22V948000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A gas leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
22V948000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the cooktops, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 25, 2022.  Owners may contact Shadow Trailer customer service at 1-352-529-2190.  Shadow Trailer's number for this recall is 22E-021.
22V948000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V956000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2023 ID4 rear-wheel drive vehicles.  The 12-Volt battery charging cable may contact the steering column shaft and cause the cable insulation to wear, possibly resulting in a short circuit.
22V956000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A short circuit may cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.  A short circuit also increases the risk of a vehicle fire.
22V956000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures until the remedy has been completed.  Dealers will inspect the 12-Volt battery charging cable and repair or replace it, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed February 27, 2023.  Owners may contact Volkswagen's customer service at 1-800-893-5298.  Volkswagen's number for this recall is 97HA.
22V956000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V770000.DESC_DEFECT: Storyteller Overland (Storyteller) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Storyteller Mode LT motorhomes.  The wires connecting the secondary alternator to the auxiliary power system may be improperly routed, allowing them to contact the CV axle shaft and damage the wires.
22V770000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Damaged or frayed wires can cause an electrical short, increasing the risk of a fire.
22V770000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reroute the wiring and add a heat shield.  In addition, wires will be inspected for damage and replaced as necessary.  Repairs will be performed free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 21, 2022.  Owners may contact Storyteller customer service at 1-888-999-7442.
22V770000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V784000.DESC_DEFECT: Thor Motor Coach (TMC) is recalling certain 2023 Magnitude and Omni vehicles.  The Occupant and Cargo Carrying Capacity (OCCC) Label states the incorrect number of seat belts, indicating that there are more seat belts available than there actually are.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other Than Passenger Cars."
22V784000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The incorrect seat belt information may result in occupants being transported without available seat belts, increasing their risk of injury.
22V784000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the label, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 10, 2022.  Owners may contact TMC customer service at 1-877-855-2867.  TMC's number for this recall is RC000281.
22V784000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V808000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US LLC) is recalling certain 2022 Dodge Challenger, Dodge Charger, and Chrysler 300 vehicles.  The Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) sensor battery may fail prematurely and cause the sensor to become inoperative.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring Systems."
22V808000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Inoperative TPMS sensors will not alert the driver to low tire pressure.  In addition, a TPMS warning light that is already illuminated from a failed battery sensor will mask an actual tire pressure failure issue.  Either of these scenarios can result in tire failure and increase the risk of a crash.
22V808000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the TPMS sensors, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 10, 2022.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US, LLC's number for this recall is ZB5.  This recall is an expansion of previous recall number 22V-504.
22V808000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V810000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE
22V810000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2018 Santa Fe Sport vehicles.  The Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) module could malfunction and cause an electrical short, which could result in an engine compartment fire while parked or driving.
22V810000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine compartment fire while parked or driving can increase the risk of injury.
22V810000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures until the recall repair is complete.  Dealers will replace the ABS multi-fuse, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 16, 2022.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 237.  This recall is an expansion of recall 22V-056.
22V810000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V812000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:FOUNDATION COMPONENTS:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
22V812000.DESC_DEFECT: Corp. Micro Bird Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling one 2019 Micro Bird G5 transit bus.  An inadequate connection between the power steering pressure line and the brake Hydroboost unit may result in a sudden loss of power steering fluid.
22V812000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden loss of power steering fluid can result in a loss of power steering and power brake assist, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V812000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: A dealer will inspect the connection between the power steering lines and the Hydroboost unit, and replace the power steering lines, as necessary, free of charge.  The owner notification letter were mailed December 22, 2022.  Owners may contact Micro Bird customer service at 1-819-477-2012.  Micro Bird's number for this recall is 22-097-PUC.
22V812000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V860000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2023 BMW 740i, 760i xDrive, and i7 xDrive60 vehicles.  The telematics control unit may not transmit the vehicle location information to emergency responders.
22V860000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Emergency response may be delayed without the vehicle location information, increasing the risk of injury.
22V860000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the telematics control unit software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 17, 2023.  Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417.
22V860000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V849000.DESC_DEFECT: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2021-2023 International MV vehicles.  The high voltage positive cables that connect the battery packs to the manual service disconnects (MSD) may have been mislabeled.
22V849000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A misidentified electrical cable may be mistaken for a de-energized cable by a technician or first responder, increasing the risk of electrical shock and injury.
22V849000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reinstall the battery cables and replace the associated warning labels, free of charge.  Interim owner notification letters were mailed January 13, 2023.  Remedy parts are expected to become available 1st Quarter of 2023.  Owners may contact Navistar's customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  Navistar's number for this recall is 22522.
22V849000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V865000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Jeep Wrangler 4xe vehicles equipped with 2.0L Plug-In Hybrid Electric Vehicle engines.  A loss of communication may cause an engine shutdown.
22V865000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine shutdown can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V865000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: There is more than one involved component and calibration software.  Updating the calibration software in the Transmission Control Module, Hybrid Control Processor and Auxiliary Hybrid Control Processor that changes fail safe from shut down to limp home.  Dealers will update the transmission control module software, Hybrid Control Processor and Auxiliary Hybrid Control Processor, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 22, 2022.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US, LLC's number for this recall ZB7.
22V865000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V869000.DESC_DEFECT: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2021-2022 International CV, 2022-2023 International HV, 2023 IC 1300 FBC, CE, RE, TC, International MV, HX, LT, RH, and LoneStar vehicles.  The hex flange lock nuts, used in the suspension and steering joints, were improperly heat treated and may lose tension over time.
22V869000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of tension in the steering and suspension joints may lead to steering instability and increase the risk of a crash.
22V869000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the hex flange lock nuts as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 20, 2023.  Owners may contact Navistar's customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  Navistar's number for this recall is 22524.
22V869000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V873000.COMPNAME: AIR BAGS: AIR BAG/RESTRAINT CONTROL MODULE
22V873000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 vehicles.  The sensing diagnostic module (SDM) was left in manufacturing mode and not activated at the assembly plant prior to shipment.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
22V873000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An SDM in manufacturing mode will not deploy the vehicle's air bags in a crash, increasing the risk of occupant injury.
22V873000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers returned the vehicles to the GM assembly plant and the sensing diagnostic modules were activated.  The vehicles had not been sold from dealer inventory and therefore no owner letters will be mailed.  Owners may contact Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020.  GM's number for this recall is N222387870.
22V873000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V417000.DESC_DEFECT: Shyft Group (Shyft Group) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Utilimaster Walk-In Vans.  The headrest portion of the passenger-side jump seat may have been installed in an incorrect position.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 202, "Head Restraints."
22V417000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrectly positioned headrest can increase the risk of injury during a crash.
22V417000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Shyft Group will install spacers, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on June 22, 2022.  Owners may contact Shyft Group's customer service at 1-800-237-7806.  Shyft Group's number for this recall is 22-02.
22V417000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V422000.DESC_DEFECT: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2022 Huracan EVO and STO vehicles.  The exterior driver-side door handle may not be assembled properly, which can prevent the opening of the driver-side door from the outside.
22V422000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A person may become trapped which, in the event of an emergency, may increase their risk of injury.
22V422000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the driver-side door handle, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 19, 2022.  Owners may contact Automobili Lamborghini customer service at 1-866-681-6276.  Automobili Lamborghini's number for this recall is L62X-R.03.22.
22V422000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V434000.MFGNAME: Isuzu Technical Center of America, Inc.
22V434000.DESC_DEFECT: Isuzu Technical Center of America, Inc. (Isuzu) is recalling certain 2022 NQR Gas and NRR Gas trucks equipped with 6.0L engines.  The engine wiring harness assembly was incorrectly wired to the oil pressure sensor.
22V434000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrectly wired oil pressure sensor will not alert the driver to low oil pressure, possibly resulting in an engine stall and increasing the risk of a crash.
22V434000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will fix the engine wiring harness assembly connector in the engine oil pressure sensor, free of charge..  Owner notification letters were mailed on July 29, 2022.  Owners may contact Isuzu's customer service at 1-866-441-9638.  Isuzu's number for this recall is V2202.
22V434000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V442000.DESC_DEFECT: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2022 Momentum travel trailers.  The 110-volt power supply wire was incorrectly wired directly into the solar inverter, which can overload the circuit and cause the power supply wire to overheat.
22V442000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated power supply wire increases the risk of a fire.
22V442000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will rewire the 110-volt power wire, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 25, 2022.  Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679.  Grand Design's number for this recall is 910030.
22V442000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V450000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2022 RPOD RPT153 travel trailers.  The Federal Placard states an incorrect axle rating of 4400 lbs, instead of the correct rating of 3500 lbs, which can cause the vehicle to become overloaded.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
22V450000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overloaded vehicle can cause a loss of control and increase the risk of a crash.
22V450000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Forest River will mail replacement labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 18, 2022.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-642-3119 Option 2.  Forest River's number for this recall is 80-1525.
22V450000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V471000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 1998 Audi A8 and 1997-1998 Audi A4 vehicles equipped with Non-Azide Driver air bag Inflators (NADI) that do not contain phase stabilized ammonium nitrate (PSAN) propellant.  Due to a manufacturing issue, the NADI inflator may absorb moisture, causing the inflator to explode or the air bag cushion to underinflate.
22V471000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The inflator could explode during air bag deployment, resulting in metal fragments striking the driver or other occupants.  An underinflated air bag may not properly protect the occupant.  These scenarios increase the risk of serious injury or death.
22V471000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the driver's air bag inflator with an alternative inflator of a different design, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were sent September 21, 2021.  Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Audi's number for this recall is 69BT.  The vehicles in this recall were mistakenly omitted from recall 20V-056.  All vehicle owners have already been notified by mail and informed that the remedy is available.
22V471000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V472000.DESC_DEFECT: Silver Eagle Manufacturing Company (Silver Eagle) is recalling certain 2021 VAST20W trailer converter dollies.  The ballast hanger near the rear of the frame may fail, causing part of the ballast hanger and its counterweights to fall onto the roadway.
22V472000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The ballast hanger separating from the trailer dolly can become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V472000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Silver Eagle will replace the ballast hanger, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on July 14, 2022.  Owners may contact Silver Eagle's customer service at 1-800-547-6792.
22V472000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V480000.DESC_DEFECT: Southeast Toyota Distributors, LLC (SET) is recalling certain 2020-2022 4Runner vehicles equipped with 20-inch Black Gunner Wheels.  The load carrying capacity modification labels are incorrect.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
22V480000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrect label may lead to unintentionally overloading the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V480000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: SET will mail replacement labels to owners, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed September 4, 2022.  Owners may contact SET's customer service at 954-429-2000.  SET's number for this recall is SET22A.
22V480000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V482000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2016-2018 Mercedes-Benz Metris vans.  The value for the maximum combined load weight capacity of the tires is incorrect.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire and Loading Information."
22V482000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overloaded vehicle may cause tire failure, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V482000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install corrected labels on the B-pillar and fuel filler door.  Dealers will also inspect and replace incorrect tires, as necessary.  All repairs will be performed free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed beginning April 19, 2024.  Owners may contact DVUSA at 1-877-762-8267.  DVUSA's number for this recall is VS2LASTRE.
22V482000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V487000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Dynamax Isata Class 3 and Class 5 motorhomes, 2021 Coachmen Sportscoach, 2020 Coachmen Pursuit, and 2017, 2020-2021 Coachmen Freelander motorhomes.  The service valves on the LPG tanks may be improperly connected, which can cause a propane leak.
22V487000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A propane leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
22V487000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the service valves, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 2, 2022.  Owner may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-262-3474 (Dynamax), 1-574-825-8212 (Sportscoach and Pursuit), and 1-574-825-8602 (Freelander).  Forest River's number for this recall is 51-1533.
22V487000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

22V503000.DESC_DEFECT: Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. (BRP) is recalling certain 2022 Can-Am Ryker motorcycles.  The handlebar stem bolt may break unexpectedly due to insufficient thread length.
22V503000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken handlebar stem bolt can cause a sudden loss of steering control, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V503000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to not ride their motorcycle until the remedy is complete.  Dealers will clean the threads of the steering column and install a new steering stem bolt, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 14, 2022.  Owners may contact BRP customer service at 1-888-272-9222.  BRP's number for this recall is 2022-16.
22V503000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V509000.DESC_DEFECT: Kia Motors America (Kia) is recalling certain 2022 Sorento and Telluride vehicles.  The vehicles may be equipped with an incorrect spare tire which, when installed, can impair the anti-lock braking system (ABS) and the traction control system (TCS).  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
22V509000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Impaired anti-lock braking or traction control systems can increase the risk of a crash.
22V509000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the spare tire, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 27, 2022.  Owners may contact Kia customer service at 1-800-333-4542.  Kia's number for this recall is SC244.
22V509000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V512000.DESC_DEFECT: Alliance RV, LLC (Alliance) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Paradigm and Valor travel trailers.  The electric retractable awning has a welded seam on the fabric that may separate, potentially allowing the awning to drop beyond normal operation.
22V512000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An awning that drops or extends beyond normal operation can increase the risk of injury.
22V512000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect for any weld separation and replace the awnings, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 17, 2022.  Owners may contact Alliance customer service at (574) 226-0140.
22V512000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

22V515000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2022 Audi S3 and A3 sedans.  The retention force of the seat belt tensioner on the driver and front passenger seats may be inadequate to properly restrain the occupants during a crash.
22V515000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Improperly restrained occupants have an increased risk of injury during a crash.
22V515000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the driver and front passenger seat belt assemblies, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed November 15, 2022. Owners may contact Audi's customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Audi's number for this recall is 68i2.
22V515000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V521000.DESC_DEFECT: Cruiser RV (Cruiser) is recalling certain 2022 Shadow Cruiser travel trailers.  The Federal certification label shows the incorrect Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR), which can allow the vehicle to be overloaded.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
22V521000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The vehicle may be overloaded, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V521000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Cruiser will send out replacement certification labels, free of charge.  Owners notification letters were mailed August 15, 2022.  Owners may contact Cruiser at 1-574-206-7920.
22V521000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V558000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2022 Flagstaff and 2022-2023 Rockwood tent campers.  The axle may be installed backwards, which can reduce brake function.
22V558000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of brake function increases the risk of a crash.
22V558000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and properly install the axle if necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 24, 2022.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 1-574-642-8943.  Forest River's number for this recall is 10-1539.
22V558000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V459000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2017-2018 Ioniq HEV and Ionic PHV vehicles previously recalled under recall number 18V-704.  The Power Relay Assembly (PRA) located underneath the rear seat may overheat.
22V459000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated PRA increases the risk of a fire.
22V459000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the main relay or PRA, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 23, 2022.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 232.  This recall replaces NHTSA recall number 18V-704.  Vehicles already repaired under the previous recall will need to have the new remedy completed.
22V459000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V463000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors (GM) has decided that certain 2022 model year Chevrolet Silverado, and GMC Sierra vehicles equipped with an accessory sport bar.  The accessory sport bar contains a high-mounted brake light that may not function.  In addition, it may block the vehicle's existing high-mounted brake light.  As such, these vehicles may fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment."
22V463000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An inoperative high-mounted brake light can reduce visibility to other drivers and increase the risk of a crash.
22V463000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the installation of the accessory bar and provide the correct vehicle wiring, if necessary, free of charge.  Interim owner notification letters advising owners of the safety risk were mailed on August 10, 2022.  Owner notification letters were mailed on January 27, 2023.  Owners may contact GM's customer service on 1-888-988-7267 or Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020..  GM's  recall number for this recall is N222368110.
22V463000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V475000.DESC_DEFECT: Autocar, LLC. (Autocar) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Legend, Xpeditor, and Xspotter trucks equipped with Sheppard Steering Gears. The steering gears may have been assembled incorrectly,which can cause the gear to fracture.
22V475000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fractured steering gear can cause a loss of steering control, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V475000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers with inspect and replace the steering gear, at no charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on August 29, 2022.  Owners can contact Autocar's customer service at 765-489-5499.  Autocar's number for this recall is ACX-2204 DC-2202.
22V475000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V491000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2021 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2500 vehicles.  The generator wiring harness may be incorrectly connected to the electric power steering, which can result in an electrical surge.
22V491000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An electrical surge can increase the risk of a fire.
22V491000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and correct the wiring harness connection, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 10, 2022.  Owners may contact DVUSA at 1-877-762-8267.  DVUSA's number for this recall is VS3LE54ELE.
22V491000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V492000.DESC_DEFECT: Roadtrek Inc. (Roadtrek) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Zion, Zion SRT, Zion Slumber, Chase, Play, Play SRT, and Play Slumber motorhomes.  The output line on the LPG tanks may not connect properly to the shut off valve, which can cause a propane leak.
22V492000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A propane leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
22V492000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the service valves, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed in September 8, 2022.  Owners may contact Roadtrek customer service at 1-888-762-3873.
22V492000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V494000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2020 GLC350E4 vehicles.  The transmission wiring harness may be routed improperly, allowing it to chafe against the front drive shaft, which can cause loss of drive power.
22V494000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power can increase the risk of a crash.
22V494000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the transmission wiring harness, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 26, 2022.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372. MBUSA's number for this recall is 2022080001.
22V494000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V495000.DESC_DEFECT: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2021 X3-45 commuter buses.  One bolt that secures the rear bench seat frame to the body of the vehicle was not installed during the manufacturing process.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."
22V495000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: During a crash, the rear seats could separate from the vehicle, increasing the risk of an injury.
22V495000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install the missing bolt, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed on August 22, 2022.  Owners may contact Prevost's customer service at 1-866-870-2046.
22V495000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V510000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2014-23 Thomas Built Buses HDX and 2014-22 EFX school buses equipped with 39-inch S3C seat frames and 3-point flex seatbelts. The passenger seat frames may crack and rotate from fatigue.
22V510000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Cracked passenger seat frames may not adequately secure passengers in the event of a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
22V510000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will secure the seat frames with brackets, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mail December 4, 2023.  Owners may contact DTNA's customer service at 1-800-547-0712.  DTNA's number for this recall is FL946.
22V510000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V513000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:FUEL INJECTION SYSTEM:FUEL RAIL
22V513000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2022 X1 xDrive 28i, X3 xDrive30i, and 228i Gran Coupe vehicles.  The high-pressure fuel rail may crack and result in a fuel leak within the engine compartment.
22V513000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.
22V513000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the high-pressure fuel rail, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 19, 2022.  Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417.
22V513000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V518000.DESC_DEFECT: Cheetah Chassis Corporation (Cheetah) is recalling certain 2023 7400GNFF0, 7235SNFSX, and 8400GNFF0 trailers.  The Tandemloc twist lock handles may separate from the trailer and fall to the ground.
22V518000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A lock that detaches and falls can become a road hazard.  In addition, this may cause a container being transported to become unsecured.  Either of these scenarios can increase the risk of a crash.
22V518000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair affected handles, and replace any lock assemblies that are missing, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed in July 2022.  Owners may contact Cheetah's customer service at 844-205-5525.
22V518000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V529000.DESC_DEFECT: Ember Recreational Vehicles, INC (Ember) is recalling certain 2022 Overland series trailers, model numbers 191MDB, 190MDB, 170MBH, and 170MRB.  The quick disconnect fittings in the LP gas system may be cracked, causing a gas leak.
22V529000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A gas leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
22V529000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the LP quick disconnect fittings, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 5, 2022.  Owners may contact Ember's customer service at 1-844-732-4204.
22V529000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V530000.DESC_DEFECT: Lion Electric Company (Lion Electric) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Lion C school buses.  The parking brake may fail if it is not properly adjusted.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 105, "Hydraulic and Electric Brake Systems."
22V530000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Failure of the parking brake increases the risk of a crash.
22V530000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reroute the cable and adjust the parking lever, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on August 16, 2022.  Owners may contact Lion Electric's customer service at 1-855-546-6706.
22V530000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V542000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2022 Golf R A8 and Golf GTI vehicles.  The touch switch for the sunroof may be too sensitive, allowing it to be inadvertently pressed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 118, "Power-Operated Window Systems."
22V542000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sunroof switch that is inadvertently pressed can result in unintended auto-closure of the sunroof, increasing the risk of injury.
22V542000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the roof module switch, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed September 23, 2022.  Owners may contact Volkswagen's customer service at 1-800-893-5298.  Volkswagen's number for this recall is 60F6.
22V542000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V554000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:ENGINE CONTROL MODULE (ECU/ECM)
22V554000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2023 Freightliner 108SD, 114SD, Business Class M2, Cascadia, 2023 Freightliner FCCC MC, MT45, S2C 106CAB, XCM, S2RV 106CAB, XCR, XCS, and 2023 Western Star 4700, 49X, and 47X vehicles.  The engine control module (ECM) may experience an internal short-circuit, which can result in an unexpected engine shut down.
22V554000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Unexpected engine shut down can increase the risk of a crash.
22V554000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Cummins will replace the ECM, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed September 26, 2022.  Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712.  DTNA's number for this recall is FL-949.
22V554000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V582000.DESC_DEFECT: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Kenworth T680 tractor trailers.  The mud flap may contact the fuel tank while the vehicle is in motion, creating wear on the fuel tank over time.
22V582000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Excessive wear of the fuel tank may allow fuel to spill on the roadway, which can increase the risk of a crash or injury.
22V582000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the fuel tank and install an anti-sail device to prevent the mud flap from contacting the fuel tank, free of charge.  Owner letters were mailed February 1, 2023.  Owners may contact Kenworth's customer service at 1-425-828-5888.  Paccar's number for this recall is 22KWF.
22V582000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V563000.DESC_DEFECT: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc. (MMNA) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Outlander Sport vehicles equipped with continuously variable transmissions and mechanical key ignition systems.  A software error in the transmission control unit (CVT-ECU) may incorrectly reduce the transmission gear ratio at high speeds, which can result in an engine stall.
22V563000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine stall can increase the risk of a crash.
22V563000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the CVT-ECU software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 24, 2022.  Owners may contact MMNA customer service at 1-888-648-7820.  MMNA's number for this recall is SR-22-004.
22V563000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V567000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling one 2022 Audi SQ5 Sportback vehicle.  The connections that join the metal sheets to form the rear lid may have been improperly connected.
22V567000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly connected rear lid may decrease the structural protection of the vehicle during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
22V567000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: A dealer will replace the rear lid, free of charge.  The owner notification letter is expected to be mailed September 30, 2022.  Owners may contact Audi's customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Audi's number for this recall is 55M6.
22V567000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V586000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021 Prime Time Tracer TRT26KSS travel trailers.  The tail light may be located too close to the water heater exhaust, which can cause the tail light lens to melt and the light to become inoperative.
22V586000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A distorted or inoperative tail light may reduce vehicle visibility and confuse other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V586000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a flush mount tail light, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 26, 2022.  Owners may contact Forest River's customer service at 1-574-862-1025.  Forest River's number for this recall is 48-1541.
22V586000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V591000.DESC_DEFECT: Heartland Recreational Vehicles, LLC (Heartland) is recalling certain 2022 Cyclone, Elk Ridge, Fuel, Milestone, North Trail,  2022-2023 Big Horn Traveler, Gravity, Lithium, Mallard, Pioneer, Prowler, Road Warrior, Sundance, Torque, and Trail Runner travel trailers.  The electric retractable awning has a welded seam on the fabric that may separate, potentially allowing the awning to drop beyond normal operation.
22V591000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An awning that drops or extends beyond normal operation can increase the risk of injury.
22V591000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair, or replace the awning, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed by September 8, 2022.  Owners may contact Heartland customer service at 1-877-262-8032.
22V591000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V595000.DESC_DEFECT: Airstream, Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Basecamp, Bambi, Atlas, Interstate, and Interstate 19 travel trailers equipped with certain 2-burner cooktops.  The burner control valves may become damaged, causing a gas leak.
22V595000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A gas leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
22V595000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect, and if necessary replace the cooktop, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 7, 2022.  Owners may contact Airstream customer service at 1-877-596-6505 or 1-937-596-6111 ext. 7401 or 7411.
22V595000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V599000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:ENGINE CONTROL MODULE (ECU/ECM)
22V599000.DESC_DEFECT: Shyft Group is recalling certain 2023 Spartan RV Chassis K2 vehicles.  The engine control module (ECM) may experience an internal short-circuit, which can result in an unexpected engine shut down without the ability to restart the vehicle.
22V599000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unexpected engine shut down can increase the risk of a crash.  Additionally, a disabled school bus may require an evacuation procedure in an uncontrolled traffic situation, increasing the risk of injury to passengers.
22V599000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Cummins will replace the ECM and fuse, free of charge.  Owners may contact Shyft Group's customer service at 1-800-582-3454.  Shyft Group's number for this recall is 22-05.
22V599000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V606000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:ENGINE CONTROL MODULE (ECU/ECM)
22V606000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2023 MD6/7 trucks.  The engine control module (ECM) may experience an internal short-circuit, which can result in an unexpected engine shut down.
22V606000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unexpected engine shut down can increase the risk of a crash.
22V606000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Cummins will replace the ECM, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on September 27, 2022.  Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177.  Mack's number for this recall is SC0438.
22V606000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V607000.DESC_DEFECT: Kovatch Mobile Equipment Corp. (KME) is recalling certain 2021-2022 KME Predator, Panther, and Severe Service fire trucks equipped with Sheppard Steering Gears.  The steering gears may have been assembled incorrectly, which can cause the gears to fracture.
22V607000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fractured steering gear can cause a loss of steering control, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V607000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the serial numbers and replace the steering gears, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on October 3, 2022.  Owners may contact KME's customer service at 1-800-235-3928.
22V607000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V620000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:ENGINE CONTROL MODULE (ECU/ECM)
22V620000.DESC_DEFECT: Rosenbauer America (Rosenbauer) is recalling certain 2022 Commander and 2023 Commercial M2-106 fire trucks.  The engine control module (ECM) may experience an internal short-circuit, which can result in an unexpected engine shut down without the ability to restart the vehicle.
22V620000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unexpected engine shut down can increase the risk of a crash.
22V620000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Cummins will replace the ECM, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed on September 25, 2022.  Owners may contact Rosenbauer's customer service at 1-651-462-1000.  Rosenbauer's number for this recall is C2614.
22V620000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V625000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:ENGINE CONTROL MODULE (ECU/ECM)
22V625000.DESC_DEFECT: Spartan Fire, LLC (Spartan Fire) is recalling one 2022 MetroStar fire truck.  The engine control module (ECM) may experience an internal short-circuit, which can result in an unexpected engine shut down.
22V625000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unexpected engine stall can increase the risk of a crash.
22V625000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Cummins will replace the ECM, free of charge.  The single affected vehicle was repaired September 21, 2022.  Owners may contact Spartan Fire's customer service at 1-517-543-6400.  Spartan Fire's number for this recall is 22004.
22V625000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V332000.DESC_DEFECT: Driverge Vehicle Innovations (Driverge) is recalling certain 2021 Ford Transit 350 vehicles.  Exposed copper may cause the Programmable Relay Power Center (PRPC) module to fail and short-circuit.
22V332000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An electrical short-circuit increases the risk of a fire.
22V332000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Driverge will work with the equipment manufacturer to provide a fused data link harness, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 31, 2022.  Owners may contact Driverge customer service at 1-330-861-1118 or Intermotive Warranty at 1-530-823-1048 ext.103.
22V332000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V341000.DESC_DEFECT: Shyft Group is recalling certain 2022 Utilimaster Walk-in vans.  The tire size and tire pressures on the tire placard and certification label may be incorrect.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims" and 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
22V341000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect tire information may result in improperly inflated tires and overloading of the vehicle, which could increase the risk of a crash.
22V341000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Shyft Group will replace the labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on May 20, 2022.  Owners may contact Shyft Group's customer service at 1-800-582-3454.  Shyft Group's number for this recall is 22-01.
22V341000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V347000.DESC_DEFECT: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2020-2022 X3-45 Commuter vehicles.  The right-side rearview mirror is positioned incorrectly, obstructing the view of the right side of the vehicle and the adjacent lane.
22V347000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrectly positioned right-side mirror can reduce the driver's visibility of what is around the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V347000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will repair or replace the right rearview mirror, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on June 30, 2022.  Owners may contact Prevost customer service at 1-866-870-2046. Prevost's number for this recall is SR22-08.
22V347000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V349000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2016-2022 E-series & DH-H series Digger Derricks.  The relay connectors may have been reattached to the incorrect plug after a stability test was performed.  If the connections are not correct, the hydraulic overload protection system will not function.
22V349000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A nonfunctional overload protection system may result in the operator unknowingly overloading the system, increasing the risk of injury.
22V349000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Altec will inspect and reattach the connectors, if necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on June 29, 2022.  Owners may contact Altec's customer service at 1-877-462-5832.  Altec's number for this recall is CSN 858.
22V349000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V354000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Accent, 2021-2022 Elantra, and 2021-2022 Elantra HEV vehicles.   In the event of a crash, the front driver-side and/or passenger-side seat belt pretensioners may explode upon deployment.
22V354000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An exploding seat belt pretensioner can project metal fragments into the vehicle, strike vehicle occupants, and result in injury.
22V354000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will secure the seat belt pretensioner(s) with a cap, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 28, 2022.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 229.  This recall expands and replaces NHTSA recall numbers 21V-796, 22V-069, 22V-218, and 22V-123 for Accent, Elantra, and Elantra HEV vehicles.  All Accent, Elantra, and Elantra HEV vehicles already repaired under the previous recalls will need to have the new remedy completed.
22V354000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V382000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Mustang vehicles equipped with 5.0L engines and manual transmissions.  The Powertrain Control Module (PCM) may broadcast an unintended faulted signal to the modules controlling the reverse camera, reverse light, and driver assist features, which may disable all of these functions.
22V382000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera or reverse light that is disabled reduces the driver's rear view, increasing the risk of a crash.  Disabled driver assist features (traction control, forward collision warning, blind spot warning, cross traffic indicator) may increase the risk of a crash.
22V382000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the PCM software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 15, 2022.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 22S37.
22V382000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V362000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
22V362000.MFGNAME: Isuzu Technical Center of America, Inc.
22V362000.DESC_DEFECT: Isuzu Technical Center of America, Inc. (Isuzu) is recalling certain FTR and FVR trucks.  The quick connector used to connect the fuel suction hose to the fuel inlet pipe of the engine is too large.  The larger diameter of the quick connector may cause inadequate sealing, resulting in a fuel leak.  In addition, the gap may cause air to be sucked into the fuel hose while the engine is running.
22V362000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.  Air intake into the fuel hose increases the risk of engine stalling, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V362000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the quick connector with the correct size quick connector, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on June 24, 2022.  Owners may contact Isuzu's customer service at 1-866-441-9638.  Isuzu's number for this recall is V2201.
22V362000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V383000.DESC_DEFECT: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2022 Keystone Cougar travel trailers, equipped with a swing up table/bed base.  The base may have incomplete welds that are unable to hold the intended weight, causing the table/bed base to drop unexpectedly.
22V383000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A table or bed that drops unexpectedly can increase the risk of injury.
22V383000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the table/bed base, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 24, 2022.  Owners may contact Keystone customer service at 1-866-425-4369.  Keystone's number for this recall is 22-433.
22V383000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V393000.DESC_DEFECT: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2020 ERA motorhomes, equipped with certain 2-burner cooktops.  The burner control valves may become damaged, causing a gas leak.
22V393000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A gas leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
22V393000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Winnebago will work with Dometic to replace the cooktops, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 28, 2022.  Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-641-585-6939 or 1-800-537-1885 or Dometic customer service at 888-943-4905.
22V393000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V399000.DESC_DEFECT: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2022-2023 VN tractor trailers.  The steering gears may have been assembled incorrectly, which can cause the gear to fracture.
22V399000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fractured steering gear can cause a loss of steering control, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V399000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace steering gears on vehicles.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed July 29, 2022.  Owners may contact Volvo Truck customer service at 1-800-528-6586. Volvo Truck's number for this recall is RVXX2202.
22V399000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V001000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:FUEL INJECTION SYSTEM:FUEL RAIL
22V001000.DESC_DEFECT: Rosenbauer America (Rosenbauer) is recalling certain 2018-2021 Commander, 2018-2020 Warrior, and 2020-2022 Commercial 114SD vehicles.  The fuel tubes between the fuel rail and the injector for cylinders 4, 5, and 6 may be susceptible to cracking, resulting in a high-pressure fuel leak.
22V001000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A high-pressure fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
22V001000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Cummins dealers will install vibration isolators, and replace the fuel tubes as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on March 8, 2022.  Owners may contact Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467.
22V001000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V004000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Prime Time Sanibel, Crusader, Forest River Cardinal, and Continental Cargo fifth wheel trailers, equipped with certain Sailun tires, size ST235/80R16/G.   Due to a manufacturing issue, the tires may experience a belt separation.
22V004000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Belt separation could lead to loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V004000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the tire DOT codes, and replace the tires as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 1, 2022.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-825-4995.  Forest River's number for this recall is 51-1449.
22V004000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V026000.MFGNAME: Trails West Manufacturing of Idaho, Inc.
22V026000.DESC_DEFECT: Trails West Manufacturing of Idaho, Inc. (Trails West) is recalling certain 2017-2021 Sierra, Classic, Santa Fe, and Freeride trailers equipped with Winntec model 6020 two-stage propane regulators.  The regulator may fail, causing an increase in propane pressure.
22V026000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Increased propane pressure can enlarge the flames in gas appliances, increasing the risk of a fire.
22V026000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the regulators, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 27, 2022.  Owners may contact Trail West customer service at 1-208-852-2200.
22V026000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V008000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:FUEL INJECTION SYSTEM:FUEL RAIL
22V008000.DESC_DEFECT: Oshkosh Corporation (Oshkosh) is recalling certain 2019-2022 S-Series vehicles.  The fuel tubes between the fuel rail and the injector for cylinders 4, 5 and 6 may be susceptible to cracking, resulting in a high pressure fuel leak.
22V008000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A high pressure fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source may increase the risk of a fire.
22V008000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: On engines with 75 miles or less, dealers will install vibration isolators to the fuel tubes.  Engines with more than 75 miles will receive new fuel tubes with vibration isolators.  Repairs will be performed free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed February 1, 2022.  Owners may contact Oshkosh customer service at 1-8088-686-7278.
22V008000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V366000.DESC_DEFECT: Joe's Trailer Mfg. (Joe's) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Great Lakes Tandem 16', 18' and 20' trailers.  The coupler was improperly welded, which may cause the trailer to separate from the tow vehicle.
22V366000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Trailer separation from a tow vehicle can increase the risk of a crash.
22V366000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Joe's will inspect and replace the coupler as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed in July 20, 2022.  Owners may contact Joe's customer service at 1-734-261-0050.
22V366000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V047000.DESC_DEFECT: Seagrave Fire Apparatus, LLC (Seagrave) is recalling certain 2021 Capitol and Marauder vehicles equipped with Meritor 180 series drive pinions.  The rear axle drive pinion may fracture.
22V047000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fractured drive pinion may contact the brake drop hose, and unintentionally engage the parking brake without detection or without the brake lights activating, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V047000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Meritor will inspect and replace the drive pinion, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 23, 2022. Owners may contact Seagrave customer service at 1-877-777-5360.
22V047000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V053000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Entegra Coach Accolade, Accolade XL, Jayco Seneca, and Seneca Prestige Class C motorhomes.  The tie rod clamps may be loose, which could result in loose tie rod ends that could break or detach.
22V053000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Detached or broken tie rod ends can result in steering loss, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V053000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Daimler Truck dealers will replace the tie rod clamp bolts and nuts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 15, 2022.  Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267.  Jayco's number for this recall is 21V-369.
22V053000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V056000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE
22V056000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2016-2018 Santa Fe, 2017-2018 Santa Fe Sport, 2019 Santa Fe XL, and 2014-2015 Tucson vehicles.  The Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) module could malfunction and cause an electrical short, which could result in an engine compartment fire.
22V056000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine compartment fire while parked or driving can increase the risk of injury.
22V056000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures until the recall repair is complete.  Dealers will replace the ABS multi-fuse, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 31, 2022.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 218.
22V056000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V069000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Accent vehicles.  In the event of a crash, the front driver-side and/or passenger-side seat belt pretensioner(s) may explode upon deployment.
22V069000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An exploding seat belt pretensioner can project metal fragments into the vehicle, striking vehicle occupants and resulting in injury.
22V069000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the seat belt pretensioners, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 24, 2022.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 219.  This recall is an expansion of NHTSA recall number 21V-796.  This recall is replaced by NHTSA recall number 22V-354.  Vehicles already repaired under this recall will need to have the new remedy completed.
22V069000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V071000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2018-2021 DC and DM Series Digger Derricks and AM series Aerial Devices.  The unit subbase may develop cracks in the bulkhead plate, which can cause the shear plates to fail.
22V071000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Shear plate failure can result in the separation of the subbase and truck frame, increasing the risk of injury.
22V071000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Altec will inspect the bulkhead plate, and add a reinforcement plate, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on April 8, 2022.  Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832.  Altec's number for this recall is CSN 851.
22V071000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V073000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2021 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vehicles.  The gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) may be improperly stated on the tire and loading label.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 120, "Wheels and Rims-Other Than Passenger Cars."
22V073000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The operator may overload the vehicle, resulting in excessive tire wear and increasing the risk of a crash.
22V073000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace, as necessary, the tire and loading information label.  Additionally, tires will be inspected for excessive wear and replaced as necessary.  All repairs will be conducted free of charge.  Interim owner notifications were mailed to owners on March 4, 2022.  Owner notification letters were mailed on March 21, 2022.  Owners may contact DVUSA customer service at 1-877-762-8267.  DVUSA's number for this recall is VS3RE58HIN.
22V073000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V085000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2022 E-Tron GT vehicles.  The owner's manual may list the incorrect tire pressure.
22V085000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect tire pressure information could result in improperly inflated tires, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V085000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will insert a corrected tire pressure table into the owner's manual, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 7, 2022.  Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-853-2834.  Audi's number for this recall is 06E7.
22V085000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V090000.DESC_DEFECT: Lucid Motors, Inc. (Lucid Motors) is recalling certain 2022 Air vehicles.  The snap ring below the front strut damper may fail, resulting in a sudden drop in ride height or front brake line damage.
22V090000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden drop in ride height while driving can cause a loss of vehicle control.  In addition, brake line damage can result in a loss of brake function.  Either of these scenarios increases the risk of a crash.
22V090000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Lucid Studios or satellite service centers will inspect and replace the front strut dampers, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on February 24, 2022.  Owners may contact Lucid Motors customer service at 1-888-995-8243.  Lucid Motors number for this recall is N01.
22V090000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V097000.DESC_DEFECT: Lance Camper Manufacturing Corp. (Lance Camper) is recalling certain 2022 Lance 1685 and 1985 travel trailers.  The liquid propane (LP) hose may not be properly secured to the frame, allowing the hose to contact the leaf springs, which can cause a gas leak.
22V097000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A propane leak can increase the risk of a fire.
22V097000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will properly secure the LP hose, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 22, 2022.  Owners may contact Lance Camper customer service at 1-661-949-3322.
22V097000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V102000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2022 RS5 coupe and RS5 Sportback vehicles.  The value for the maximum combined weight of occupants and cargo on the B-pillar Tire and Loading information label is incorrect.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire and Loading Information."
22V102000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: While referencing the B-pillar label, the operator may overload the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
22V102000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a corrected label on the B-pillar, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 31, 2022.  Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Audi's number for this recall is 44S3.
22V102000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V120000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:FUEL INJECTION SYSTEM:FUEL RAIL
22V120000.DESC_DEFECT: AEBI-Schmidt (AEBI) is recalling one 2019 MB3 vehicle.  The fuel tubes between the fuel rail and the injectors for cylinders four, five, and six may fatigue and crack, which can result in a high pressure fuel leak.
22V120000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A high pressure fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
22V120000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Cummins' dealers will replace the fuel tubes, and install vibration isolators, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on March 7, 2022.  Owners may contact AEBI's customer service at 1-920-898-1035.
22V120000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V134000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
22V134000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2017-2022 Mercedes-Benz Metris vehicles.  The connection of the upper and lower fuel hoses to the engine may be insecure, which can result in a fuel leak.
22V134000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
22V134000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the fuel hose connections, and replace the clamps and fuel hose, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 5, 2022.  Owners may contact DVUSA customer service at 1-877-762-8267.  DVUSA's number for this recall is VS2KRAUCH.
22V134000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V163000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2022 Golf GTI and Golf R vehicles.  Certain driving situations, such as high acceleration driving maneuvers, may loosen the engine design cover.
22V163000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose engine design cover may contact hot surfaces in the engine compartment and melt, increasing the risk of a fire.
22V163000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will remove the engine design cover, free of charge.  Once parts become available, Volkswagen will provide a free updated engine design cover under a separate Service Action.    Owner notification letters were mailed by March 29, 2022.  Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298.  Volkswagen's number for this recall is 10H5.
22V163000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V168000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:ENGINE CONTROL MODULE (ECU/ECM):SOFTWARE
22V168000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2010 E350, 2014 G550, 2008-2009 C300, 2008 C350, 2009 CLK550, 2007 SL550, SLK280, and 2008 SLK350 vehicles.  Various control units may have been updated with incorrect software configuration during a service repair.  This can result in various system failures, such as loss of drive power, reduced exterior lighting, or loss of dynamic control functions, including stability and traction control.
22V168000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Various system failures, such as loss of drive power, reduced exterior lighting, or loss of dynamic control functions including stability and traction control, can increase the risk of a crash.
22V168000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the software configuration on the affected control units, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 3, 2022.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.  MBUSA's number for this recall is 2022040003.
22V168000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V368000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:ENGINE CONTROL MODULE (ECU/ECM)
22V368000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2022 Audi A6 Sedan, A4 Sedan, Q5, and Q5 Sportback vehicles.  The semiconductor inside the engine control unit may short-circuit and cause an engine stall.
22V368000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine stall can increase the risk of a crash.
22V368000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the engine control unit, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 18, 2022. Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Audi's number for this recall is 24iH.
22V368000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V174000.DESC_DEFECT: Alliance RV, LLC (Alliance RV) is recalling certain 2022 Paradigm, Valor, and Avenue travel trailers, equipped with a 50-amp shore power inlet.  The power inlet lug bolts may have been manufactured with excessively hard metal, preventing them from being tightened properly and resulting in a loose wiring connection.
22V174000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Loose wiring can cause an electrical arc or short, increasing the risk of a fire.
22V174000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the power inlet, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 25, 2022.  Owners may contact Alliance RV customer service at 1-574-218-7165.
22V174000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V180000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Jeep Grand Cherokee L vehicles.  These vehicles may have been built with a missing weld from the seat back frame to the child seat tether anchorage.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 225, "Child Restraint Anchorage Systems."
22V180000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A missing weld may allow the child seat tether to separate from the seat frame during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
22V180000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and, if necessary, replace the second-row seat back frame, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 7, 2022.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US LLC's number for this recall is Z24.
22V180000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V322000.DESC_DEFECT: Kia Motor America (Kia) is recalling certain 2022 EV6 vehicles.  A software error in the Shifter Control Unit (SCU) may disengage the parking mechanism, which can allow the vehicle to rollaway.
22V322000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Vehicle rollaway can increase the risk of a crash or injury.
22V322000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Drivers are recommended to park their vehicles on level ground and avoid parking on a slope/inclined surface whenever possible until the remedy has been performed.  Dealers will update the Shifter Control Unit software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 25, 2022.  Owners may contact Kia customer service at 1-800-333-4542.  Kia's number for this recall is SC236.
22V322000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

22V336000.DESC_DEFECT: Kuntry Kustom RV, LLC (Kuntry) is recalling certain 2017-2020 Rich Specialty Trailers Sanitation, Movie, Office, and Bunk House trailers, equipped with Winntec model 6020 two-stage propane regulators.  The regulators may fail, causing an increase in propane pressure.
