24V451000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An oil leak in the presence of an ignition source such as hot engine or exhaust components, can increase the risk of a fire.
24V451000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the filter housing, oil filter, and o-rings, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 27, 2024.  Owners may contact Jaguar customer service at 1-800-452-4827.  Jaguar's number for this recall is H506.
24V451000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V465000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, AIR:SUPPLY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
24V465000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Audi RS E-Tron GT and Audi E-Tron GT vehicles.  The front axle brake hoses can develop tears, causing a leak and a brake circuit failure.
24V465000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A failed brake circuit can cause longer brake pedal travel and reduced braking performance, extending the distance required to stop and increasing the risk of a crash.
24V465000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the front axle brake hoses, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed on August 6, 2024.  Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Audi's number for this recall is 47UP.
24V465000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V482000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2024 Lexus RX 350, RX 350h, 2024-2025 NX 250, NX 350, and NX 350h vehicles.  The head restraints on the driver and front passenger seats may be inadvertently removed without pressing the lock release button.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) Number 202, "Head Restraints."
24V482000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A head restraint that is inadvertently removed and not reinstalled can increase the risk of injury during a rear-end crash.
24V482000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the driver and front passenger seat head rest assemblies, free of charge.  Owner letters were mailed February 14, 2025.  Owners may contact Toyota customer service at 1-800-331-4331.  Toyota's numbers for this recall are 24LB06 and 24LA06.
24V482000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V498000.DESC_DEFECT: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2024 Nissan Sentra vehicles.  The windshield may have air bubbles on the front lower driver's side, which can obscure the Vehicle Identification Number (VIN).  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 205, "Glazing Materials."
24V498000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An owner who cannot see their VIN clearly may not recognize their vehicle is involved in a safety recall, and may not have the recall remedy performed, which could increase the risk of injury, fire, or a crash.
24V498000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the windshield as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 29, 2024.  Owners may contact Nissan customer service at 1-800-867-7669.  Nissan's number for this recall is PMA38.
24V498000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V501000.DESC_DEFECT: E-One Incorporated (E-One) is recalling certain 2024 Cyclone N and Typhoon N vehicles equipped with an independent front suspension assembly.  The lower control arm retention bolts could become brittle and break after being tightened.
24V501000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken bolt head can become a projectile, increasing the risk of an injury.
24V501000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the bolts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 6, 2024.  Owners may contact E-One customer service at 1-352-237-1122.
24V501000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V504000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2025 LR, Granite, and Pinnacle vehicles equipped with Composilite EXS20 steerable lift axle suspension assemblies.  The tie rod assembly ball stud could have been improperly heat treated and can fail.
24V504000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The ball stud can separate from the vehicle becoming a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V504000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the tie rod end assemblies as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 15, 2024.  Owners may contact Mack customer service at 1-800-866-1177.  Mack's number for this recall is SC0468.
24V504000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V505000.DESC_DEFECT: Vermeer Manufacturing Company (Vermeer) is recalling certain 2024 BC1200XL brush chippers.  The mounting bolts which secures the axle to the mainframe may not have been properly tightened.
24V505000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose axle mounting bolt can result in the axle separating from the brush chipper, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V505000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the mounting bolts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 22, 2024.  Owners may contact Vermeer customer service at 1-800-829-0051, ext. 7060.  Vermeer's number for this recall is IK4576.
24V505000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V515000.DESC_DEFECT: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2023-2024 ACX (Xpeditor).  The retaining ring could be missing from the cab tilt hinge pin, leaving the pin unsecured.
24V515000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unsecured pin can separate from the vehicle and become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V515000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the cab tilt pin and replace the retaining ring as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 2, 2024.  Owners may contact Autocar customer service at 1-888-218-3611.  Autocar's number for this recall is ACX-2403.
24V515000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V519000.DESC_DEFECT: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2022-2023 LFS buses.  The windshield wiper arms may be incorrectly aligned, which can cause the wiper blades to collide.
24V519000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Damaged wiper blades can reduce visibility in certain weather conditions, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V519000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Nova Bus will inspect and realign the wiper blades, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 10, 2024.  Owners may contact Nova Bus customer service at 1-800-350-6682.  Nova Bus's number for this recall is CR5615.
24V519000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V542000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Transit vehicles equipped with a Transit Trail package.  The electronic power assist steering (EPAS) ground eyelet joint may experience corrosion, which can result in a loss of power steering assist.
24V542000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of power steering assist can increase the risk of a crash.
24V542000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a new EPAS ground pigtail kit, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on January 10, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S46.
24V542000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V549000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
24V549000.DESC_DEFECT: Temsa is recalling certain 2024 TS35 vehicles equipped with certain Cummins L9 diesel engines.  The remote fuel filter hoses may become separated from the fitting, which can result in a fuel leak and a lack of fuel supply to the engine.
24V549000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.  Additionally, a lack of fuel can cause an engine stall, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V549000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Cummins will replace the fuel filter hoses, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed August 20, 2024.  Owners may contact Temsa customer service at 1-833-628-3672.
24V549000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V551000.DESC_DEFECT: Storyteller Overland, LLC (Storyteller Overland) is recalling certain 2024 GXV Next vehicles.  The Cargo Carrying Capacity listed on the certification label is incorrect, which can allow the vehicle to be overloaded.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other than Passenger Cars."
24V551000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overloaded vehicle can increase the risk of a crash.
24V551000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Storyteller Overland will mail corrected labels to owners, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 29, 2024.  Owners may contact Storyteller Overland customer service at 1-888-999-7442.
24V551000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V564000.DESC_DEFECT: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2019-2023 LFS and 2019-2020 LFS Arctic buses.  The glazing used on the glass windows may reduce the driver's visibility.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 205, "Glazing Materials."
24V564000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Reduced visibility while driving can increase the risk of a crash.
24V564000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Nova Bus will inspect the vehicles and replace the driver shield glazing as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 10, 2024.  Owners may contact Nova Bus customer service at 1-800-350-6682.  Nova Bus's number for this recall is CR5626.
24V564000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V574000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023 Dodge Charger vehicles.  The left rear seat back may not lock in the upright position.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 207, "Seating Systems."
24V574000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat back that is not locked into position can increase the risk of injury in a crash.
24V574000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and adjust the seat back latch striker as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US LLC's number for this recall is 37B.
24V574000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V578000.DESC_DEFECT: Doosan Bobcat North America, Inc. (Doosan) is recalling certain 2023 Bobcat PA185, and C185WD0-T4F portable compressor trailers.  The wheel lug nuts may be improperly tightened.
24V578000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Improperly tightened lug nuts may allow the wheels to detach, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V578000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to tow their trailers until the remedy has been completed.  Dealers will tighten the wheel lug nuts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 7, 2024.  Owners may contact Doosan customer service at 1-800-633-5206.  Doosan's number for this recall is 5-24-10.
24V578000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V580000.COMPNAME: AIR BAGS: AIR BAG/RESTRAINT CONTROL MODULE
24V580000.DESC_DEFECT: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2021 and 2024 Titan vehicles.  The Air Bag Control Unit (ACU) may be missing a spacer, which can allow the fastener to loosen and result in an unsecured ACU.
24V580000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unsecured ACU can prevent or delay air bags from deploying as intended, increasing the risk of injury in a crash.
24V580000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the ACU, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 19, 2024.  Owners may contact Nissan customer service at 1-800-867-7669.  Nissan's number for this recall is PD120.
24V580000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V592000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:FOUNDATION COMPONENTS:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
24V592000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2024 AMG GLB 35 4MATIC vehicles.  The brake hoses on the rear axle may have been improperly routed, which could allow chafing, and result in a brake fluid leak.
24V592000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A brake fluid leak can cause a loss of brakes and increase the risk of a crash.
24V592000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and reroute the rear axle brake hoses as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 11, 2024.  Owner may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-877-496-3691.
24V592000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V599000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
24V599000.DESC_DEFECT: Blue Bird Bus Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2018-2021 Vision school buses equipped with 6.8L gasoline engines.  The coating on the fuel lines may have been improperly applied, which can result in a fuel leak.
24V599000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.
24V599000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the fuel lines as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 10, 2024.  Owners may contact Blue Bird customer service at 1-478-822-2242.
24V599000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V620000.DESC_DEFECT: Kalmar Solutions, LLC (Kalmar) is recalling certain 2016-2017 Ottawa T2 6X4 vehicles.  The air tanks have an insufficient volume of air for the brake system.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 121, "Air Brake Systems."
24V620000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Insufficient air volume can reduce braking performance and increase the risk of a crash.
24V620000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the air tank, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 24, 2024.  Owners may contact Kalmar customer service at 1-785-229-6327.
24V620000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V621000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2019-2024 Audi E-Tron and 2020-2024 Audi E-Tron Sportback vehicles.  The fastener that connects the brake pedal and the brake booster may have been improperly assembled during manufacturing, which can cause the brake pedal to detach from the brake booster.
24V621000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Brake pedal detachment can cause a loss of brake function and increase the risk of a crash.
24V621000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the brake booster, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on October 1, 2024, and November 22, 2024.  Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Volkswagen's number for this recall is 46P6.
24V621000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V628000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024 Forest River Salem, and Wildwood travel trailers.  The tire may contact the outrigger, causing the tire to fail.
24V628000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Tire failure can cause a loss of control, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V628000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace and relocate the outriggers, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 10, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-534-3167.  Forest River's number for this recall is 44-1831.
24V628000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V643000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (VW) is recalling certain 2023-2024 ID4 vehicles.  The fasteners securing the passenger frontal air bag inflator may be loose.
24V643000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly secured air bag inflator may not deploy as intended, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
24V643000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the air bag as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 10, 2024. Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298. VolkswagenÂs number for this recall is 69E8.
24V643000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V646000.DESC_DEFECT: E-One Incorporated (E-One) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Cyclone 2, 2022-2024 Cyclone N, and Typhoon N vehicles.  The engine crossmember may break, allowing the cooling fan to contact the fan shroud and become damaged.
24V646000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A damaged cooling fan can result in an engine stall while driving and increase the risk of a crash.
24V646000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the crossmember as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 24, 2024.  Owners may contact E-One customer service at 1-352-237-1122.
24V646000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V660000.DESC_DEFECT: Multiquip, Inc. (Multiquip) is recalling certain 2024 WTE5C and WTE5HP trailers.  The trailer brakes may engage unexpectedly or fail to engage when the turn signal is activated, due to wiring that is incorrectly connected between the turn signal and electric brakes.  As such, these trailers fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 105, "Hydraulic and Electric Brake Systems" and 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V660000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Brakes that fail to engage when applied or unexpected brake engagement while driving increases the risk of a crash.
24V660000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the wiring, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 22, 2024.  Owners may contact Multiquip customer service at 1-800-421-1244.
24V660000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V664000.DESC_DEFECT: Airstream, Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain 2025 Airstream Classic travel trailers.  The power hub supplying power to circuits may have an incorrect max fuse rating, which can allow the power hub to overheat.
24V664000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A power hub that overheats increases the risk of a fire.
24V664000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the power hubs, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 24, 2024.  Owners may contact Airstream customer service at support@airstream.com, 1-877-596-6505 or 1-937-596-611 ext. 7401.
24V664000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V672000.DESC_DEFECT: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley-Davidson) is recalling certain 2024 FLHX, FLHXSE, FLTRX, FLTRXSE, and FLTRXSTSE motorcycles.  The voltage regulator output wire may rub on the front corner of the crankcase, exposing the wire and causing an electrical short circuit.  A short can result in a loss of electrical power and drive power.
24V672000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The unexpected loss of drive power and the loss of electrical power while in motion increases the risk of a crash.
24V672000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and as necessary, repair the voltage regulator output wire harness, and install a secondary retention strap, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 23, 2024.  Owners may contact Harley-Davidson customer service at 1-800-258-2464.  Harley-Davidson's number for this recall is 0186.
24V672000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V678000.COMPNAME: FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
24V678000.MFGNAME: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
24V678000.DESC_DEFECT: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2024 Defender, Discovery Sport, Range Rover, Range Rover Evoque, Range Rover Velar, and Range Rover Sport vehicles.  The Near Field Sensing Module (NFSM) may overheat and cause the 3D surround camera images, including the rearview camera image, not to display.
24V678000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera image that does not display can decrease the driver's visibility, increasing the risk of injury or crash.
24V678000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the NFSM, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 24, 2024.  Owners may contact Land Rover customer service at 1-800-637-6837.  Land Rover's number for this recall is N927.
24V678000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V691000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 Tucson vehicles.  The glove box air bag warning label may be missing.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
24V691000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Without the glove box label, operators may be unaware of the increased risks that an air bag poses to an infant or child in the front seat, increasing the risk of injury to occupants.
24V691000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Hyundai will mail owners the warning labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 4, 2024.  Owners may contact Hyundai Customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 268.
24V691000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V698000.DESC_DEFECT: Motiv Power Systems, Inc. (Motiv) is recalling certain 2017-2020 E-450 and F-59 vehicles equipped with a Motiv Gen 4 EPIC and 2020-2023 F-53 and F-59 vehicles equipped with a Motiv Gen 5 EPIC powertrain.  The wiring harness may be missing a heat shrink insulator and retention clip.  The 12-volt control wires may deteriorate and loosen, causing a loss of connection to the high voltage (HV) batteries and drive power.
24V698000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
24V698000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Motiv field support technicians will inspect and correct any loose wiring, and replace damaged 12-volt control wires, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 21, 2024.  Owners may contact Motiv customer service at 1-650-458-4804.
24V698000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V709000.DESC_DEFECT: Textron Specialized Vehicles (Textron) is recalling certain 2024-2025 E-Z-GO Liberty LSV, CUSHMAN Tour LSV and CUSHMAN Hauler Pro vehicles.  The brake linkage rod may bend under applied force, impairing application of the brakes.
24V709000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Decreased braking ability increases the risk of a crash.
24V709000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the brake linkage rod, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 15, 2024.  Owners may call Textron Specialized Vehicles Customer Service at 706-799-4768.  Textron's number for this recall is FSB05-24.
24V709000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V768000.DESC_DEFECT: Multiquip, Inc. (Multiquip) is recalling certain 2010-2016 TRLR-55348, 2012-2015 TRLR-55164, and 2013 TRLR-57615 trailers.  The frame welds may crack or break, reducing the trailer's stability while being towed.
24V768000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Instability can cause a loss of control, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V768000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Multiquip will mail instructions and reinforcement plates, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 8, 2024.  Owners may contact Multiquip Customer Service at 800-421-1244.  Multiquip's number for this recall is TL20160921.
24V768000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V720000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2020-2024 Jeep Wrangler 4XE and 2022-2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee 4XE vehicles.  The high voltage battery may fail internally and lead to a vehicle fire while parked or driving.
24V720000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A vehicle fire while parked or driving can increase the risk of injury.
24V720000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: This recall is replaced by NHTSA recall number 25V741. Vehicles already repaired under this recall will need to have the new remedy completed. Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures, and not to recharge their vehicles until they are repaired.  Dealers will update the high voltage battery pack software and replace the battery pack assembly, if necessary, free of charge.  Interim notification letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, were mailed October 11, 2024.  Owner notification letters were mailed beginning December 2024.  Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  Chrysler's number for this recall is 95B.  Vehicles in this recall that were previously recalled for the same issue under NHTSA Recall 23V-787 will need to have the new remedy performed.
24V720000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V708000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Corolla Cross Hybrid and 2023-2025 Corolla Hybrid vehicles.  A software error in the skid control electronic control unit (ECU) may result in a loss of power brake assist when turning a corner.
24V708000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of power brake assist can extend the distance required to stop, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V708000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the skid control ECU software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 19, 2024. Additionally, notifications to owners of the Corolla Hybrid vehicles were mailed January 17, 2025.  Owners may contact Toyota customer service at 1-800-331-4331.  Toyota's number for this recall is 24TA11.
24V708000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V724000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2021-2022 GLE 350 and 2021-2022 GLE 450 vehicles.  The front acceleration sensor's wiring harness may be routed incorrectly, which can prevent the front air bags from deploying properly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
24V724000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that does not deploy properly can increase the risk of injury in the event of a crash.
24V724000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and reroute the wiring harness, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 1, 2024.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.  MBUSA's number for this recall is 2024100006.
24V724000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V777000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE
24V777000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021 Mach-E vehicles.  An Over-The-Air (OTA) update to the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) may result in a loss of power brake assist, ABS, Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and driver assistance features.
24V777000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of power brake assist can extend the distance required to stop the vehicle.  Additionally, a disabled antilock brake system and/or stability control system can result in a loss of vehicle control.  Either of these scenarios can increase the risk of a crash.
24V777000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the ABS calibration, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 5, 2024.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S65.
24V777000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V785000.DESC_DEFECT: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd. (Triumph) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Bonneville T100, T120, T120 Black, 2022 Triumph Street Scrambler, Street Scrambler Sandstorm, Street Twin, Street Twin Goldline, 2023-2024 Scrambler 900, and Speed Twin 900 motorcycles.  The wiring between the alternator and main harness connector may short circuit and overheat.
24V785000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overheated wiring increases the risk of a fire or crash.
24V785000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a new wire alignment clip, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 18, 2024.  Owners may contact Triumph customer service at 1-678-854-2010.  Triumph's number for this recall is SRAN 627.
24V785000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V700000.DESC_DEFECT: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2019-2020 LEAF vehicles equipped with a Level 3 quick charging port.  The lithium-ion battery may overheat during Level 3 charging.
24V700000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A quick charging battery that overheats increases the risk of a fire.
24V700000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the battery software, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed June 3, 2026. This is a phased recall. Owners may contact Nissan Customer Service at 1-800-867-7669.  Nissan's numbers for this recall are R24B2, P4A38, and P5A22.
24V700000.NOTES: Owner's may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V792000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2020-2025 Anthem, Granite, TerraPro and Pinnacle vehicles, equipped with Bendix EC80 Advanced Electronic Control Units (ECU).  Electrical noise and low signal to the power line carrier may cause the ECU to incorrectly process commands or stop working.
24V792000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Safety systems that depend on the ECU (Automatic Traction Control, ABS, Electronic Stability Control, Active Cruise Control, and Collison Mitigation System) may have diminished or lost functionality, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V792000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reprogram the ECU software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 9, 2024.  Owners may contact Mack customer service at 1-800-866-1177.  Mack's number for this recall is SC0472.
24V792000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V794000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2025 Ram 1500 vehicles.  The front wheel hub encoder rings may be damaged, which can disable the electronic stability control system.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 126, "Electronic Stability Control Systems."
24V794000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Driving with a disabled electronic stability control system can increase the risk of a crash.
24V794000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the front wheel bearing hub assembly, as necessary free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 19, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is 97B.
24V794000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V797000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Chevrolet Silverado 1500, 2500, 3500, GMC Sierra 1500, 2500, 3500, 2021 Cadillac Escalade, Escalade ESV, Chevrolet Tahoe, Suburban, GMC Yukon, and Yukon XL vehicles equipped with diesel engines.  The transmission control valve may fail and cause the rear wheels to lock-up.
24V797000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Rear wheel lock-up can increase the risk of a crash.
24V797000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install new transmission control module software, free of charge.  GM will provide a special coverage program to cover the repair of transmissions that are identified by the remedy software as containing a defective control valve.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 12, 2024.  Owners may contact GM customer service at 1-888-988-7267, Cadillac customer service at 1-800-458-8006, GMC customer service at GMC 1-800-462-8782 or Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020.  GM's number for this recall is N242454440.
24V797000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V800000.DESC_DEFECT: Orange EV (OEV) is recalling certain 2017-2024 T-Series and 2023-2024 e-TRIEVER terminal trucks.  The Emergency Response Guide (ERG), operator, maintenance, and service manuals incorrectly state that the emergency stop button in the vehicle cab will shut off and lock out the high voltage system.
24V800000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect lockout instructions can mislead the operator into thinking the high voltage system is shut down, increasing the risk of injury by electrical shock.
24V800000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: OEV will provide corrected ERG, operator, and maintenance manuals and add additional warning labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 20, 2024.  Owners may contact OEV customer service at 1-866-688-5223.  OEV's number for this recall is 2024-SRC-01.
24V800000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V836000.DESC_DEFECT: Lucid USA, Inc. (Lucid) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Air Pure rear wheel drive vehicles.  The rear subframe wiring harness may be too short, straining the electrical connection and causing power loss to the rear drive unit (RDU).
24V836000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of power to the rear drive unit can result in a complete loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V836000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Lucid will replace the wiring harness, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 18, 2024.  Owners may contact Lucid at 1-888-995-8243.  Lucid's number for this recall is SR-24-05-0.
24V836000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V805000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Ford Transit vehicles previously repaired under recall number 24V-102.  Incorrect bolts may have been used to attach the rear axle shaft, which can lead to the rear wheel locking up or separating from the axle.
24V805000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Rear wheel lock-up or separation of the wheel from the axle shaft can result in loss of vehicle control or loss of drive power.  In addition, the vehicle may roll in park if the parking brake is not applied.  Any of these scenarios can increase the risk of a crash.
24V805000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the rear axle shaft bolts, replace incorrect bolts as necessary, and fill the differential fluid if needed, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 13, 2024.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S67.
24V805000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V809000.DESC_DEFECT: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2025 Panamera, 2024 718 Cayman GT4 RS, 718 Spyder RS, and 2021-2024 911 vehicles.  The center lock wheel bolt may fracture and cause the wheel to detach.
24V809000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Wheel detachment can result in a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V809000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners should not drive their vehicles until they have been repaired.  Dealers will check the center lock wheel fastening system and replace any incorrectly manufactured parts, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on January 24, 2024.  Owners may contact Porsche customer service at 1-800-767-7243.  Porsche's number for this recall is ARC4.
24V809000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V811000.DESC_DEFECT: Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2024 Low Floor buses.  A defective welded joint may cause the wiper arm to suddenly fail.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 104, "Windshield Wiping and Washing Systems."
24V811000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Inoperative wipers can reduce the driver's ability to see out of the windshield, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V811000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Gillig will replace the wiper motor arm, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 12, 2024.  Owners may contact Gillig customer service at 1-800-735-1500.
24V811000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V839000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Chevrolet Express and GMC Savana vehicles.  Incorrect software in the transmission control module (TCM) may result in harsh shifting, reduced power, unintended deceleration, rear wheel lockup, or cause the vehicle to move in an unintended direction.
24V839000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Rear wheel lock-up or moving in an unintended direction can increase the risk of a crash.
24V839000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the transmission control module software calibration, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 9, 2024.  Owners may contact GM customer service at 1-888-988-7267, Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020 or GMC customer service at 1-800-462-8782.  GM's number for this recall is N242471620.
24V839000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V847000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Impression fifth wheel travel trailers.  The solar charge line, front LED hitch light, and the pass-thru light may have been wired to the incorrect mini breaker.
24V847000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Wires connected to the incorrect mini breaker could melt and short, increasing the risk of a fire.
24V847000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will correct the wiring, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 3, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-367-3314.  Forest River's number for this recall is 83-1862.
24V847000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V855000.DESC_DEFECT: VANCRAFT LLC (VanCraft) is recalling certain 2014-2023 SWB, LWB, 2023 LWB Pro, 2023-2024 Rover, Rover XL and Alltrek campervans.  The reinforcement hardware, mounting hardware, and seat belt anchor bolts in the rear bench seating system may fail under load.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 207, "Seating Systems" and 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies."
24V855000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Hardware failure may prevent the seat and/or seatbelt from adequately restraining an occupant, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
24V855000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install new seat belt anchor hardware, flooring reinforcement, and reinforced bench seat bars, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 19, 2024.  Owners may contact Vancraft customer service at 1-888-381-7333.
24V855000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V856000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 X3 30 xDrive vehicles.  The gas generator in the right-side head curtain air bag may have been assembled incorrectly.
24V856000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrectly assembled air bag can result in delayed activation or improper deployment of the head curtain air bag, increasing the risk of injury in a crash.
24V856000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the right-side head curtain air bag, if necessary, free of charge.  The vehicles have not been sold from dealer inventory and therefore no owner letters will be mailed.  Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417.
24V856000.NOTES: Owners may contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V862000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2024 GLC 300 4MATIC, and S 580 4MATIC vehicles.  The bolts that secure the rear axle differential to the rear axle carrier may come loose, which can result in a separation of the drive shaft from the rear axle differential.
24V862000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Driveshaft separation can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V862000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will repair the rear axle differential bolt connection as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 10, 2025.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.  MBUSA's number for this recall is 2024120005.
24V862000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V057000.DESC_DEFECT: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Niro EV and 2023 EV6 vehicles.  One of the drive shafts may have been improperly heat-treated, allowing it to break under load and resulting in a loss of drive power.
24V057000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
24V057000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the drive shaft, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 28, 2024.  Owners may contact Kia customer service at 1-800-333-4542.  Kia's number for this recall is SC295.
24V057000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V897000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee and 2021-2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee L vehicles.  An improperly secured connector for the front seat side air bags (SAB) may prevent the air bags from deploying.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 214, "Side Impact Protection."
24V897000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that does not deploy during a crash increases the risk of injury.
24V897000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers secured the connector, free of charge.  All affected vehicles have been remedied.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 17, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is B3B.
24V897000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V782000.DESC_DEFECT: Motiv Power Systems, Inc. (Motiv) is recalling certain 2021-2024 E-450 vehicles equipped with a Motiv Gen 4 EPIC powertrain.  A wire connection point could loosen, causing a loss of 12-volt control power to the high voltage (HV) batteries.
24V782000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Interruption of the 12-volt control power can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V782000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Motiv field support technicians will inspect and replace the 12-volt control cable as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 23, 2024.  Owners may contact Motiv customer service at 1-650-458-4804.
24V782000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V840000.MFGNAME: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
24V840000.DESC_DEFECT: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2014-2016 Range Rover vehicles. The front suspension upper knuckle joint may crack, which can result in suspension arm detachment.
24V840000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Suspension arm detachment can cause a loss of vehicle handling and control, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V840000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the front suspension knuckles and install a retaining bracket or replace the knuckle, as necessary, free of charge. Interim owner notification letters, informing owners of the safety risks were mailed December 18, 2024. Owners may contact Land Rover customer service at 1-800-637-6837.  Land Rover's numbers for this recall are N759 and D025. This recall has been superseded by NHTSA recall number 25V514.
24V840000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V963000.DESC_DEFECT: Orange EV is recalling certain 2023-2024 e-TRIEVER and 2018-2023 T-Series trucks built with beavertail frames.  The end of the beavertail frame may obstruct the center of the reverse lights.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V963000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Obstructed reverse lights can reduce the vehicle's visibility to pedestrians or other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V963000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to limit on-road use while operating without a trailer until the remedy is completed.  Orange EV will replace and relocate the reverse lights, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2025.  Owners may contact Orange EV customer service at 1-866-688-5223.
24V963000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V781000.DESC_DEFECT: Motiv Power Systems, Inc. (Motiv) is recalling certain 2021-2024 E-450 school buses equipped with a Motiv Gen 4 EPIC powertrain.  A wire connection point could loosen, causing a loss of 12-volt control power to the high voltage (HV) batteries.
24V781000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Interruption of the 12-volt control power can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V781000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Motiv field support technicians will inspect and replace the 12-volt control cable as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 23, 2024.  Owners may contact Motiv customer service at 1-650-458-4804.
24V781000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V906000.DESC_DEFECT: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2025 EMV vehicles.  A circuit breaker may be missing, causing the defrosting system to be inoperative.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 103, "Windshield Defrosting and Defogging Systems."
24V906000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An inoperative windshield defrosting system may decrease the driver's visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V906000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a 5A circuit breaker and a label, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 17, 2025.  Owners may contact International customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  International's number for this recall is 24518.
24V906000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V911000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2024 RAV4 and 2025 Lexus NX vehicles.  Some of the bolts that secure the front brake caliper and the wheel hub bearing may be loose, which can result in a damaged caliper brake hose or possible wheel detachment.
24V911000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A damaged brake line can cause a brake fluid leak, reducing brake performance and increasing the distance required to stop the vehicle.  Wheel detachment can result in a loss of vehicle control.  Either condition increases the risk of a crash.
24V911000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and tighten the front brake caliper mounting bracket and hub bearing bolts, as necessary, free of charge.  In addition, any damaged components will be replaced, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 23, 2025.  Owners may contact Toyota customer service at 1-800-331-4331.  Toyota's numbers for this recall are 24TA14 and 24LA08.
24V911000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V930000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vehicles.  The instrument cluster illumination may not be adjustable and appear too bright in certain lighting conditions.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."
24V930000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A display that is too bright can make it difficult for the driver to see critical safety information, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V930000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the instrument cluster software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 31, 2025.  Owners may contact DVUSA customer service at 1-877-762-8267.  DVUSA's number for this recall is VS3BELKOM.
24V930000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V025000.DESC_DEFECT: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Sportage and 2022-2024 Carnival vehicles.  The roof molding may loosen and detach.
24V025000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached roof molding can create a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V025000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the roof molding and replace or secure it as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 15, 2024.  Owners may contact Kia customer service at 1-800-333-4542.  Kia's number for this recall is SC292.
24V025000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V914000.DESC_DEFECT: McNeilus Truck & Manufacturing, Inc. (McNeilus) is recalling certain 2024 Atlantic and Zero Radius Side Loader vehicles equipped with certain Agility Fuel Solutions CNG Fuel Systems, using part number 10300466.  The manual cylinder valves may develop stress corrosion cracks in the bottom plugged port, causing a leak.
24V914000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A natural gas leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.
24V914000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Agility will replace the valves, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 17, 2025 by Agility.  Owners may contact Agility customer service at 1-844-474-7400 or McNeilus customer service at 1-888-686-7278.
24V914000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V923000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
24V923000.DESC_DEFECT: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC (Suzuki) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Burgman 400 (AN400AM3-M5) scooters.  The fuel supply hose assembly may contact the fuel vapor hose assembly, causing the fuel supply hose to become damaged and leak fuel.
24V923000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of fire.
24V923000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised that if they must ride the scooter before the safety recall repair has been completed, they should check the scooter for fuel leakage and proper operation as outlined in the "Inspection before riding" checklist in the owner's manual.  Dealers will replace the fuel supply hose assembly and fuel vapor hose assembly with new parts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 10, 2025.  Owners may contact Suzuki customer service at 1-800-934-0934.  Suzuki's number for this recall is 3A05.
24V923000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V937000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025 Chevrolet Silverado EV work trucks.  The pedestrian alert sound system may not produce sound at a sufficient volume.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 141, "Minimum Sound Requirements for Hybrid and Electric Vehicles."
24V937000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A vehicle that fails to make sufficient sound may result in pedestrians being unaware of an approaching vehicle, increasing the risk of injury.
24V937000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the software in the body control module (BCM), free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 22, 2025.  Owners may contact Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020.  GM's number for this recall is N242483530.
24V937000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V945000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:OIL/LUBRICATION:PIPES, HOSES, AND FITTINGS
24V945000.DESC_DEFECT: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2024 Revuelto vehicles.  The oil circuit connection flange screws may have been improperly tightened during assembly, which could cause the oil line to leak.
24V945000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An oil leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
24V945000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will Inspect and repair the flange screws as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 31, 2025.  Owners may contact Automobili Lamborghini customer service at 1-866-681-6276.  Automobili Lamborghini's number for this recall is L74X-R.03.24.
24V945000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V962000.DESC_DEFECT: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2024-2025 EV9 vehicles.  The second- and third-row seat mounting bolts may be missing.
24V962000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Seats without mounting bolts may not properly restrain an occupant, increasing the risk of injury.
24V962000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and install mounting bolts as necessary free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 24, 2025.  Owners may contact Kia customer service at 1-800-333-4542.  Kia's number for this recall is SC329.
24V962000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V969000.DESC_DEFECT: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2025 Kicks vehicles.  The "Shift-to-Park" warning may not activate as intended when the vehicle is shut off and still in a gear other than "Park."  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 114, "Theft Protection and Rollaway Prevention."
24V969000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: When the vehicle is not in "Park" and the ignition is shut off, the vehicle could move unexpectedly, increasing the risk of a vehicle rollaway and crash.
24V969000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reconfigure the body control module (BCM) to activate the "Shift-to-Park" warning, free of charge.  Some owner notification letters were mailed January 29, 2025. The remaining owner notification letters will be mailed at a future date, anticipated, May 7, 2025.  Owners may contact Nissan customer service at 1-800-867-7669.  Nissan's number for this recall is PMA42.
24V969000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V964000.DESC_DEFECT: Orange EV (OEV) is recalling certain 2023-2024 HUSK-e, 2023-2025 e-TRIEVERs, and 2018-2023 T-Series trucks built with frame extenders.  The frame extenders obstruct the rear turn signals, reverse, brake, and taillights.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V964000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Obstructed rear lights can reduce the vehicle's visibility to pedestrians or other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V964000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to limit on-road use while operating without a trailer until the remedy is completed. OEV will relocate the rear taillights and replace the original with combination lights, free of charge. Interim owner notification letters explaining the safety risk were mailed February 21, 2025.  A second notice will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact OEV customer service at 1-866-688-5223.
24V964000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V459000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Cadillac XT5 and 2024-2025 Cadillac XT6 vehicles.  The instrument panel may not illuminate when the hazard warning lights, high beams, or turn signals are activated.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 101, "Controls and Displays" and 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Assoc. Equipment."
24V459000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Without the illuminated reminder, the driver could fail to turn off the lights when no longer needed.  Hazard warning lights, high beams, or turn signals that remain activated unintentionally can confuse other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V459000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the instrument panel software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 13, 2024.  Owners may contact Cadillac's customer service at 1-800-458-8006.  GM's number for this recall is N242447940.
24V459000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V647000.DESC_DEFECT: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova) is recalling certain 2010-2020 LFS Artic and 2012-2024 LFS vehicles.  The driver's seat belt may not retract properly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies."
24V647000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat belt that does not retract properly may result in a loose seat belt, which can increase the risk of injury in a crash.
24V647000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Nova Bus will install additional seat stoppers to the driver's rear partition, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed July 4, 2025. Nova's number for this recall is CR5635.  This recall expands and replaces previous recall number 23V-350.  Vehicles that were previously recalled under 23V-350 will need to have the new remedy completed.
24V647000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V712000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:OIL/LUBRICATION:PIPES, HOSES, AND FITTINGS
24V712000.DESC_DEFECT: Aston Martin The Americas (Aston Martin) is recalling certain 2024-2025 DBX707, 2024-2025 DB12, and 2025 Vantage vehicles.  The engine oil cooler hose may split during vehicle operation, resulting in a loss of oil and oil pressure.
24V712000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden loss of oil and oil pressure could lead to the engine stalling or seizing, increasing the risk of a crash or fire.
24V712000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the hoses, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 13, 2024.  Owners may contact Aston Martin customer service at 1-888-923-9988.  Aston Martin's number for this recall is RA-03-1973.
24V712000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V538000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2019-2021 Pacifica Plug-In Hybrid Electric (PHEV) vehicles.  The battery pack may cause a vehicle fire when parked, even with the ignition in the "Off" position.
24V538000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A vehicle fire increases the risk of injury.
24V538000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to charge their vehicles, and to park outside and away from structures, until they are repaired.  Dealers will update the high voltage battery pack control module (BPCM) software.  In addition, dealers will inspect and if necessary, replace the battery pack assembly.  Repairs will be performed free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 6, 2025.  Owners may contact FCA US LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US LLC's number for this recall is 72B.  This recall is an expansion of NHTSA recall number 22V-077.
24V538000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V027000.DESC_DEFECT: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2024 IC EV school buses.  The high voltage positive cables that connect the battery packs to the manual service disconnects (MSD) may have been mislabeled.
24V027000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A mislabeled electrical cable may be mistaken for a de-energized cable by a technician or first responder, increasing the risk of electrical shock and injury.
24V027000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the high voltage cables and add white high voltage tape as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 05, 2024.  Owners may contact Navistar customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  Navistar's number for this recall is 24502.
24V027000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V072000.MFGNAME: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc.
24V072000.DESC_DEFECT: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc. (MFTA) is recalling certain 2024 FEC7K and FEC9K vehicles.  Due to a control unit counter error, the vehicle may shut down unexpectedly, which can result in a loss of drive power.
24V072000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power can increase the risk of a crash.
24V072000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reprogram vehicle control unit and instrument panel control unit, free of charge.  None of the affected vehicles have been sold, so therefore no owner notification letters will be sent.  Owners may contact MFTA customer service at 1-877-771-0707.  MFTA's number for this recall is C10126.
24V072000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V005000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2020-2024 Coachmen Galleria motorhomes.  The battery boost wiring may become damaged, resulting in an electrical short circuit and causing a loss of power steering.
24V005000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of power steering increases the risk of a crash.
24V005000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will relocate the wiring to a different lug, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 13, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 1-574-825-6319.  Forest River's number for this recall is 225-1716.
24V005000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V008000.DESC_DEFECT: PL Custom Emergency Vehicles (PL Customs) is recalling certain 2020-2024 Ambulance & Rescue Vehicle Type 1 and Type 3 vehicles.  In the event of a short circuit or wiring failure, the firmware in the vehicle multiplex system may fail to shut off the output pin, resulting in overloaded electrical circuits.
24V008000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overloaded electrical circuits can overheat, increasing the risk of fire.
24V008000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the firmware, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 25, 2024.  Owners may contact PL Custom customer service at 1-732-223-1411.
24V008000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V030000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024 Shasta Oasis travel trailers.  The side marker lights may not reflect light as intended, which can make it difficult for other drivers to see the trailer.  As such, these trailers fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V030000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Non-reflective side marker lights can reduce the trailer's visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V030000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the marker lights, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 24, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 1-574-821-1311.  Forest River's number for this recall is 53-1724.
24V030000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V045000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024 Coachmen Clipper and Viking Travel Trailers.  The tail light bezel may not have been installed on the vehicle.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V045000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A missing tail light bezel may reduce visibility of the trailer, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V045000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install the tail light bezel, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed March 6, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 1-269-467-4600.  Forest River's number for this recall is 120-1729.
24V045000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V061000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Entegra Anthem, Aspire, Cornerstone, and Reatta XL motorhomes.  The pedestal mounting plate on the passenger's seat may be improperly welded, causing the plate to separate and the seat assembly to loosen or detach.  As such, these seat assemblies fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 207, "Seating Systems" and number 210, "Seat belt assembly anchorages."
24V061000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose or detached seat assembly increases the risk of injury.
24V061000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect for a missing weld and replace the pedestal as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 11, 2024.  Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267.  Jayco's number for this recall is 9903602.
24V061000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V062000.DESC_DEFECT: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Allegro Bay motorhomes.  The standard house batteries may shift position during travel, which can cause the battery terminals to contact the steel hold-down bar.
24V062000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Battery terminals that contact the steel hold-down bar can cause electrical arcing and increase the risk of a fire.
24V062000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a new battery hold-down bar and angle brackets, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 29, 2024.  Owners may contact Tiffin customer service at 1-256-356-8661.  Tiffin's number for this recall is TIF-137.
24V062000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V077000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:HARD PARTS INTERNAL/MECHANICAL
24V077000.DESC_DEFECT: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2024 Telluride vehicles.  The engine valve springs may break while driving, which can result in a loss of drive power and possibly create a hole in the engine block.
24V077000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.  A hole in the engine block increases the risk of a fire.
24V077000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the engine sub-assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 5, 2024.  Owners may contact Kia customer service at 1-800-333-4542.  Kia's number for this recall is SC296.
24V077000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V078000.DESC_DEFECT: Blue Bird Body Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2020-2024 Vision 2020-2023 All American school buses.  The convertible seats may have been incorrectly installed, which can result in an unsecured seat.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."
24V078000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unsecured seat may not adequately restrain an occupant, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
24V078000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the seat, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 04, 2024.  Owners may contact Blue Bird customer service at 1-478-822-2242.  Blue Bird's number for this recall is R24CM-SB.
24V078000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V088000.DESC_DEFECT: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2024 International HX, LT, RH and 2024-2025 International HV, MV trucks and 2024 IC Bus CE commercial buses.  The steering gear assemblies may have been assembled incorrectly with fewer recirculating balls than are required, which may result in a loss of steering control.
24V088000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of steering control increases the risk of a crash.
24V088000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the defective gears, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 30, 2024.  Owners may contact Navistar's customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  Navistar's number for this recall is 24503.
24V088000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V089000.DESC_DEFECT: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2024 IC Bus CE school buses.  The steering gear assemblies may have been assembled incorrectly with fewer recirculating balls than are required, which may result in a loss of steering control.
24V089000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of steering control increases the risk of a crash.
24V089000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the defective gears, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 30, 2024.  Owners may contact Navistar's customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  Navistar's number for this recall is 24504.
24V089000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V096000.DESC_DEFECT: Bugatti is recalling certain 2016-2023 Bugatti Chiron vehicles.  The audible chime may not activate when the vehicle starts, and the driver has not buckled their seat belt.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
24V096000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The driver may be unaware that their seat belt is not fastened, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
24V096000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the instrument cluster software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed on May 1, 2024. Owners may contact Bugatti customer service at 1-703-826-7545.  Bugatti's number for this recall is BUGCR036.
24V096000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V102000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Ford Transit vehicles.  An inadequate amount of rear axle lubricant may cause rear axle tail bearing damage and seizure, which can result in wheel lock-up or driveshaft separation.
24V102000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Wheel lock-up or driveshaft separation can result in a loss of drive power.  A disconnected driveshaft can also result in a roll away when the vehicle is in park without the parking brake applied.  Any of these scenarios can increase the risk of a crash.
24V102000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the rear axle, and replace the axle bearings or axle assembly as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 4, 2024.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S05.
24V102000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V143000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023-2024 F-650 and F-750 vehicles.  The parking brake may malfunction and allow the lever to be released without pressing the release button.
24V143000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A parking brake that is released unexpectedly may result in a vehicle roll away, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
24V143000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the parking brake handle assembly.  Owner notification letters were mailed on June 17, 2024.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S09.
24V143000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V105000.DESC_DEFECT: Belmont Trailers LLC (Belmont) is recalling certain 2023-2024 FlatTrak trailers.  The spindle mount may crack, resulting in the spindle mount and spindle arm separating.
