24V258000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Weldon will update the firmware, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 29, 2024.  Owners may contact Akron Brass customer service at 1-800-228-1161 or Hi-Tech customer service at 1-209-847-3042.
24V258000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V232000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2024-2025 LR natural gas vehicles.  The methane detector may be inoperative due to a missing fuse.
24V232000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An inoperative methane detector can fail to detect a gas leak, increasing the risk of a fire or injury.
24V232000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a fuse, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 10, 2024.  Owners may contact Mack customer service at 1-800-866-1177.  Mack's number for this recall is SC0461.
24V232000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V236000.DESC_DEFECT: Heartland Recreational Vehicles, LLC (Heartland) is recalling certain 2023 Elk Ridge, Lithium, 2024 Eddie Bauer, Corterra, 2023-2024 Big Country, Big Horn, South Fork, Fuel, Gravity, Mallard, North Trail, Sundance, Milestone, Pioneer, Prowler, Torque, and Trail Runner fifth wheels and travel trailers.  The LED backlight circuit board in the cooktop range may fail, causing the board to overheat.
24V236000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A circuit board that overheats increases the risk of a fire.
24V236000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will disconnect and cut the circuit powering the LED backlights and terminate the wiring, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 9, 2024.  Owners may contact Heartland customer service at 1-877-262-8032.
24V236000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V238000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024 Pacifica and Voyager vehicles.  The windshield may not have been properly bonded to the vehicle, allowing it to detach during a crash.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 212, "Windshield Mounting."
24V238000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A windshield that detaches from the vehicle during a crash can increase the risk of injury.
24V238000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the windshield, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 30, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is 25B.
24V238000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V243000.DESC_DEFECT: Big Tex Trailer Manufacturing, Inc. (Big Tex Trailer) is recalling certain 2024 25GN, 25PH, 3XGN, and 3XPH trailers.  The oil seals may have been improperly installed, which can cause oil to leak onto the brake system.
24V243000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Oil leaking onto brake components can reduce braking ability and increase the risk of a crash.
24V243000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the hub seals as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed May 24, 2024.  Owners may contact Big Tex Trailer customer service at 1-800-594-5637.
24V243000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V244000.DESC_DEFECT: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2023 Forte vehicles.  The right front lower control arm may have been improperly welded, which can cause it to fail.
24V244000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Front lower control arm failure can cause a sudden loss of steering control, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V244000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until the repair has been performed.  Dealers will replace the right front lower control arm, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 17, 2024.  Owners may contact Kia customer service at 1-800-333-4542.  Kia's number for this recall is SC306.  This recall expands previous NHTSA recall number 23V-649.
24V244000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V248000.DESC_DEFECT: Aston Martin The Americas (Aston Martin) is recalling certain 2021 DBX vehicles.  The fasteners for the front propeller shaft and front differential may be loose, which can result in a loss of front wheel drive or an engine stall.
24V248000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of front wheel drive or an engine stall can increase the risk of a crash.
24V248000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the fasteners, and tighten them if necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 16, 2024.  Owners may contact Aston Martin customer service at 1-888-923-9988.  Aston Martin's number for this recall is RA-51-1928.
24V248000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V261000.DESC_DEFECT: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2022-2023 DC (Legend) dump trucks. The upper hoist cylinder mounting pin may fail.
24V261000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A pin failure can allow the hoist to fall, increasing the risk of injury. In addition, the hoist cylinder can disconnect from the vehicle, becoming a road hazard and increasing the risk of a crash.
24V261000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect, repair, or replace the pin as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed February 24, 2026. Owners may contact Autocar customer service at 1-888-218-3611. Autocar's number for this recall is DC-2403.
24V261000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V265000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024 Cardinal and Wildcat Fifth Wheels trailers.  The operator may utilize the rear towing hitch without locking the turning point fifth wheel hitch into the "Conventional Transport" position.
24V265000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Towing while in a different position can cause the upper front structure to break and the pin box to separate from the vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V265000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a warning label to the hitch and rear wall of the vehicle, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 6, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 1-574-296-7700.  Forest River's number for this recall is 15-1755.
24V265000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V270000.DESC_DEFECT: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A. (KMC) is recalling certain 2024 ZR900C, ZR900E and ZR900N (Z900RS ABS, Z900RS CAFE ABS, and Z900RS SE ABS) motorcycles.  Due to an improper manufacturing process during installation of the sidewall rubber of the tire, the front tire may blister on the inner surface.  As such, these motorcycles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 119, "New Pneumatic Tires-Other Than Passenger Car."
24V270000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A tire with inner wall blistering can fail, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V270000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the front tires, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 13, 2024.  Owners may contact KMC customer service at 1-866-802-9381.  KMC's number for this recall is DAL491A.
24V270000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V294000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2017-2019 Transit Connect vehicles.  An improper bond may exist between the panoramic roof and the vehicle body, which can result in the panel detaching from the vehicle.
24V294000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A roof panel that detaches while driving can create a road hazard and increase the risk of a crash.
24V294000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will remove, clean, and reinstall the panoramic roof panel, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 4, 2024.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S29.
24V294000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V312000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain Jayco Swift, Swift LI, Entegra Coach Ethos, and Ethos LI motorhomes.  The driver seat belt warning light and audible chime may not activate as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
24V312000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A malfunctioning seat belt warning system can result in improper seat belt use, increasing the risk of injury in a crash.
24V312000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: FCA dealers will inspect and replace the driver seat belt buckle as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 14, 2024.  Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267.
24V312000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V364000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
24V364000.MFGNAME: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
24V364000.DESC_DEFECT: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2018-2022 Range Rover Sport vehicles equipped with a Surround Camera System.  Water may enter into the rearview camera, which can cause the rearview camera image not to appear on the display or display a distorted image.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
24V364000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera image that does not display can decrease the driver's visibility, increasing the risk of injury or crash.
24V364000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the rearview camera for damage.  If no damage is found, the camera will be fitted with a new seal.  If damage is found, the camera will be replaced and calibrated.  Repairs will be performed free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 18, 2024.  Owners may contact Land Rover customer service at 1-800-637-6837.  Land Rover's number for this recall is N901.  These vehicles were previously recalled under 24V-023 for this same issue and will need to have the new remedy completed.
24V364000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V463000.DESC_DEFECT: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2025 IC Bus CE school buses.  Tie rod assemblies may contain ball studs that may have been incorrectly heat-treated, which can cause them to break, and possibly result in tie rod failure.
24V463000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Tie rod failure can cause a loss of vehicle steering control and increase the risk of a crash.
24V463000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the tie rod ends and realign the front axle, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 29, 2024.  Owners may contact Navistar customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  Navistar's number for this recall is 24510.
24V463000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V449000.DESC_DEFECT: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2021 LFS buses.  The welds may fail, allowing the rotary plate to separate from the door operator.
24V449000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The separation can allow the passenger door to open while the bus is in motion, increasing the risk of injury.
24V449000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Nova Bus will replace the door operator assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 12, 2024.  Owners may contact Nova Bus customer service at 1-800-350-6682.  Nova Bus's number for this recall is CR5612.
24V449000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V454000.DESC_DEFECT: Entrans International, LLC (Entrans) is recalling certain 2017 Polar Tank ARJH trailers.  The barrel of the tank may be welded improperly, which can result in a leak.
24V454000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A tank that leaks can create a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V454000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Entrans will repair the seams, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 12, 2024.  Owners may contact Entrans customer service at 1-320-746-2255.
24V454000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V471000.DESC_DEFECT: Oshkosh Corporation (Oshkosh) is recalling certain Oshkosh Defense NGDV ICE vehicles.  During supplier testing, the terminals in a wiring harness connector may have been deformed, possibly resulting in an insufficient electrical connection that can cause the air bags not to deploy as intended.
24V471000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Air bags that do not deploy as intended can increase the risk of injury in a crash.
24V471000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Oshkosh will inspect and replace the electrical connectors, or replace the wiring harness as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed July 9, 2024.  Owners may contact Oshkosh's customer service at 1-800-392-9921.  Oshkosh's number for this recall is NGDV_TSB-001.
24V471000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V485000.DESC_DEFECT: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2008-2024 G5, 2008-2015 MBII, and 2015-2023 T-Series transit buses.  The rear emergency door exterior handle may unexpectedly break under applied force.
24V485000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: In the event of an emergency, a broken door handle can prevent or delay emergency responders from entering the vehicle, increasing the risk of injury.
24V485000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the rear emergency door exterior handle, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2024.  Owners may contact Micro Bird customer service at 1-819-477-2012.  Micro Bird's number for this recall is 24-109-EUC.
24V485000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V490000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Salem, and Wildwood travel trailers.  The affected vehicles may not have a secondary emergency exit installed.
24V490000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: In the event of an emergency, passengers may not be able to exit the vehicle, increasing the risk of injury.
24V490000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install an emergency exit window, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 26, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 574-534-3167.  Forest River's number for this recall is 72-1805.
24V490000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V493000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Ford Mustang vehicles.  The secondary steering torque sensor may not be calibrated properly, which can cause the steering wheel to turn side to side against the driver's intentions.
24V493000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A steering wheel that turns unintentionally can cause a loss of vehicle control and increase the risk of a crash.
24V493000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the power steering control module (PSCM) software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on October 11, 2024.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S44.
24V493000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V497000.DESC_DEFECT: Lucid USA, Inc. (Lucid) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Air vehicles.  When a hardware communication fault is detected, the High Voltage Interlock (HVIL) software could disconnect the high voltage contactors while the vehicle is in motion, causing a loss of drive power.
24V497000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
24V497000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Lucid released an over-the-air (OTA) software update June 24, 2024, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 5, 2024.  Owners may contact Lucid customer service at 1-888-995-8243.  Lucid's number for this recall is SR-24-03-0.
24V497000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V514000.DESC_DEFECT: Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Low Floor transit buses.  The steering spline shaft fasteners may have been improperly tightened, allowing the steering spline shaft to loosen.
24V514000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose steering shaft can cause a complete loss of steering control, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V514000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Gillig will tighten the fasteners, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 13, 2024.  Owners may contact Gillig customer service at 1-510-264-5073 or 1-800-735-1500.
24V514000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V532000.DESC_DEFECT: Triple E Recreational Vehicles (Triple E) is recalling certain 2020-2024 Wonder W24RL, W24FTB, W24MBL, and W24MB motorhomes.  The floor structure to the crossmember may be inadequately secured, causing the generator to fall.
24V532000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A generator that falls increases the risk of injury or crash.
24V532000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will properly secure the floor structure to the crossmember, free of charge.  Owner letters were mailed August 16, 2024.  Owners may contact Triple E customer service at 1-204-325-4361.  Triple E's number for this recall is CA#10556-1.
24V532000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V535000.DESC_DEFECT: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC (Suzuki) is recalling certain 2023-2024 DL800DE motorcycles.  The rear tire may crack or deform, resulting in tire tread separation.
24V535000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Tread separation may cause a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V535000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to ride their motorcycles until the remedy has been completed.  Dealers will replace the rear tire, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 20, 2024.  Owners may contact Suzuki customer service at 1-714- 572-1490.  Suzuki's number for this recall is 3A03.
24V535000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V543000.DESC_DEFECT: Blue Bird Bus Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2019-2023 Vision, All American Front Engine, and All American Rear Engine school buses.  An exterior roof joint may have been manufactured with insufficient strength that can allow the roof panels to separate in a crash.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 221, "School Bus Body Joint Strength."
24V543000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Roof panels that separate during a crash can increase the risk of injury.
24V543000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the roof panel joints and install additional rivets as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 17, 2024.  Owners may contact Blue Bird customer service at 1-478-822-2242.
24V543000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.Please be reminded of the following requirements:You are required to submit a draft owner notification letter to this office no less than five days prior to mailing it to the customers.Also, copies of all notices, bulletins, dealer notifications, and other communications that relate to this recall, including a copy of the final owner notification letter and any subsequent owner follow-up notification letter(s), are required to be submitted to this office no later than 5 days after they are originally sent (if they are sent to more than one manufacturer, distributor, dealer, or purchaser/owner).Under 49 U.S.C. Â§ 30112(a), it is illegal for anyone, including a manufacturer, distributor, dealer, or retailer to sell an item of equipment or vehicle that fails to comply with all applicable Federal motor vehicle safety standards.As stated in 49 U.S.C. Â§ 30118(f), submission of eight consecutive quarterly reports followed by three annual reports is required. As described in 573.7, submission of the first of eight consecutive quarterly status reports is required within one month after the close of the calendar quarter in which notification to purchasers occurs. Therefore, the first quarterly report will be due on, or before, 30 days after the close of the calendar quarter. The first of three consecutive annual status reports will be due on, or before, 1 year after the eighth quarterly report was submitted.

24V554000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Model 3, Model S, Model X, and 2020-2024 Model Y vehicles.  The hood latch assembly may fail to detect an unlatched hood condition after the hood has been opened.
24V554000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unlatched hood can fully open, obstructing the driver's view and increasing the risk of a crash.
24V554000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla has released an over-the-air (OTA) software update, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 24, 2024.  Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752.  Tesla's number for this recall is SB-24-00-012.
24V554000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V559000.DESC_DEFECT: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2019-2021 LFS and 2019 LFS Artic buses.  The brake chamber on the rear axle may have been improperly manufactured, which can result in an air leak.
24V559000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A brake chamber air leak may cause the brakes to engage unexpectedly, which can overheat the brakes and increase the risk of a fire.  Additionally, unexpected braking can increase the risk of a crash.
24V559000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Nova Bus will inspect and replace the brake chamber as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 02, 2024.  Owners may contact Nova Bus customer service at 1-800-350-6682.  Nova Bus's number for this recall is CR5620.
24V559000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V562000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2010-2013 Genesis Coupe vehicles.  A return spring in the ignition lock switch may fracture, which can result in unintended vehicle movement when the vehicle is started in gear, without the parking brake applied.
24V562000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Unintended vehicle movement can increase the risk of a crash.
24V562000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the ignition lock switch, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 4, 2024.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 266.
24V562000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V566000.DESC_DEFECT: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Phaeton, Allegro Bus, and Zephyr motorhomes.  The PowerGlide chassis controller may have insufficient circuit protection, which can result in a blown fuse and cause an engine shutdown.
24V566000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine shutdown increases the risk of a crash.
24V566000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install circuit protection, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 13, 2024.  Owners may contact Tiffin customer service at 1-256-356-8661.  Tiffin's number for this recall is TIF-141.
24V566000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V567000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Anthem, Granite, and Pinnacle vehicles equipped with RollTek driver's seat assemblies.  The seat pedestal and seat belt attachment may have been improperly tightened.
24V567000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly tightened seat pedestal and seat belt attachment may not restrain the occupant as intended, increasing their risk of injury during a crash.
24V567000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace and tighten the seat pedestal and seat belt attachment bolts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 16, 2024.  Owners may contact Mack customer service at 1-800-866-1177.  Mack's number for this recall is SC0469.
24V567000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V572000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021 Jeep Wrangler and Jeep Gladiator vehicles that were previously remedied under NHTSA recall number 23V-116.  The software for the powertrain control module may cause an engine stall, which can result in a loss of drive power.
24V572000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
24V572000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the powertrain control module software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US LLC's number for this recall is 92B.  Vehicles previously repaired under recall 23V-116 will need to have the new remedy completed.
24V572000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V573000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023 Dodge Challenger vehicles.  The left rear seat back may not lock in the upright position.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 207, "Seating Systems."
24V573000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat back that is not locked into position can increase the risk of injury in a crash.
24V573000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and adjust the seat back latch striker as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US LLC's number for this recall is 38B.
24V573000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V575000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2024 Cadillac XT4 and Chevrolet Malibu vehicles.  The vehicles may have the wrong owner's manual in the glove box.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 225, "Child Restraint Anchorage Systems."
24V575000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The wrong owner's manual may contain inaccurate information about vehicle functions and other safety relevant information, which could lead to improper operation of the vehicle and increase the risk of a crash or injury.
24V575000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will provide owners with the correct manual, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 26, 2024.  Owners may contact Cadillac's customer service at 1-800-458-8006 and Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020.  GM's number for this recall is N242454040.
24V575000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V581000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Freelander motorhomes.  The Federal Placard indicates 30 seat-belted positions in the rear, when the correct number of belted positions is 3.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other than Passenger Cars" and 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
24V581000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect seating capacity information may lead to overloading the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V581000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Forest River will mail owners new Federal Placards, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 8, 2024.  Owners may contact customer service at 1-574-825-8602.  Forest River's number for this recall is 210-1824.
24V581000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V586000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee L vehicles.Â  The child seat tether welds on the second-row seat back frame may be insufficient, which can reduce the seat's ability to properly restrain a child during a crash.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 225, "Child Restraint Anchorage Systems."
24V586000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A child that is not properly restrained during a crash can have an increased risk of injury.
24V586000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reinforce the child seat tether welds on the seat back frame, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 3, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is 85B.
24V586000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V593000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 Mustang vehicles.  The rear suspension knuckles may have a casting defect that causes them to fail, which can result in a loss of vehicle handling and steering control.
24V593000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of vehicle handling and steering control increases the risk of a crash.
24V593000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the rear suspension knuckle as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 26, 2024.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S49.
24V593000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V596000.DESC_DEFECT: Triple E Recreational Vehicles (Triple E) is recalling certain 2024 Triple E Unity U24RL, U24TB, U24FX, and U24MBL motorhomes.  The RVMP generator propane hose may be incorrectly routed too close to the generator exhaust, which can result in a fuel leak.
24V596000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A propane leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.
24V596000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reroute the propane line and install a heat shield, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 21, 2024.  Owners may contact Triple E customer service at 1-204-325-4361.  Triple E's number for this recall is CA#10584-1.
24V596000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V598000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Explorer vehicles equipped with the Police Interceptor Utility Package.  In the event of an engine failure, engine oil and fuel vapor may be released into the engine compartment and accumulate near ignition sources such as hot engine or exhaust components, possibly resulting in an engine compartment fire.
24V598000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine compartment fire increases the risk of injury.
24V598000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park and shut off the engine as promptly as possible upon hearing unexpected engine noises, or after experiencing an unexpected engine power reduction, or seeing smoke from the engine compartment.  Dealers will update the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) software.  In addition, dealers will inspect for connecting rod bearing failure and if necessary, replace the engine long block.  All inspections and repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S52.
24V598000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V605000.DESC_DEFECT: Heartland Recreational Vehicles (Heartland) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Torque travel trailers, equipped with optional Onan 5.5 generators.  These generators may not be properly vented and allow the generator to overheat or prevent exhaust gas from escaping properly.
24V605000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A generator that overheats increases the risk of fire.  In addition, trapped exhaust gases inside the trailer can increase the risk of injury.
24V605000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will correctly route the generator venting, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 18, 2024.  Owners may contact Heartland customer service at 1-877-262-8032.
24V605000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V634000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023 Lincoln Corsair, 2023-2024 Escape, 2024 Mustang, and 2025 Explorer vehicles.  The fuel injectors may have been assembled without O-ring support discs, which can result in a fuel leak.
24V634000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.
24V634000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install new fuel injector O-rings and O-ring support discs, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on October 7, 2024.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S54.
24V634000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V648000.DESC_DEFECT: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova) is recalling certain 2023 LFS Artic and 2023-2024 LFS vehicles.  The instrument panel may fail to display the speedometer or incorrectly display warning lights, due to defective firmware.  In addition, the firmware may result in a loss of drive power.Â Â As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 101, "Control and Displays."
24V648000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument panel that fails to show critical safety information, such as the speedometer or warning lights, can increase the risk of a crash.  A loss of drive power also increases the risk of a crash.
24V648000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Novas Bus will update the instrument panel firmware, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 18, 2024.  Owners may contact Nova customer service at 1-800-350-6682.  Nova's number for this recall is CR5636.
24V648000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V669000.DESC_DEFECT: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Allegro Bay motorhomes.  The subframe truss may collapse and pinch the electrical wiring, causing an electrical arc.
24V669000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Electrical arcing increases the risk of a fire.
24V669000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reinforce the trusses, and repair damage as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 8, 2024.  Owners may contact Tiffin customer service at 1-256-356-8661.  Tiffin's number for this recall is TIF-142.
24V669000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V649000.DESC_DEFECT: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2024 Mazda 3, CX-30, and 2025 CX-50 vehicles.  A malfunction in the forward sensing camera (FSC) may prevent the automatic emergency braking system and the lane-keep assist system from functioning.  In addition, the headlights will not automatically adjust from high beams to low beams as intended.
24V649000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Automatic braking, steering assist, and headlight control systems that do not function as intended can increase the risk of a crash.
24V649000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the forward sensing camera as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 24, 2024.  Owners may contact Mazda customer service at 1-800-222-5500, Option 6.  Mazda's number for this recall is 6824H.
24V649000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V659000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2019-2023 G 550 and 2019-2022 G63 AMG vehicles that received a replacement door latch during a service visit or prior recall repair.  Components within the right-side rear door latch may prevent the rear doors from latching or opening properly.
24V659000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The rear door may appear closed even when the latch is not fully engaged, allowing the door to open while driving and increasing the risk of injury or a crash.  Damaged latch components may prevent the rear door from being opened while inside the vehicle, increasing the risk of injury.
24V659000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the right-side rear door latches, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 11, 2024.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.  Vehicles in this recall that were previously repaired under recall 21V-353 will need to have the new remedy completed.
24V659000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V663000.DESC_DEFECT: Alliance RV, LLC is recalling certain 2024-2025 Alliance Valor 31T13 travel trailers.  The front bathroom may be missing the Ground Fault Interrupter (GFI) and may not be connected to the GFI circuit.
24V663000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A bathroom electrical outlet that is missing GFI protection can result in electrical shock, increasing the risk of injury.
24V663000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the standard receptacle with a GFI receptacle, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed in October 18, 2024.  Owners may contact Alliance customer service at 1-574-218-7165.
24V663000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V688000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2024 CLE 300 Convertible, CLE 300 Coupe, CLE 450 Convertible, CLE 450 Coupe, E 350, E 450 Station Wagon, E 450, and AMG CLE 53 Coupe vehicles.  A software error in the MBUX multimedia system may deactivate certain vehicle systems, including the cross-traffic alert that applies the brakes automatically in certain driving situations.
24V688000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An automatic emergency braking system that does not function as intended can increase the risk of a crash.
24V688000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the MBUX multimedia system software and parking control unit settings, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 1, 2024. This is a phased recall, phase 1 owner letters will be mailed November 12, 2024, November 1, 2024, and January 14, 2025.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.
24V688000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V680000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:ENGINE CONTROL MODULE (ECU/ECM):SOFTWARE
24V680000.DESC_DEFECT: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A. (KMC) is recalling certain 2024 Z7 Hybrid ABS and Ninja 7 Hybrid ABS motorcycles.  The electronic control unit (ECU) may cause the transmission to shift into neutral when the operator attempts to shift from first to second gear.
24V680000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The unintended shift to neutral can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V680000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reprogram the ECM software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 27, 2024.  Owners may contact KMC customer service at 1-866-802-9381.  KMC's number for this recall is MC24-13.
24V680000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V697000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America (BMW) is recalling certain 2023-2024 X1, 2024-2025 X5, 2025 X6, 2023-2025 X7, 740i, 760i, 2024 XM, 530i, 540i, i7, 750e, X2, 2024-2025 i5, 2024 Rolls Royce Spectre, 2025 MINI Countryman S ALL4, JCW Countryman ALL4, and 2025 MINI Hardtop 2 Door (Cooper, Cooper S) vehicles.  Please refer to the recall report for the complete list of models.  The welds in the servomotor of the integrated brake control module may break, causing a loss of power brake assist and rear brake function.  In addition, the Antilock Brake System (ABS) and Dynamic Stability Control (DSC) system may not function.
24V697000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of brake power assist or rear brake function can result in extended stopping distance.  A loss of ABS or DSC can cause a loss of vehicle handling and control.  Either of these scenarios can increase the risk of a crash.
24V697000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the integrated brake system, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 13, 2024.  Owners can contact BMW Customer Service at 1-800-525-7417.
24V697000.NOTES: Owner's may contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V714000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America (BMW) is recalling certain 2024-2025 530i xDrive, 540i xDrive, 2024-2025 i5 eDrive40, i5 M60 xDrive, 2025 i5 xDrive40, 2024 740i xDrive, 760i xDrive, 750e xDrive, i7 eDrive50, i7 xDrive60, and i7 M70 xDrive vehicles.  The steering spindle may break requiring a greater steering effort to control the vehicle.
24V714000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden increase in required steering effort increases the risk of a crash.
24V714000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the steering spindle's double universal joint, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 22, 2024.  Owners may contact BMW Customer Service at 1-800-525-7417.
24V714000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V701000.DESC_DEFECT: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2024 Huracan EVO Spyder vehicles.  The right front frame bracket may have been installed on the wrong side of the vehicle.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
24V701000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: In the event of a crash, an incorrectly installed frame bracket may not provide adequate protection to an unbelted passenger, increasing the risk of injury.
24V701000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and reassemble the bracket as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 15, 2024.  Owners may contact Lamborghini customer service at 1-866-681-6276.  Lamborghini's number for this recall is L62X-R.03.24.
24V701000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V718000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024 Cybertruck vehicles.  The rearview camera image may be delayed after shifting into reverse.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
24V718000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A delayed rearview image reduces the driver's view of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V718000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla released an over-the-air (OTA) software update, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 25, 2024.  Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752.  Tesla's number for this recall is SB-24-00-016.
24V718000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V719000.DESC_DEFECT: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley-Davidson) is recalling certain 2018-2019 Softail FXBB Street Bob and 2018-2019 Softail FXLR Low Rider motorcycles.  The front tire inflation pressure on the VIN label may be less than the stated front gross axle weight rating (GAWRs).  As such, these motorcycles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other than Passenger Cars."
24V719000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect tire pressure information may result in overloading the front tire, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V719000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Harley-Davidson will mail labels with installation instructions and owner's manual inserts to owners, free of charge.  Letters informing owners of the safety risk were mailed November 13, 2024.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 30, 2024.  Owners may contact Harley-Davidson customer service at 414-343-4056.  Harley-Davidson's number for this recall is 0628.
24V719000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V722000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. is recalling certain 2024-2025 Viking and Clipper travel trailers.  The side marker lights may not reflect light as intended, which can make it difficult for other drivers to see the trailer.  As such, these trailers fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V722000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Insufficiently reflective side marker lights can reduce the trailer's visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V722000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install reflector stickers to the lights, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 22, 2024.  Owners may call Forest River Customer Service at 269-467-6604.  Forest River's number for this recall is 121-1845.
24V722000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V725000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 F-53 Recreational Stripped Chassis and 2024 F-59 Commercial Stripped Chassis vehicles.  The instrument panel cluster may not properly display the transmission gear position indicator.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 102, "Transmission Shift Position Sequence, Starter Interlock, and Transmission Braking Effect."
24V725000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A transmission gear position indicator that fails to illuminate can make it difficult to identify the correct transmission shift position, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V725000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the instrument panel cluster (IPC) module software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on February 12, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24C32.
24V725000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V729000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Ram 1500 vehicles.  The turn signal self-canceling feature may not function properly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V729000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Turn signals that do not function properly may fail to indicate the driver's intention to change vehicle direction, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V729000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the steering column control module as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 23, 2024.  Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  Chrysler's number for this recall is A1B.
24V729000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V744000.DESC_DEFECT: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Acura Integra, Civic Type R, CR-V Hybrid, CR-V, HR-V, 2022-2025 Civic, Civic Hatchback, 2024-2025 Acura Integra Type S, 2025 CR-V Fuel Cell EV, Civic Hybrid, and Civic Hatchback Hybrid vehicles.  The steering gearbox assembly may have been manufactured incorrectly, which can cause excessive internal friction and lead to difficulty steering the vehicle.
24V744000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Difficulty steering can increase the risk of a crash.
24V744000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the worm gear spring and redistribute or add grease as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 18, 2024.  Owners may contact Honda Customer Service at 1-888-234-2138.   Honda's numbers for this recall are SJS, MJU, QJT and VJV.
24V744000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V746000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Catalina CAT243RBSLE travel trailers.  The Federal Placard label states an incorrect Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR).  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims," and fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
24V746000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Referencing an incorrect label may lead to unintentionally overloading the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V746000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install corrected labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 4, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-825-4995.  Forest River's number for this recall is 300-1847.
24V746000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V751000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2025 Jay Feather Air travel trailers.  The Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) listed on the vehicle certification label is incorrect, which can allow the vehicle to be overloaded.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
24V751000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overloaded vehicle can increase the risk of a crash.
24V751000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install new labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 23, 2024.  Owners may contact Jayco Customer Service at 1-800-283-8267.  Jayco's number for this recall is 9901613.
24V751000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V753000.DESC_DEFECT: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley-Davidson) is recalling certain 2022 FXRST and 2022-2024 FXLRST motorcycles.  The front brake lines may contact the fuel tank and become damaged, possibly resulting in a brake fluid leak and a loss of front brake function.
24V753000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of front brake function can increase the risk of a crash.
24V753000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the brake lines and replace them, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 25, 2024.  Owners may contact Harley-Davidson Customer Service at (414) 343-4056.  Harley-Davidson's number for this recall is 0187.
24V753000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V754000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Ram 1500 Classic vehicles equipped with heated trailer tow rearview mirrors.  The mirror glass may detach from the driver's side heated trailer tow rearview mirror.  As such these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
24V754000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Detached mirror glass can reduce driver visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V754000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the mirror glass, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 5, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA Customer Service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is 86B.
24V754000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V759000.DESC_DEFECT: Blue Bird Body Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2020-2024 All American and 2021-2024 Vision transit buses.  The emergency exit label operating instructions lettering is too small and may be difficult to read.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."
24V759000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An emergency exit label that is difficult to read can prevent or delay the use of the emergency exit, increasing the risk of injury.
24V759000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the label, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 9, 2024.  Owners may contact Blue Bird Customer Service at 478-822-2242.  Blue Bird's number for this recall is R23CK (NSB).
24V759000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V771000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024 Ahara, Entrada, 2022-2025 FR3, Georgetown, 2021-2023 Dynamax Isata, 2021-2025 Encore, Mirada, Pursuit, 2025 Sportscoach, V-Cruise, V-Sport, V-Tour, 2023 Sunseeker, and 2024-2025 V-RV motorhomes, equipped with General Electric air conditioners with a soft start device with part number ICM870-16A-BH5400.  The air conditioner soft start device may fail and overheat.
24V771000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air conditioner soft start device that overheats increases the risk of a fire.
24V771000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the soft start, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 1, 2025.  Owners may contact Encore, Mirada, Pursuit and Sportscoach customer service at 1-574-825-8212, Isata customer service at 574-262-3474, Georgetown, FR3, and Sunseeker customer service at 574-206-7600, Ahara and Entrada customer service at 574-264-6664, and V-Cruise, V-RV, V-Sport, and V-Tour customer service at 574-617-6408.  Forest River's number for this recall is 51-1839.
24V771000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V779000.DESC_DEFECT: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC) is recalling certain 2013-2025 Car Hauler and 2017-2025 Stacker vehicles.  Stress may crack and break the A-frame tongue, separating the tongue from the trailer.
24V779000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A separated trailer tongue can cause a loss of control and increase the risk of a crash.
24V779000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will weld additional supports to the tongue tubes, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 4, 2024.  Owners may call ATC customer service at 1-877-441-2440 ext. 342.
24V779000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V802000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 Mustang vehicles.  The Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) may not illuminate at startup or while driving.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 101, "Control and Displays" and 102, "Transmission shift lever sequence, starter interlock, and transmission braking effect."
24V802000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument panel display that does not show critical information, such as warning lights or vehicle speed, increases the risk of a crash.
24V802000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the instrument panel cluster software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on February 25, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24C35.
24V802000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V852000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2025 Explorer, Lincoln Aviator, 2020-2024 Escape, Lincoln Corsair, 2018-2024 F-150, Expedition and Lincoln Navigator vehicles.  The air bag warning label may be missing from the dashboard.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirement Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
24V852000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Without a label that shows the proper restraint usage guidelines, the occupants may have an increased risk of injury in the event of a crash.
24V852000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Ford will mail owners the warning labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 19, 2024.  Owners may call Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24C39.
24V852000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V790000.DESC_DEFECT: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2020-2025 VN, VAH, VHD and VNRE trucks, equipped with Bendix EC80 Advanced Electronic Control Units (ECU).  Electrical noise and low signal to the power line carrier may cause the ECU to incorrectly process commands or stop working.
24V790000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Safety systems that depend on the ECU (Automatic Traction Control, ABS, Electronic Stability Control, Active Cruise Control, and Collison Mitigation System) may have diminished or lost functionality, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V790000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reprogram the ECU software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 9, 2024.  Owners may contact Volvo Trucks customer service at 1-800-528-6586.  Volvo Truck's number for this recall is RVXX2409.
24V790000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V793000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Pacifica and 2020-2021, 2023 Voyager vehicles.  An improperly secured connector for the side curtain air bags may prevent the air bags from deploying.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 214, "Side Impact Protection" and 226, "Ejection Mitigation."
24V793000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that does not deploy during a crash increases the risk of injury.
24V793000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will secure the connector, free of charge.  All vehicles have been remedied.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 22, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is A8B.
24V793000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V810000.DESC_DEFECT: Ferrari North America, Inc (Ferrari) is recalling certain 2023 Portofino M, F8 Spider, and 2024 Roma Spider vehicles.  The driveshaft screws may not have been tightened during production and may loosen.
24V810000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Driveshaft screws that loosen may result in a loss of vehicle traction and control, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V810000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to drive the vehicles.  Dealers will verify the tightening of the driveshaft screws and, if necessary, perform the tightening process, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 13, 2024.  Owners may contact Ferrari customer service at 1-201-816-2668.  Ferrari's number for this recall is RC 88.
24V810000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V827000.DESC_DEFECT: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2025 R1T and R1S vehicles.  Software version 2024.39.30 may prevent certain exterior lights from turning on when the Car Costume feature is activated.
24V827000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Deactivated exterior lighting reduces the vehicle's visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V827000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Rivian has released an over-the-air (OTA) software update, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 18, 2024.  Owners may contact Rivian customer service at 1-888-748-4261.  Rivian's number for this recall is FSAM-1552.
24V827000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V843000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2024 Santa Fe and Santa Fe Hybrid vehicles. The overhead console rear sunshade switch knob may not be fully recessed, which can result in unintentional closing of the sunshade.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 118, "Power-Operated Window, Partition and Roof Panel Systems."
24V843000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sunshade that closes unexpectedly can increase the risk of injury.
24V843000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the switch knobs, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 2, 2025.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 270.
24V843000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V846000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Catalina and Aurora travel trailers.  Please see the recall report for a complete list of models.  The solar panel wiring may be incorrectly wired, causing the wiring to short and overheat.
24V846000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overheated wiring can melt, increasing the risk of a fire.
24V846000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will rewire the solar panel to the solar controller, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 15, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-825-4995.  Forest River's number for this recall is 300-1863.
24V846000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V854000.DESC_DEFECT: VANCRAFT LLC (VanCraft) is recalling certain 2002-2006 Campervan, 2014-2023 SWB Campervan, LWB Campervan, 2023 LWB Campervan Pro, 2023-2024 Rover, Rover XL, and Alltrek vehicles.  The vehicles are missing the Occupant and Cargo Carrying Capacity (OCCC) label and the altered certification label.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 110, "Tire Selection and Rims" and 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
24V854000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Missing OCCC and altered certification labels may result in unintentionally overloading the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V854000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Vancraft will mail labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 19, 2024.  Owners may contact Vancraft customer service at 1-888-381-7333.
24V854000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V877000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 Tucson and Santa Cruz vehicles.  The console extension wiring assembly may be routed improperly, allowing the transmission to be shifted out of Park without applying the brake pedal.
24V877000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A transmission that can shift out of Park without applying the brake pedal can result in a vehicle roll away, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V877000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to use the parking brake when parking the vehicle.  Dealers will reroute the console extension wiring assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 17, 2024.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 273.
24V877000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V883000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Cedar Creek CRT40RDE Fifth Wheel trailers.  Undersized axles and tires may have been installed, which can lead to a tire detaching.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other Than Passenger Cars."
24V883000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached tire increases the risk of crash.
24V883000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace axles and tires, free of charge.  The two affected vehicles have not been sold from dealer inventory and therefore no owner letters will be mailed.  Forest River's customer service number is 1-260-593-4000.  Forest River's number for this recall is 20-1873.
24V883000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V326000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Coachmen Nova NAB20C and NAB20D Class B motorhomes.  The solar panel may detach from the pop-up roof.
24V326000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached solar panel could become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V326000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will remove and reinstall the solar panel, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 26, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 1-574-825-6319.  Forest River's number for this recall is 225-1772.
24V326000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V884000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Viking and Clipper travel trailers.  The fresh water holding tank support bracket may be the incorrect gauge and may break.
24V884000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken bracket can cause the tank to detach, increases the risk of a crash.
24V884000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the support bracket, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 20, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-269-467-8283.  Forest River's number for this recall is 51-1870.
24V884000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V908000.DESC_DEFECT: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2024 Peterbilt 367, 389, 548, Kenworth T480, T800, 2024-2025 Peterbilt 520, 567 and Kenworth T880 vehicles with PACCAR 20k steer axles.  The steering arm and/or tie rod bracket fasteners may fail, resulting in a loss of steering control.
24V908000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of steering control increases the risk of a crash.
24V908000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install new correctly torqued fasteners, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 21, 2025.  Owners may contact Kenworth's customer service at 1-425-828-5888 or Peterbilt's customer service at 1-940-591-4220.  PACCAR's numbers for this recall are 24KWK and 24PBK.
24V908000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V887000.MFGNAME: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc.
24V887000.DESC_DEFECT: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc. (Mitsubishi Fuso) is recalling certain 2016-2020 FEC52, FEC72, and FEC92 vehicles.  The rear leaf spring may break.
24V887000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken rear spring leaf may become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V887000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the leaf spring assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 7, 2024.  Owners may contact Mitsubishi Fuso customer service at 1-877-711-0707.
24V887000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.Please be reminded of the following requirements:You are required to submit a draft owner notification letter to this office no less than five days prior to mailing it to the customers.Also, copies of all notices, bulletins, dealer notifications, and other communications that relate to this recall, including a copy of the final owner notification letter and any subsequent owner follow-up notification letter(s), are required to be submitted to this office no later than 5 days after they are originally sent (if they are sent to more than one manufacturer, distributor, dealer, or purchaser/owner).Please be reminded that under 49 U.S.C. Â§ 30112(a)(3), it is illegal for a manufacturer, to sell, offer for sale, import, or introduce or deliver into interstate commerce, a motor vehicle or item of motor vehicle equipment that contains a safety defect once the manufacturer has notified NHTSA about that safety defect.This prohibition does not apply once the motor vehicle or motor vehicle equipment has been remedied according to the manufacturer's instructions.As stated in 49 U.S.C. Â§ 30118(f), submission of eight consecutive quarterly reports followed by three annual reports is required.As described in 573.7, submission of the first of eight consecutive quarterly status reports is required within one month after the close of the calendar quarter in which notification to purchasers occurs.Therefore, the first quarterly report will be due on, or before, 30 days after the close of the calendar quarter.The first of three consecutive annual status reports will be due on, or before, 1 year after the eighth quarterly report was submitted.

24V117000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2024 GLE350, GLE450, AMG GLE53, and AMG GLE53 Coupe vehicles.  The accelerator pedal module bracket may have been improperly welded, which can result in the bracket breaking or detaching.
24V117000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken or detached accelerator pedal can increase the risk of a crash or injury.
24V117000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will drill through the spot welds and secure the bracket with rivets, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 5, 2024.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.  MBUSA's number for this recall is 2024030009.
24V117000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V129000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Ram Promaster vehicles.  The driver seat belt warning light and audible chime may not activate as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
24V129000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A malfunctioning seat belt warning system can result in improper seat belt use, increasing the risk of injury in a crash.
24V129000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the driver seat belt buckle as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 9, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US, LLC's number for this recall is 02B.
24V129000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V002000.DESC_DEFECT: Terex Advance Mixer, Inc. (Terex) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Commander, Charger, and 2023 MM300 concrete mixer trucks.  The bolts connecting the drum to the drum drive plate may loosen, resulting in the drum separating from vehicle.
24V002000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached drum can become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
24V002000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Terex will provide replacement fasteners and thread locker, free of charge.  The manufacturer has not yet provided a schedule for recall notification.  Owners may contact Terex customer service at 1-800-678-5961.
24V002000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V011000.DESC_DEFECT: Lucid USA, Inc. (Lucid) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Air vehicles.  The high voltage coolant heater may fail to defrost the windshield.
24V011000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A high voltage coolant heater that fails to defrost the windshield can reduce the driver's view, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V011000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Lucid will update the software to identify a high voltage coolant heater failure and provide a warning to the driver.  High voltage coolant heaters that fail will be replaced.  Repairs will be performed free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 7, 2024.  Owners may contact Lucid customer service at 1-888-995-8243.  Lucid's number for this recall is SR-24-01-0.
24V011000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V015000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2004-2023 AT Series aerial devices.  The cables in the engine compartment may contact the vehicle's hood, damaging the cables and causing a short circuit.
24V015000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A short circuit increases the risk of a fire.
24V015000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Altec will inspect and relocate the cables and fuse blocks, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed March 8, 2024.  Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832.  Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3142.
24V015000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V023000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
24V023000.MFGNAME: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
24V023000.DESC_DEFECT: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2018-2022 Range Rover and Range Rover Sport vehicles equipped with a Surround Camera System.  Water may enter into the rearview camera, which can cause the rearview camera image not to appear on the display or display a distorted image.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
24V023000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera image that does not display while in reverse decreases the driver's visibility, increasing the risk of injury or crash.
24V023000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the rearview camera and add a new seal or replace the camera, free of charge.
