Owner notification letters were mailed to Range Rover owners March 4, 2024.  Interim notification letters were mailed to Range Rover Sport owners March 7, 2024.  Range Rover Sport owners will receive a second notice once remedy parts become available.  Owners may contact Land Rover customer service at 1-800-637-6837.  Land Rover's number for this recall is N778.
24V023000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V024000.DESC_DEFECT: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Ekko motorhomes.  The blind spot monitoring system may fail without warning to the driver.
24V024000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Without a functioning blind spot monitoring system, the driver may be unaware of a vehicle in their blind spot, which can increase the risk of a crash.
24V024000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a new blind spot monitoring system, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed February 16, 2024.  Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-641-585-6939 or 1-800-537-1885.
24V024000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V026000.DESC_DEFECT: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2024 International HV and International MV trucks.  The driver's seat belt tether bolt may not be properly seated in the anchor, causing a bind at the anchor point.
24V026000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly anchored seat belt tether may not restrain an occupant as intended, increasing their risk of injury during a crash.
24V026000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the seat belts as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 26, 2024.  Owners may contact Navistar customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  Navistar's number for this recall is 24501.
24V026000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V038000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:FOUNDATION COMPONENTS:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
24V038000.DESC_DEFECT: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC (Suzuki) is recalling certain 2024 GSX1300R motorcycles.  The brake fluid pipe flare nut for the brake fluid supply line may have been tightened incorrectly and cause a brake fluid leak.
24V038000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A brake fluid leak can result in reduced braking performance, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V038000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and tighten the brake pipe flare nut connection and adjust the brake fluid level, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 5, 2024.  Owners may contact Suzuki customer service at 1-714-542-1490.  Suzuki's number for this recall is 3A01.
24V038000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V055000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2023 Entegra Expanse, Expanse LI, Jayco Solstice, and Solstice LI motorhomes.  The retractable awning may extend unintentionally during transit.
24V055000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An awning extending unintentionally during transit may become a distraction or road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V055000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a wedge to support the internal components in the gearbox and replace the motor as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 23, 2024.  Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267.  Jayco's number for this recall is 9903601.
24V055000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V063000.DESC_DEFECT: Braun Ambulances (Braun) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Chief XL I, Express Plus I, Chief XL III, Liberty I, Super Chief I, Signature Series III, Signature Series I, and 2020-2024 Express III emergency vehicles equipped with Weldon 8X16 Input-Output nodes.  In the event of a short circuit or wiring failure, the firmware in the node may fail to shut off the output pin, resulting in overloaded electrical circuits.
24V063000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overloaded electrical circuits can overheat, increasing the risk of fire.
24V063000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Weldon will update the firmware, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 28, 2024.  Owners may contact Akron Brass customer service at 1-800-228-1161 or Braun customer service at 1-800-488-0359.  Braun's number for this recall is 2024-01.
24V063000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V067000.DESC_DEFECT: Gulf Stream Coach, Inc. (Gulf Stream) is recalling certain 2024 Trail Boss 160FK trailers.  The incorrect tire size and tire pressure are listed on the federal certification label.  As such, these trailers fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims" and 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
24V067000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect tire information could result in improperly inflated tires or the wrong tires being installed on the trailer, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V067000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will mail replacement federal certification labels to customers, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 8, 2024.  Owners may contact Gulf Stream customer service at 1-800-289-8787.  Gulf Stream's number for this recall is 106FK/23.
24V067000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V074000.DESC_DEFECT: Eldorado National-California, Inc. (ENC) is recalling certain 2012-2023 XHF and Arrivo vehicles equipped with a Ricon wheelchair lift.  The red beacon lighting on the threshold warning system (TWS) may not be bright enough.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 403, "Platform Lift Systems."
24V074000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Beacons that do not provide proper illumination may be less visible to wheelchair lift users, increasing the risk of injury.
24V074000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: ENC will work with Ricon to replace the TWS kits, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 4, 2024.  Owners may contact ENC customer service at 1-951-684-6868.
24V074000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V092000.DESC_DEFECT: Vicinity Motor Corporation (Vicinity) is recalling certain 2022 Vi35 transit buses.  Inadequate clearance may allow the CNG tanks to contact the supporting mounting structure and/or safety cables, damaging the tanks.
24V092000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A damaged tank can leak natural gas, increasing the risk of a fire.
24V092000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: As an interim repair, dealers will inspect and adjust the mounting structure.  If the vehicle's mounting structure cannot be adjusted, owners are advised not to drive their vehicle until the supporting member is replaced.  When the final repair is available, dealers will inspect, secure the safety cables, install protective material on the tank, and replace the mounting structure and CNG tanks as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 18, 2024.  Owners may contact Vicinity customer service at 1-604-607-4000.  Vicinity's number for this recall is CA-000-051.
24V092000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V106000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:HARD PARTS INTERNAL/MECHANICAL
24V106000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundia Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2024 Palisade vehicles.  The engine valve springs may break while driving, which can result in a loss of drive power and possibly create a hole in the engine block.
24V106000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.  A hole in the engine block increases the risk of a fire.
24V106000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the engine sub-assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed by December 6, 2024.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 255.
24V106000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V110000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain front-wheel drive 2015-2020 Audi A3 Sedan, 2015-2019 Audi A3 Cabriolet, 2019-2020 Volkswagen Jetta GLI, 2018 Golf Sportwagen GP, 2018-2019 Golf Sportwagen A7, 2015-2017 Golf Sportwagen, 2015-2020 Golf GTI, and 2015-2020 Golf A7 vehicles.  Due to a problem with a suction jet pump seal inside the fuel tank, fuel may flow into the evaporative emissions (EVAP) system and possibly leak out of the charcoal canister.
24V110000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.
24V110000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the suction pump, free of charge.  Final owner notification letters for Audi owners were mailed on July 25, 2024.  Final owner letters for VW owners were mailed on August 13, 2024.  Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298 or Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Volkswagen's numbers for this recall are VW: 20UF/Audi: 20YF.  Vehicles that were previously recalled under 16V-647 will need to have the new remedy completed.  This recall expands and replaces previous recall number 16V-647.
24V110000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V115000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2023-2024 C300, AMG C43, S580e, S580, Maybach S580, Maybach S680, AMG SL43, AMGSL63, GLC300, EQE350, EQE500, EQS450, EQS580, AMG EQS, 2023 S500, AMG SL55, AMG EQE, 2024 E350, E450, AMG C63e S, CLE300 Coupe, CLE450 Coupe, and GLC300 Coupe vehicles.  The 80-Amp fuses may have been manufactured incorrectly, which can cause the fuses to fail.
24V115000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An 80-Amp fuse that fails can result in a sudden loss of drive power or a loss of critical safety functions such as the restraint systems or instrument cluster, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.  Additionally, there could be an increased risk of a fire.
24V115000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the main fuse boxes, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 5, 2024.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.  MBUSA's number for this recall is 2024030008.
24V115000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V516000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Jeep Cherokee vehicles.  An improperly secured connector for the right-side curtain air bag may prevent the air bag from deploying as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 214, "Side Impact Protection" and 226, "Ejection Mitigation."
24V516000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that does not deploy as intended can increase the risk of injury in a crash.
24V516000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will secure the connector, free of charge.  All vehicles have been remedied.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US, LLC's number for this recall is 71B.
24V516000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V521000.DESC_DEFECT: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2024 Springdale 245ML, Hideout 24L0F, Aspen Trail 260THLOFT, 360THLOFT, and Colorado 360THLOFT travel trailers.  The metal sidewall may be incorrectly attached and come loose during transit.
24V521000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Loose sidewalls that detach during transit can create a road hazard, increasing the risk of injury or crash.
24V521000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install additional support, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2024.  Owners may contact Keystone customer service at 1-574-535-2100.  Keystone's number for this recall is 24-456.
24V521000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V526000.DESC_DEFECT: Terex South Dakota, Inc. (Terex) is recalling certain 2020-2024 XT Pro vehicles equipped with replacement basket brackets.  The replacement basket brackets may not be compatible with the original basket retaining pins and cause the basket to unintentionally tilt.
24V526000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Tilting of the basket may cause the basket occupants to fall, increasing the risk of an injury.
24V526000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the retaining pins, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 10, 2024.  Owners may contact Terex customer service at 1-605-882-4000.  Terex's number for this recall is SN729.
24V526000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V528000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Veloster N, 2019-2023 Genesis G70, 2022-2023 Elantra N, and Kona N vehicles.  The fuel pump may fail, which can result in a loss of drive power.
24V528000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power can increase the risk of a crash.
24V528000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update engine control module software.  In addition, dealers will inspect and replace the fuel pump assembly, as necessary.  All repairs will be performed free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed beginning September 9, 2024.  Some interim notification letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, were mailed September 3, 2024.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's numbers for this recall are 262 and 023G.
24V528000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V541000.DESC_DEFECT: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Ekko motorhomes.  The solar charging system was incorrectly designed without sufficient over-current protection, which can allow the circuit to overheat and melt the fuse.
24V541000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A melted fuse increases the risk of a fire.
24V541000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the solar controller fuse and components, as necessary free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 25, 2024.   Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-641-585-3535.  Winnebago's number for this recall is 186.
24V541000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V548000.DESC_DEFECT: Gulf States Toyota, Inc. (GST) is recalling certain Toyota 2023 GR Supra, 2024 4 Runner, Corolla, Grand Highlander, Grand Highlander Hybrid, Land Cruiser Hybrid, Tacoma, Tacoma Hybrid, 2023-2024 BZ4X, Corolla Cross Hybrid, GR Corolla, GR86, Highlander, Highlander Hybrid, Prius, Prius Prime, Sequoia Hybrid, Tundra, Tundra Hybrid, Venza Hybrid, 2023-2025 Crown, and 2025 Camry Hybrid vehicles equipped with GST accessories.  The load carrying capacity modification label may display inaccurate added weight values.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
24V548000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A vehicle with an incorrect maximum capacity weight value may be overloaded, which can increase the risk of a crash.
24V548000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: GST will mail new labels to owners, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 16, 2024.  Owners may contact GST customer service at 1-800-444-1074.  GST's number for this recall is 24R2.
24V548000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V563000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Cherokee CKT20-0G travel trailers.  During installation, an incorrect length screw was used to install the microwave, which allowed the screw to enter the microwave compartment.
24V563000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The presence of a screw in the microwave compartment can cause electrical arcing, increasing the risk of a fire.
24V563000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the microwave as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 7, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-260-499-2100.  Forest River's number for this recall is 89-1819.
24V563000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V579000.DESC_DEFECT: TAXA LLC (TAXA) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Mantis trailers.  The gaskets and brackets could fail to stabilize the freshwater tank, allowing the tank to move and detach from the trailer.
24V579000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached tank can fall, becoming a road hazard and increasing the risk of a crash.
24V579000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the gaskets and brackets, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 20, 2024.  Owners may contact TAXA customer service at 713-861-2540.
24V579000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V585000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024 Jeep Wrangler vehicles.Â  The vehicles are equipped with incorrect tail lights that may be obstructed by the spare tire.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V585000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Obstructed tail lights can reduce the vehicle's visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V585000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the tail lights, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 29, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is 90B.
24V585000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V587000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2025 Lexus UX300h vehicles.  Certain wires in the engine room wire harness that supply power to the motor generator electronic control unit (MG ECU) may become fractured and separate, which can result in a loss of power.
24V587000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power can increase the risk of a crash.
24V587000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the engine room main wire harness, free of charge.  Owner letters were mailed December 6, 2024.  Owners may contact Toyota customer service at 1-800-331-4331.  Toyota's numbers for this recall are 24LB07 and 24LA07.
24V587000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V590000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 Maverick vehicles previously repaired under recall number 24V-267.  The body and power train control modules may fail to detect a change in the 12-volt battery state of charge.
24V590000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An undetected low battery charge can result in a loss of electrical accessories such as hazard lights, or cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V590000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will recalibrate the body control module and power train control module, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 26, 2024.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S50.
24V590000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V609000.DESC_DEFECT: CFMOTO Powersports, Inc. (CFMOTO) is recalling certain 2023 Ibex 800 S and Ibex 800 T motorcycles.  The throttle wire may bend excessively and break, resulting in a loss of throttle response and an engine stall.
24V609000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
24V609000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reposition the rubber claps, rerouting the throttle wire, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 28, 2024.  Owners may contact CFMOTO customer service at 1-763-398-2690.  CFMOTO's number for this recall is SAF-2024-03.
24V609000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V617000.DESC_DEFECT: Winnebago Towable (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Minnie travel trailers.  The microwave may have been incorrectly connected to a 20 AMP breaker, allowing the wire to become overloaded.
24V617000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overloaded wire increases the risk of a fire.
24V617000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the 20 AMP breaker with a 15 AMP breaker, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 10, 2024. Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-574-825-5250.  Winnebago's number for this recall is CAM0000037.
24V617000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V618000.DESC_DEFECT: Winnebago Towable (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Minnie, 2024-2025 Access, and 2021-2025 Voyage travel trailers.  The countertop may have an incorrect standard outlet installed when there should be a GFCI protected outlet.
24V618000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A lack of proper circuit protection increases the risk of electric shock and injury.
24V618000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a GFCI outlet, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 10, 2024.  Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-574-825-5250.  Winnebago's number for this recall is CAM0000038.
24V618000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V705000.DESC_DEFECT: Triple E Recreational Vehicles (Triple E) is recalling certain Triple E 2024 Unity and Triple E 2024 Wonder motorhomes.  The metric and imperial gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) values were transposed.
24V705000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrect label may lead to unintentionally overloading the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V705000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Triple E will mail owners corrected labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 9, 2024.  Owners can contact Triple E Customer Service at 1-204-325-4361.  Triple E's number for this recall is CA#10616-1.
24V705000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V636000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 Transit vehicles.  The front gross axle weight rating may be labeled incorrectly on the vehicle B-pillar label and the owner's manual label, which can result in an overloaded vehicle.
24V636000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overloaded vehicle may result in steering knuckle failure and a loss of steering control, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V636000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 23, 2024.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S53.
24V636000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V642000.DESC_DEFECT: Kentucky Trailer Manufacturing (KTM) is recalling certain 2022-2024 (KTB) MV and PV truck bodies.  The upper cargo area floor may not be secured properly, which can allow the crossmembers to loosen and detach.
24V642000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Crossmembers that detach can fall off the truck body, increasing the risk of injury.
24V642000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will secure the floor, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 23, 2023.  Owners may contact KTM customer service at 1-502-637-2551.
24V642000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V645000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:EXHAUST SYSTEM:MANIFOLD/HEADER/MUFFLER/TAIL PIPE
24V645000.DESC_DEFECT: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2022-2024 DC (Legend).  The horizontal exhaust diffuser may be improperly positioned and vent exhaust toward the CNG fuel tank.
24V645000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Exhaust fumes can overheat the fuel tank, increasing the risk of a fire.
24V645000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and reposition the exhaust diffuser as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 25, 2024.  Owners may contact Autocar customer service at 1-888-218-3611.  Autocar's number for this recall is DC-2406.
24V645000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V652000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2020-2024 Jeep Gladiator and 2018-2024 Jeep Wrangler vehicles.  The instrument panel cluster may experience an internal short circuit and fail.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 101, "Controls and Displays."
24V652000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument panel that fails to display critical safety information, such as the speedometer or warning lights, can increase the risk of a crash.
24V652000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the instrument panel cluster, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed between October 3, 2024, and January 23, 2025.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is 30B.
24V652000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V695000.COMPNAME: AIR BAGS: AIR BAG/RESTRAINT CONTROL MODULE:SOFTWARE
24V695000.DESC_DEFECT: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2016-2023 MX-5 Miata vehicles.  A software error in the air bag control module may cause the front air bags to deploy with excessive force during a crash.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
24V695000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that deploys with excessive force can increase the risk of injury during a crash.
24V695000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the Sophisticated Air Bag Sensor (SAS) control module software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 7, 2024.  Owners may contact Mazda customer service at 1-800-222-5500.  Mazda's number for this recall is 6924I.
24V695000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V662000.DESC_DEFECT: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2025 Winnebago View, Navion, and 2024-2025 Ekko recreational vehicles equipped with certain GE air conditioners.  The air conditioner soft start device may fail and overheat.
24V662000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air conditioner soft start device that overheats increases the risk of a fire.
24V662000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the air conditioner soft start module, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 21, 2025.  Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-641-585-3535.  Winnebago's number for this recall is 188.
24V662000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V665000.DESC_DEFECT: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2025 VN and VHD trucks.  The wheel lug nuts may be improperly tightened.
24V665000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Improperly tightened lug nuts can allow the wheel to detach, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V665000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will tighten the left-side lug nuts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 19, 2024.  Owners may contact Volvo Trucks customer service at 1-800-528-6586.  Volvo Truck's number for this recall is RVXX2407.
24V665000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V676000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
24V676000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2018-2024 Jeep Wrangler vehicles.  The wiring harness for the rearview camera and the center brake light may short circuit, which can disable the rearview camera image and center brake light.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 111, "Rear Visibility" and 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V676000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera image that does not display decreases the driver's visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.  Additionally, a center brake light that fails to illuminate can fail to indicate to other drivers that the vehicle is slowing down, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V676000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers replaced the harness for the center brake light and rearview camera and/or the spare tire carrier/harness assembly, as necessary, free of charge.  All vehicles were repaired by January 15, 2024.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 26, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US, LLC's number for this recall is 77B.
24V676000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V682000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 F-150 vehicles.  The parking lights may flicker when the headlights are activated.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V682000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Flickering parking lights can reduce visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V682000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the LED Driver module, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on March 10, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24C30.  These vehicles were previously recalled for this same issue under 22V-686 and will need to have the new remedy performed.
24V682000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V687000.DESC_DEFECT: Winnebago Towable (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Winnebago Access travel trailers.  The metal siding may have been improperly attached and can come loose.
24V687000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Loose siding can detach and become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V687000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the siding as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 18, 2024.  Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-574-825-5250.  Winnebago's number for this recall is CAM0000039.
24V687000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V699000.DESC_DEFECT: Motiv Power Systems, Inc. (Motiv) is recalling certain 2017-2020 F-59 school buses equipped with a Motiv Gen 4 EPIC and 2020-2023 F-59 school buses equipped with a Motiv Gen 5 EPIC powertrain.  The wiring harness may be missing a heat shrink insulator and retention clip.  The 12-volt control wires may deteriorate and loosen, causing a loss of connection to the high voltage (HV) batteries and drive power.
24V699000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
24V699000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Motiv field support technicians will inspect and correct or replace any 12-volt control wires showing signs of fatigue, cracking, or improper retention or protection as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 21, 2024.  Owners may contact Motiv customer service at 1-650-458-4804.
24V699000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V703000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Chevrolet Colorado and 2023 GMC Canyon vehicles.  The left or right front seat may have a seat belt buckle attachment bolt that was not tightened properly.
24V703000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose seat belt may not properly restrain an occupant in a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
24V703000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will tighten the left and right front seat belt buckle attachment bolts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 30, 2024.  Owners may contact Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020, or GMC customer service at 1-800-462-8782.  GM's number for this recall is N242453720.
24V703000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V860000.DESC_DEFECT: Indian Motorcycle Company (Indian) is recalling certain 2022 FTR 1200 R Carbon, FTR 1200, FTR 1200 S and FTR 1200 Rally motorcycles.  These motorcycles may have been assembled with an altered fuel tank containing holes that can leak fuel.
24V860000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel tank leak increases the risk of fire or injury.
24V860000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the fuel tank, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 17, 2024.  Owners may contact Indian customer service at 1-877-204-3697.  Indian's number for this recall is I-24-09.
24V860000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V707000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:GASOLINE:BELTS AND ASSOCIATED PULLEYS
24V707000.DESC_DEFECT: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2023-2024 G5 school buses.  The engine drive belt tensioner may fail, resulting in a loose drive belt.
24V707000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose drive belt can result in a loss of power steering, or a loss of alternator and water pump function, increasing the risk of a crash.  Additionally, the engine may overheat, increasing the risk of a fire.
24V707000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the engine drive belt tensioner and belt, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 6, 2024.  Owners can contact Micro Bird Customer Service at 819-477-2012.  Micro Bird's number for this recall is 24-111-GUS.
24V707000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V713000.DESC_DEFECT: Royal Enfield North America Limited (Royal Enfield) is recalling certain 2023 Himalayan, Classic 350, Meteor 350, Hunter 350, Super Meteor 650, Int 650, and Continental GT 650 motorcycles.  The side and rear reflectors are not sufficient.  As such, these lights fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V713000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Without the proper reflective equipment, it may be difficult for other road users to see the motorcycle from the rear or side, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V713000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the side and rear reflectors, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 30, 2024.  Owners may contact Royal Enfield's customer service at 1-866-600-1122.  Royal Enfield's number for this recall is SC-43.
24V713000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V715000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024 Ram Promaster Battery Electric (BEV) vehicles.  Incorrect software in the motor control processor module (MCPA) may cause a loss of drive power.
24V715000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power can increase the risk of a crash.
24V715000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the MCPA software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 31, 2024.  Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  Chrysler's number for this recall is 99B.
24V715000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V732000.DESC_DEFECT: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Taycan vehicles.  The high-voltage battery may experience a short circuit within the battery module.
24V732000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A short circuit in a high-voltage battery increases the risk of a fire.
24V732000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install advanced diagnostic software as the final remedy, anticipated to be available in the first quarter of 2025.  Porsche will monitor available online vehicle data and contact owners as necessary, to advise them to only charge the vehicle to 80% capacity until the battery can be replaced.  For vehicles in which online data is unavailable, dealers will perform a diagnostic test and replace the battery module assembly, if necessary and advise owners to only charge to 80% capacity.  Repairs will be performed free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 6, 2025. Owners may contact Porsche customer service at 1-800-767-7243.  Porsche's numbers for this recall are ARB6 and ARB7.  This recall expands and replaces previous recall numbers 23V-840, 24V-215, and 24V-217.
24V732000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V737000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025 Chevrolet Blazer, Blazer EV, and Equinox vehicles.  The door strikers were not properly heat-treated, which can cause them to break.
24V737000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken door striker can cause the door to open unexpectedly, increasing the risk of injury.
24V737000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace all four side door strikers and attachment bolts, free of charge.  All affected vehicles are still in dealership inventory and therefore no owner notification letters are expected to be mailed.  Owners may call Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020.  GM's number for this recall is N242477131.
24V737000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V740000.DESC_DEFECT: Terex South Dakota, Inc. (Terex) is recalling certain 2023-2024 TL80, TL80/112, TL100, and TM vehicles.  The jib extension hydraulic cylinder rod may have a weak weld that can fail.
24V740000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A failed weld can result in the cylinder rod separating from the cylinder, increasing the risk of injury.
24V740000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the jib extension cylinders, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 7, 2024.  Owners may contact Terex customer service at 1-605-882-4000.  Terex's number for this recall is SN732.
24V740000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V741000.DESC_DEFECT: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Volvo VN vehicles.  When the Controller Area Network (CAN) communications are interrupted and the vehicle is in limp mode, an incorrect accelerator pedal signal can result in unintended acceleration.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 124, "Accelerator Control Systems."
24V741000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Sudden unintended acceleration can increase the risk of a crash.
24V741000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the electronic control unit (ECU) software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 26, 2024.  Owners may contact Volvo Customer Service at 1-800-528-6586.  Volvo's number for this recall is RVXX2408.
24V741000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V760000.DESC_DEFECT: E-One Incorporated (E-One) is recalling certain 2020-2024 Cyclone 2, Typhoon N, 2021- 2024 Cyclone N, and 2021 Quest 2 vehicles.  The engine crossmember may break, allowing the cooling fan to contact the fan shroud and become damaged.
24V760000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A damaged cooling fan can result in an engine stall while driving and increase the risk of a crash.
24V760000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the crossmember as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 26, 2024.  Owners may contact E-One Customer Service at 1-352-237-1122.
24V760000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V765000.DESC_DEFECT: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2024 Revuelto vehicles.  The connecting rod between the passenger wiper arm and the wiper motor may bend and separate from the wiper motor, causing the wipers to fail.
24V765000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Inoperative windshield wipers can reduce visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V765000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the passenger wiper system connecting rod, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 15, 2024, and November 22, 2024.  Owners may contact Automobili Lamborghini customer service at 1-866-681-6276.  Automobili Lamborghini's number for this recall is L74X-R.02.24.
24V765000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V774000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Riverstone Fifth Wheel trailers.  The solar panels may have been incorrectly connected in parallel and instead of in series, causing the wiring to overheat and melt.
24V774000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Melted wires increase the risk of a fire.
24V774000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the wiring and replace the cable entry plate and solar controller as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 5, 2024.  Owners may call Forest River Customer Service at (260) 593-2425.  Forest River's number for this recall is 70-1853.
24V774000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V780000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2025 GLB 250, GLB 250 4MATIC, and GLB 35 4MATIC vehicles.  The right-side front and rear tires may have sidewall damage, which can result in a sudden loss of tire pressure.
24V780000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden loss of tire pressure can result in a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V780000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the tires as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 22, 2024.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.  MBUSA's number for this recall is 2024100014.
24V780000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V783000.DESC_DEFECT: Rimac D.O.O. (Bugatti-Rimac) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Nevera vehicles.  The C19 low voltage cable may not be secured properly, which can cause a short-circuit and allow the cable to overheat.
24V783000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An electrical cable that overheats can increase the risk of a fire.
24V783000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until the inspection has been performed.  Dealers will inspect and repair the C19 low voltage cable, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 25, 2024.  Owners may contact Bugatti-Rimac customer service at 1-703-826-7545.
24V783000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V848000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
24V848000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 Ranger vehicles.  The fuel vapor line bracket may have insufficient clearance to the fuel vapor line, which can result in fuel vapor line damage that can lead to a fuel vapor leak.
24V848000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel vapor leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
24V848000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect for a fuel vapor line bracket and install a tie strap to secure the fuel vapor line to the bracket, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 20, 2024.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S71.
24V848000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V858000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
24V858000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2024 Chevrolet Express Commercial Cutaway and GMC Savana Commercial Cutaway vehicles.  These vehicles may be missing the required rear vision camera video display because an incorrect inside rearview mirror was installed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
24V858000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A missing rear vision camera display reduces the driver's visibility behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V858000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the inside rearview mirror as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 6, 2024.  Owners may contact GM customer service at 1-888-988-7267, and Chevrolet at 1-800-222-1020.  GM's number for this recall is N242481860.
24V858000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V859000.DESC_DEFECT: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Honda Accord, Accord Hybrid, Civic Sedan, Civic Hatchback, Pilot, and 2024 HR-V, Acura Integra and Acura Integra Type S vehicles.  The driver's seat cushion frame may not have been tightened properly, which can result in an unsecured seat.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 207, "Seating Systems."
24V859000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unsecured driver's seat may not adequately restrain the driver during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
24V859000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the driver's seat cushion frame, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 6, 2025.  Owners may contact Honda customer service at 1-888-234-2138.
24V859000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V875000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
24V875000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2023 ID.4 vehicles.  The rearview camera image may not display when the vehicle is placed in reverse or when the park function is manually activated.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
24V875000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A blank rearview camera display can reduce the driver's rear visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V875000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the peripheral camera control module, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 26, 2025.  Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298.  Volkswagen's number for this recall is 91B3.
24V875000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V888000.DESC_DEFECT: Braun Corporation (Braun) is recalling certain 2024 Chrysler Pacifica and Voyager vehicles.  The seat limiter may not have been installed, allowing the seat to move too far forward.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
24V888000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat positioned too close to the air bag can increase the risk of injury during a crash.
24V888000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and install a seat limiter as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 17, 2024.  Owners may contact Braun customer service at 1-800-488-0359.
24V888000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V889000.DESC_DEFECT: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Macan Electric vehicles.  The headlights may be too bright and exceed the maximum light output, which may adversely affect the vision of drivers.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V889000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Headlights that are excessively bright can reduce visibility for oncoming drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V889000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reprogram the headlight control unit software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 23, 2025.  Owners may contact Porsche customer service at 1-800-767-7243.  Porsche's number for this recall is ARC5.
24V889000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V916000.DESC_DEFECT: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Momentum fifth wheel trailers.  The interior step base does not adequately support the step tread.
24V916000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The tread may detach from the step, increasing the risk of a trip and fall injury.
24V916000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the step riser and step treads, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 16, 2025.  Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679.  Grand Design's number for this recall is 910047.
24V916000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V918000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Jeep Renegade vehicles.  The incorrect bumper reverse light assembly may have been installed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V918000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The incorrect reverse lights may have reduced visibility, and not alert pedestrians and other drivers that the vehicle is backing up, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V918000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the bumper reverse light assembly, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 30, 2025.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is D7B.
24V918000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V929000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 RPOD RPT197 and RPT205 travel trailers.  The propane tank tray may be missing the required number of fasteners, allowing the tanks to detach.
24V929000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached tank can become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V929000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to remove the tanks until the repair is performed.  Dealers will install the correct number of fasteners, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 3, 2025.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-642-3119.  Forest River's number for this recall is 80-1877.
24V929000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V933000.DESC_DEFECT: VinFast Auto, LLC (VinFast) is recalling certain 2023-2025 VF8 vehicles.  The center air bag mounted in the driver's seat may deploy improperly during a side impact crash and strike the driver's arm.
24V933000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that strikes the driver increases the risk of injury.
24V933000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the center air bag, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 23, 2025.  Owners may contact VinFast customer service at 1-833-503-0600.
24V933000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V934000.DESC_DEFECT: Cummins, Inc. (Cummins) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Power Generation C275D2RE trailer-mounted generators. The unsecured wire leads may chafe against the starter motor housing or terminal and short circuit.
24V934000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A short increases the risk of electrical shock or a fire.
24V934000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Distributors or warranty repair locations will inspect and repair the generator set wiring harness and secure the wiring leads, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 7, 2025.  Owners may contact Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467.  Cummins' number for this recall is C5807.
24V934000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V935000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024 Cybertruck, 2017-2025 Model 3, and 2020-2025 Model Y vehicles.  The tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) warning light may not remain illuminated between drive cycles, failing to warn the driver of low tire pressure.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring Systems."
24V935000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Driving with improperly inflated tires increases the risk of a crash.
24V935000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla released an over-the-air (OTA) software update, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 15, 2025.  Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752.  Tesla's number for this recall is SB-24-00-018.
24V935000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V942000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2025 Ram 1500 pickup trucks.  Incorrect headlight module software may cause the headlights to become inoperative.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V942000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Inoperative headlights can reduce visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V942000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the headlight module software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 6, 2025.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is D4B.
24V942000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V943000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Alfa Romeo Giulia and Alfa Romeo Stelvio vehicles.  The fastener that connects the brake pedal and the brake booster may have been improperly assembled during manufacturing, which can cause the brake pedal to detach from the brake booster.
24V943000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Brake pedal detachment can cause a loss of brake function and increase the risk of a crash.
24V943000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair, the brake booster connection, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 18, 2025.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is E0B.
24V943000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V016000.DESC_DEFECT: E-One Incorporated (E-One) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Cyclone 2, Cyclone N, Typhoon N, and 2023 Cyclone E vehicles.  The steering assist bracket may have been machined incorrectly.
24V016000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The incorrectly machined bracket may cause a reduction in hydraulic force, requiring greater steering effort and increasing the risk of a crash.
24V016000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the steering assist bracket, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 7, 2024.  Owners may contact E-One customer service at 1-352-237-1122.
24V016000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V019000.DESC_DEFECT: Newmar Corporation (Newmar) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Dutch Star, Mountain Aire, London Aire, Essex, and 2016 London Aire motorhomes.  The pedestal mounting plate may be improperly welded, causing the plate to separate and the seat assembly to loosen or detach.  As such, these seat assemblies fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 207, ÂSeating Systems,", and number 210, "Seat belt assembly anchorages."
24V019000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose or detached seat assembly increases the risk of injury.
24V019000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect for a missing weld, and replace the pedestal as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 31, 2024.  Owners may contact Newmar customer service at 1-800-731-8300.  Newmar's number for this recall is 608 RSB.
24V019000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V020000.DESC_DEFECT: Morgan Motor Company Limited (MMC) is recalling certain 2023 Super 3 motorcycles.  The pedal box housing may have been improperly welded, which can result in the hydraulic seal between the hose and master cylinder breaking, causing a loss of brake function.
24V020000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Reduced braking performance or a total loss of braking ability can increase the risk of a crash.
24V020000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the pedal box assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 31, 2024.  Owners may contact MMC customer service at 1-749-656-2632.  MMC's number for this recall is MMC2023-001.
24V020000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V028000.DESC_DEFECT: Marion Body Works Inc. (Marion) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Pumper, Rescue, Aerial, and RPM vehicles equipped with Weldon 8X16 Input-Output nodes.  In the event of a short circuit or wiring failure, the firmware in the node may fail to shut off the output pin, resulting in overloaded electrical circuits.
24V028000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overloaded electrical circuits can overheat, increasing the risk of fire.
24V028000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Maron will work with the equipment manufacturer Weldon to update the firmware, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 26, 2024.  Owners may contact Marion Body Works customer service at 1-715-754-5261.
24V028000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V034000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024 Coachmen Nova Class B motorhomes.  The liquid level remote fill gauge on the propane tank may leak when in the "Open" position.
24V034000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.
24V034000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the bleed valve on the propane tank, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 31, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 1-574-825-6225.  Forest River's number for this recall is 225-1696.
24V034000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V037000.DESC_DEFECT: Brinkley RV (Brinkley) is recalling certain 2024 Model Z recreational vehicles.  The axle spindle weld may fail, resulting in the wheel assembly detaching from the axle.
24V037000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Wheel assembly detachment increases the risk of a crash.
24V037000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the axles as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed in February 05, 2024.  Owners may contact Brinkley customer service at 1-574-501-4280.  Brinkley's number for this recall is REC-2401.
24V037000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V048000.DESC_DEFECT: Blue Bird Body Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2024 Vision buses.  The parking brake secondary release mechanism may malfunction and allow the lever to be released without pressing the release button.
24V048000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A parking brake malfunction may result in a vehicle roll-away, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V048000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealer will inspect and replace service brake lever as needed, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 04, 2024.  Owners may contact Blue Bird customer service at 1-478-822-2242.
24V048000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov. Please be reminded of the following requirements:You are required to submit a draft owner notification letter to this office no less than five days prior to mailing it to the customers.Also, copies of all notices, bulletins, dealer notifications, and other communications that relate to this recall, including a copy of the final owner notification letter and any subsequent owner follow-up notification letter(s), are required to be submitted to this office no later than 5 days after they are originally sent (if they are sent to more than one manufacturer, distributor, dealer, or purchaser/owner).Please be reminded that under 49 U.S.C. Â§ 30118(f), submission of eight consecutive quarterly reports followed by three annual reports is required. As described in 573.7, submission of the first of eight consecutive quarterly status reports is required within one month after the close of the calendar quarter in which notification to purchasers occurs. Therefore, the first quarterly report will be due on, or before, 30 days after the close of the calendar quarter. The first of three consecutive annual status reports will be due on, or before, 1 year after the eighth quarterly report was submitted.

24V052000.DESC_DEFECT: Shyft Group is recalling certain 2023-2025 Spartan RV K2, K3, and K4 chassis.  The steering gear may have foreign material inside the gear that could build pressure within the system, resulting in a loss of power steering assist.
24V052000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden loss of power steering assist can increase the risk of a crash.
24V052000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Shyft Group will remove and replace the steering gear, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 21, 2024.  Owners may contact Shyft Group customer service at 1-800-237-7806.  Shyft Group's number for this recall is 24-01.
24V052000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V056000.DESC_DEFECT: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2021-2023 XE35, XE40, 2021-2024 XE60, and 2023-2024 XHE40 vehicles.  One or more drain valves may not activate as intended, which could allow battery packs to accumulate liquid in the battery pack enclosure.
24V056000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The accumulation of liquid inside the battery pack enclosure may lead to an electrical short, increasing the risk of a fire.
24V056000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: New Flyer will remove the rubber washer from the affected drain valves, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 14, 2024.  Owners may contact New Flyer customer service at 1-204-224-6706.  New Flyer's number for this recall is R24-02.  This recall is in addition to NHTSA recall number 23V-083.  Certain vehicles are affected by both recalls and will need to have both remedies performed.
24V056000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V058000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Western Star 49X and 2025 Freightliner Cascadia vehicles.  The Electronic Stability Control (ESC) software has incorrect axle spacing parameters.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 136, "Electronic Stability Control Systems on Heavy Vehicles."
24V058000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect parameters can decrease vehicle stability or braking performance, increasing the risk of crash.
24V058000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the ESC software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 22, 2024.  Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712.  DTNA's number for this recall is FL993.
24V058000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V060000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2020-2024 Chevrolet Silverado 2500, 3500, GMC Sierra 2500 and 3500 vehicles equipped with power-unlatching tailgates.  The tailgate's electronic gate-release switch may short circuit due to water intrusion, which can result in the tailgate inadvertently unlatching while the vehicle is in park.
24V060000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unlatched tailgate may open while driving and result in a loss of unsecured cargo, creating a road hazard and increasing the risk of a crash.
24V060000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to check that the tailgate is closed and latched before driving.  Dealers will replace the exterior touchpad switch assemblies, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 17, 2024.  Owners may contact Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020 or GMC customer service at 1-800-462-8782.  GM's number for this recall is N232426400.
24V060000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V064000.DESC_DEFECT: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Pilot, Accord, Civic sedan, HR-V, Odyssey, 2020 Civic coupe, Fit, 2021-2022 Civic hatchback, 2021 Civic Type R, Insight, 2020-2021 CR-V, CR-V Hybrid, Passport, Ridgeline, Accord Hybrid, 2020 Acura MDX, 2022 Acura MDX, 2020-2022 Acura RDX, and 2020-2021 Acura TLX vehicles.  The front passenger seat weight sensor may crack and short circuit, failing to suppress the air bag as intended.
24V064000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that deploys unintentionally during a crash can increase the risk of injury.
24V064000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the seat weight sensors, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 28, 2024.  This is a phased recall.  Owners may contact Honda customer service at 1-888-234-2138.  Honda's numbers for these recalls are XHP and VHQ.
24V064000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V066000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Salem and Wildwood fifth wheel travel trailers.  The Federal Placard may have incorrect tire size information.  As such, these trailers fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other Than Passenger Cars."
24V066000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect tire size information could result in the wrong tires being installed on the trailer, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V066000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will mail new federal placards, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 13, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 1-574-534-3167.  Forest River's number for this recall is 69-1731.
24V066000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V084000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Western Star 49X vehicles.  The suspension hanger may fail due to missing welds, which can result in difficulty steering and maintaining the direction of the front two wheels.
24V084000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Difficulty steering and a loss of directional control increases the risk of a crash.
24V084000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: DTNA will replace the suspension hanger, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 22, 2024.  Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 800-745-8000.  DTNA's number for this recall is FL994.
24V084000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V082000.DESC_DEFECT: Braun Ambulances (Braun) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Chief XL Type I, Chief XL Type III, Express Plus Type I, Express Type III, and Liberty Type I vehicles.  The high contact nodes may cause the module mounted turn signals, backup alarm, brake lights, and rearview camera to turn on intermittently or fail to activate.
24V082000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Failure of vital visual systems reduce the vehicle's visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V082000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the node and update the software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 26, 2024.  Owners may contact Braun customer service at 419-232-7020.  Braun's number for this recall is 2024-2.
24V082000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V107000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2015-2016 Genesis, 2017-2019 Genesis G80, Genesis G90, and 2019 Genesis G70 vehicles.  Water may enter the starter solenoid and cause an electrical short, which can result in an engine compartment fire while parked or driving.
24V107000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine compartment fire while parked or driving can increase the risk of injury.
24V107000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures until the recall repair is complete.  Dealers will install a remedy relay kit in the engine junction box, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 15, 2024.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's numbers for this recall are 254(H) and 018G(G).
24V107000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V284000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling one 2024 Model 3 vehicle.  The driver seat side air bag module was assembled without a deflector that directs gas flow during deployment.
24V284000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Without a deflector, the air bag may deploy improperly, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
24V284000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla service replaced the side air bag, free of charge.  The affected vehicle was repaired April 12, 2024.  Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752.  Tesla's number for this recall is SB-24-13-001.
24V284000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V112000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023 Chrysler 300, Dodge Charger, and Dodge Challenger vehicles.  The parking brake may be improperly adjusted, which can result in a vehicle roll away.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 135, "Light Vehicle Brake Systems."
24V112000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A vehicle roll away increases the risk of a crash or injury.
24V112000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will properly adjust the parking brake, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 29, 2024.  Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  Chrysler's number for this recall is 01B.
24V112000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V130000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee and Jeep Grand Cherokee L vehicles.  When the master headlight switch is set to the AUTO position, the driver may be unable to quickly activate the high beams.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V130000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: High beam headlights that do not activate as intended can reduce visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V130000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reconfigure the vehicle high beam parameters, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 7, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is 12B.
24V130000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V139000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2024 XM vehicles.  The tailgate panel may detach from the mounting structure due to improper adhesive bonding that occurred during manufacturing.
24V139000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A panel that detaches from a vehicle can become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V139000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the tailgate panel as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 17, 2024.  Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417.
24V139000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V146000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2015-2016 Elantra vehicles.  The trunk latch may become damaged, preventing the opening of the trunk from the inside.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 401, "Internal Trunk Release."
24V146000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A person inside the trunk compartment may become trapped, increasing their risk of injury.
