24V845000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached solar panel can become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V845000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install butyl adhesive tape between the solar panel and mounting bracket, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 15, 2024.  Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-574-825-5280 Ext. 5220.  Winnebago's number for this recall is CAM0000040.
24V845000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V849000.DESC_DEFECT: Vancraft LLC (Vancraft) is recalling certain 2002-2006 Campervan vehicles.  Incorrect seat belt anchor hardware was used on the rear bench seats.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies."
24V849000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The incorrect hardware may fail, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
24V849000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the seat belt anchor hardware, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 19, 2024.  Owners may contact Vancraft customer service at 1-888-381-7333.
24V849000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V851000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 F-150, 2024 Expedition and 2024 Lincoln Navigator vehicles equipped with a 3.5L GTDI engine.  The engines may have a misaligned engine cup plug, which can result in a rapid oil leak.
24V851000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rapid oil leak can result in an engine stall, increasing the risk of a crash.  In addition, an oil leak in the presence of an ignition source such as hot engine or exhaust components, can increase the risk of a fire.
24V851000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the engine cup plug alignment, and replace the plug if necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on May 23, 2024.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S70.
24V851000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V853000.DESC_DEFECT: Diamond C Trailer MFG (Diamond C) is recalling certain 2023-2024 MFG and Pacesetter trailers.  Please see the recall report for a complete list of models.  The weld between the axle frame bracket assembly and frame may fail, reducing the trailer's stability while being towed.
24V853000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Instability can increase the risk of a crash.
24V853000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a locking flange nut to the torsion hanger frame, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 15, 2025.  Owners may contact Diamond C customer service at 1-903-572-2834.
24V853000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.Please be reminded of the following requirements:You are required to submit a draft owner notification letter to this office no less than five days prior to mailing it to the customers.Also, copies of all notices, bulletins, dealer notifications, and other communications that relate to this recall, including a copy of the final owner notification letter and any subsequent owner follow-up notification letter(s), are required to be submitted to this office no later than 5 days after they are originally sent (if they are sent to more than one manufacturer, distributor, dealer, or purchaser/owner).Please be reminded that under 49 U.S.C. Â§ 30112(a)(3), it is illegal for a manufacturer, to sell, offer for sale, import, or introduce or deliver into interstate commerce, a motor vehicle or item of motor vehicle equipment that contains a safety defect once the manufacturer has notified NHTSA about that safety defect.This prohibition does not apply once the motor vehicle or motor vehicle equipment has been remedied according to the manufacturer's instructions.As stated in 49 U.S.C. Â§ 30118(f), submission of eight consecutive quarterly reports followed by three annual reports is required.As described in 573.7, submission of the first of eight consecutive quarterly status reports is required within one month after the close of the calendar quarter in which notification to purchasers occurs.Therefore, the first quarterly report will be due on, or before, 30 days after the close of the calendar quarter.The first of three consecutive annual status reports will be due on, or before, 1 year after the eighth quarterly report was submitted.

24V857000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023 Alfa Romeo Stelvio vehicles that were previously remedied under NHTSA recall number 24V-512.  The tire size information on the tire placard is incorrect.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
24V857000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect tire information can result in installing the incorrect-size tires, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V857000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: FCA will mail corrected tire placard labels.  Owners may bring the label into a dealer for free installation.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 12, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA US customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US's number for this recall is C3B.  Vehicles previously repaired under recall 24V-512 will need to have the new remedy completed.
24V857000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V861000.DESC_DEFECT: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2022 Imagine, Reflection, Momentum, Solitude, and Transcend travel trailers.  The quick disconnect fittings in the LP gas system may be cracked, causing a gas leak.
24V861000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A gas leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
24V861000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace quick disconnect as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 6, 2024.  Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679.  Grand Design's number for this recall is 910045.  This recall supersedes Grand Design RV recall 22V308.
24V861000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V868000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2022-2024 IONIQ 5, 2023-2025 IONIQ 6, Genesis GV60, Genesis GV70 "Electrified," and Genesis G80 "Electrified" vehicles.  The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become damaged and stop charging the 12-volt battery, which can result in a loss of drive power.
24V868000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
24V868000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the ICCU and its fuse, as necessary.  In addition, dealers will update the ICCU software.  All repairs will be performed free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 20, 2024.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460 or Genesis customer service at 1-844-340-9741.  Hyundai's numbers for this recall are 272 (Hyundai) and 025G (Genesis).  This recall expands and replaces previous recall number 24V-204. Vehicles previously repaired under recall 24V-204 will need to have the new remedy completed.
24V868000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V899000.DESC_DEFECT: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2025 Arcadia and Cougar trailers equipped with Curt Helux Pin Boxes.  The pin box fasteners may have been improperly tightened.
24V899000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The fasteners can loosen and fall out, allowing the towed vehicle to detach from the pin box and increasing the risk of a crash.
24V899000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will tighten the pin box fasteners, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 10, 2025.  Owners may contact Keystone customer service at 1-866-425-4369.  Keystone's number for this recall is 24-459.
24V899000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V886000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024 Model Y vehicles.  The weld attaching the seat recliner mechanism to the front seat backs may fail.
24V886000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The seat back frame may not properly restrain the occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
24V886000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla service will replace the seat assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 21, 2025.  Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752.  Tesla's number for this recall is SB-24-13-004.
24V886000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V891000.DESC_DEFECT: Pagani S.p.A (Pagani) is recalling certain 2024 Utopia vehicles.  The passenger side dashboard panel may have been manufactured incorrectly, which can cause the air bag not to deploy as intended.
24V891000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: During air bag deployment, the dashboard panel may damage the air bag or cause the air bag to deploy improperly, increasing the risk of injury.
24V891000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will repair the dashboard panel by applying kevlar strips, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 12, 2024.  Owners may contact Pagani S.p.A customer service at +39 059 4739201.
24V891000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V894000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2024 Chevrolet Silverado HD 2500, 3500, and GMC Sierra HD 2500, 3500 vehicles equipped with power-unlatching tailgates.  The tailgate's electronic gate-release switch may short circuit due to water intrusion, which can result in the tailgate inadvertently unlatching while the vehicle is in Park.
24V894000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unlatched tailgate may open and result in a loss of unsecured cargo, creating a road hazard and increasing the risk of a crash.
24V894000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to check that the tailgate is closed and latched before driving.  Dealers will replace the exterior touchpad switch assemblies, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 17, 2024.  Owners may contact Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020 or GMC customer service at 1-800-462-8782.  GM's number for this recall is N242469160.  This recall is an expansion of NHTSA Recall 24V-060.
24V894000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V901000.DESC_DEFECT: McLaren Automotive Incorporated (McClaren) is recalling certain 2021 765LT Coupe vehicles.  The rear cabin window may have insufficient adhesive bonding, which can allow the window to detach from the support frame.
24V901000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rear window that detaches from the vehicle can create a road hazard for other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V901000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install bespoke fasteners into each corner of the polycarbonate panel, free of charge.  Interim owner notification letters explaining the safety risk were mailed on December 4, 2024.  Owners will receive a second notice when remedy parts become available, anticipated late September 2025.  Owners may contact McClaren customer service at 1-646-429-8916.  McClaren's number for this recall is 2024/002.
24V901000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V921000.DESC_DEFECT: Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2023 Low Floor diesel-hybrid transit buses.  During vehicle operations in full electric vehicle (EV) mode, the odometer will not display accumulated mileage.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."
24V921000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A missing odometer reading could lead to an unintended delay in critical safety-related maintenance, potentially impairing the safe operation of the vehicle and increasing the risk of a crash.
24V921000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Gillig will install a new speedometer gauge, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed December 20, 2024.  Owners may contact Gillig customer service at 1-800-735-1500 or 1-510-264-5073.
24V921000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V931000.DESC_DEFECT: Featherlite Trailer Manufacturing, LLC (Featherlite) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Living Quarters Horse Trailers, models 7821, 7841, 9807, and 9808.  The cooktop may have a rubber gas line instead of a copper line.
24V931000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The rubber line may overheat, increasing the risk of a fire.
24V931000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a copper extension, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 8, 2025.  Owners may contact Featherlite customer service at 1-800-800-1230.
24V931000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V950000.DESC_DEFECT: Acura (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2021-2023 TLX vehicles.  The fuel filler neck and fuel tank may have been improperly welded, which can result in a fuel leak.
24V950000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.
24V950000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the fuel tank assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 3, 2025.  Owners may contact Honda customer service at 1-888-234-2138.  Acura's number for this recall is JKX.
24V950000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V965000.DESC_DEFECT: Orange EV is recalling certain 2023-2024 HUSK-e, 2023-2025 e-TRIEVER, and 2017-2024 T-Series trucks.  The front side marker lights may be missing, and the passenger front side reflectors may be in the incorrect location.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V965000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Missing or incorrectly positioned lights and reflectors can reduce the trailers visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V965000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to limit on-road use while operating without a trailer until the remedy is available.  Orange EV will install front side marker lights and relocate the front reflectors, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2025.  Owners may contact Orange EV customer service at 1-866-688-5223.
24V965000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V967000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Model S and Model X vehicles.  The driver's air bag could tear during deployment.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 208, "Occupant Crash Protection" and 212, "Windshield Mounting."
24V967000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A torn air bag may not adequately protect an occupant in a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
24V967000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla service will replace the air bag assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 21, 2025.  Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752.  Tesla's number for this recall is SB-24-20-001.
24V967000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V971000.DESC_DEFECT: GEM WAEV LLC (GEM) is recalling certain 2024-2025 e2, e4, e6, and eLXD vehicles.  The mounting screws between the ball joint and the hub strut may have been improperly tightened, resulting in ball joint separation from the wheel.
24V971000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Ball joint separation can cause a loss of steering control, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V971000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will tighten the mounting screws, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 31, 2025.  Owners may contact GEM customer service at 1-800-688-8680. This recall is superseded by NHTSA recall 25V-380.
24V971000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V242000.DESC_DEFECT: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2019 G5 school buses.  A LIN gateway module may fail causing the defrosting system to be inoperative.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 103, "Windshield Defrosting and Defogging Systems."
24V242000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An inoperative windshield defrosting system may decrease the driver's visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V242000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealer will replace the LIN gateway module, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 17, 2024.  Owners may contact Micro Bird customer service at 1-819-477-2012.  Micro Bird's number for this recall is 24-105-CUS.
24V242000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V246000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2024 Santa Fe vehicles.  The rearview camera image may be obstructed by a trailer parking assist message.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
24V246000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An obstructed rearview camera image reduces rearward visibility and increases the risk of a crash or injury.
24V246000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Hyundai will release an over-the-air (OTA) software update.  Owner notification letters were mailed beginning May 31, 2024.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 258.
24V246000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V274000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Prius and Prius Prime vehicles.  Water may enter the rear door switch and cause a short circuit, allowing an unlocked rear door to open unexpectedly.
24V274000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A door that unexpectedly opens while the vehicle is moving or during a crash increases the risk of injury.
24V274000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace both right and left rear door opener switches, free of charge.  Owner letters were mailed August 9, 2024.  Owners may contact Toyota customer service at 1-800-331-4331.  Toyota's numbers for this recall are 24TB06 and 24TA06.
24V274000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V276000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024 Cybertruck vehicles.  The accelerator pedal pad may dislodge and cause the pedal to become trapped by the interior trim.
24V276000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A trapped accelerator pedal can cause the vehicle to accelerate unintentionally, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V276000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla service will replace or repair the accelerator pedal assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 18, 2024.  Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752.  Tesla's number for this recall is SB-24-33-003.
24V276000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V278000.MFGNAME: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
24V278000.DESC_DEFECT: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Jaguar) is recalling certain 2021-2023 E-Pace vehicles.  The passenger air bag may tear during deployment.
24V278000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A torn air bag may not adequately protect an occupant in a crash, increasing the risk of injury.  Additionally, a torn air bag may allow the escape of hot gases which can burn an occupant.
24V278000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the passenger air bag module, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 30, 2024.  Owners may contact Jaguar customer service at 1-800-452-4827.  Jaguar's number for this recall is H491.
24V278000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V279000.DESC_DEFECT: REV Recreation Group (REV) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Fleetwood Discovery and Holiday Rambler Endeavor motorhomes, equipped with Remco 50-54 Rebel 4.0 GPM water pumps.  The water pump harness was designed with inadequate fuse protection.
24V279000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Inadequate fuse protection may cause harness damage, increasing the risk of a fire.
24V279000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and relocate the water pump circuit to a properly sized fuse as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 15, 2024.  Owners may contact REV customer service at 1-800-509-3417.  REV's number for this recall is 240416REV.
24V279000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V286000.DESC_DEFECT: Alliance RV, LLC (Alliance) is recalling certain 2022 Paradigm 295MK, and Avenue 32RLS fifth wheels.  The freshwater tank may be installed incorrectly, which can result in the tank detaching from the vehicle.
24V286000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A freshwater tank that detaches from a vehicle can become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V286000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will remount the freshwater tank, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 22, 2024.  Owners may contact Alliance customer service at 1-574-218-7165.
24V286000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V289000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
24V289000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Jeep Grand Cherokee and 2023-2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee L vehicles.  An improperly connected coaxial cable may prevent the rearview camera image from displaying.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
24V289000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera image that does not display decreases the driver's visibility, increasing the risk of injury or crash.
24V289000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will secure the coaxial cable connection, free of charge.  All affected vehicles have been remedied.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US, LLC's number for this recall is 40B.
24V289000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V299000.DESC_DEFECT: Highland Ridge RV (Highland Ridge) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Mesa Ridge TT, Mesa Ridge XLT FW, Open Range Roamer FW, Open Range TT, Silverstar TT, and Silverstar XLT FW trailers.  The LED backlight circuit board in the cooktop range may fail, causing the board to overheat.
24V299000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A circuit board that overheats increases the risk of a fire.
24V299000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will disconnect and cut the circuit powering the LED backlights and terminate the wiring, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 22, 2024.  Owners may contact Highland Ridge customer service at 1-800-283-8267.  Highland Ridge's number for this recall is 9904606.
24V299000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V307000.DESC_DEFECT: Braun Ambulances (Braun Ambulances) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Chief XL I, Chief XL III, Express Plus I, Express III, and Liberty I vehicles.  In the event of a short circuit or wiring failure, the firmware in the node may fail to shut off the output pin, resulting in overloaded electrical circuits.
24V307000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overloaded electrical circuits can overheat, increasing the risk of fire.
24V307000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the firmware, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 17, 2024.  Owners may contact Braun Ambulances customer service at 1-877-344-9990.  Braun Ambulances number for this recall is 24-003.
24V307000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V313000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2011, 2016-2019, 2021-2024 Rockport Work Trucks.  The rear liftgate may have been installed without a U-bolt on the driver and passenger side, which can allow the liftgate to fall to the ground when loaded.
24V313000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A liftgate that falls unexpectedly increases the risk of injury.
24V313000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the U-bolts, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 17, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 1-574-522-7599.  Forest River's number for this recall is 65-1700.
24V313000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V315000.DESC_DEFECT: Heartland Recreational Vehicles, LLC (Heartland) is recalling certain 2024 Eddie Bauer travel trailers.  The tire placards indicate an incorrect tire size.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other Than Passenger Cars."
24V315000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect tire size information can allow the incorrect tires to be installed on the trailer, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V315000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Heartland will mail out replacement certification labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 14, 2024.   Owners may contact Heartland customer service at 1-877-262-8032.
24V315000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V323000.DESC_DEFECT: Spartan Fire, LLC (Spartan Fire) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Gladiator, Metro Star, and 2023-2024 FC-94 vehicles.  The seat mount fastener may be undersized and could break.  As such, these vehicles may fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 207, "Seating Systems."
24V323000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken fastener can allow the seat to move, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
24V323000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the fastener as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 27, 2024.  Owners may contact Spartan Fire customer service at 1-517-543-6400.  Spartan Fire's number for this recall is 24007.
24V323000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V327000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2024-2025 X5 xDrive40i vehicles.  The tire information placard may indicate an incorrect tire size and tire pressure.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
24V327000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect tire information can allow an incorrectly sized tire to be installed or result in improperly inflated tires, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V327000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the tire information placard, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 9, 2024.  Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417.
24V327000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V328000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
24V328000.DESC_DEFECT: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova) is recalling certain 2022-2023 LFS vehicles.  Insufficient crimping may allow the secondary fuel filter hoses to disconnect and leak.
24V328000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.  Additionally, a lack of fuel can cause an engine stall, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V328000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until the repair has been performed.  Dealers will replace the secondary fuel filter hoses, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 05, 2024.  Owners may contact Nova customer service at 1-800-350-6682.  Nova's number for this recall is CR5595.
24V328000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V344000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (VW) is recalling certain 2021-2023 ID.4 vehicles.  Due to a software issue, affected vehicles may experience center displays and instrument panel displays that do not boot, or that sporadically reset.  This can result in loss of speedometer information or loss of rearview camera image.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 101, "Control and Displays" and 111, "Rear Visibility."
24V344000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Displays that do not show critical information, such as vehicle speed or the rearview camera image, increase the risk of a crash.
24V344000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the vehicle software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on December 20, 2024.  Owners may contact VW customer service at 1-800-893-5298.  VW's number for this recall is 919A.
24V344000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V377000.DESC_DEFECT: Lion Electric Company (Lion Electric) is recalling certain 2024-2025 LionC school buses.  The parking brake may malfunction and allow the lever to be released without pressing the release button.
24V377000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A parking brake that is released unexpectedly may result in a vehicle roll away, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
24V377000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Lion Electric will provide inspection instructions to owners, and replace the parking brake levers as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 25, 2024.  Owners may contact Lion Electric customer service at 1-855-546-6706.  Lion Electric's number for this recall is R2024-01-009.
24V377000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V352000.DESC_DEFECT: The Braun Corporation (Braun) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Chrysler Voyager vehicles, equipped with certain GO-ES Space Saver Foldaway Seats.  The recliner mechanism may not engage when the seat back is fully reclined.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."
24V352000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The seat back could release when force is applied to the shoulder belt, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
24V352000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the seat as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 3, 2024.  Owners may contact Braun customer service at 1-800-488-0359.
24V352000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V361000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Q4 E-TRON and Q4 E-TRON Sportback vehicles.  The incorrect headlight control module software may have been installed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V361000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect headlight control module software may cause the parking lights not to operate as intended when the headlights are turned on and the turn signals are activated, which can reduce vehicle visibility and increase the risk of a crash.
24V361000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the headlight control module with a new data set, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 6, 2024.  Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Audi's number for this recall is 941L.
24V361000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V372000.COMPNAME: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:PROPULSION SYSTEM:TRACTION BATTERY:MANAGEMENT SYSTEM/ENERGY CONTROL MODULE (BMS/BECM):SOFTWARE
24V372000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2024 EQE 350 4MATIC, EQE 350+, EQE 500 4MATIC, EQS 450 4MATIC, EQS 450+, EQS 580 4MATIC, AMG EQE 53 4MATIC, AMG EQS 53 4MATIC, 2023-2025 EQE SUV 350 4MATIC, EQE SUV 350+, EQE SUV 500 4MATIC, EQS SUV 450 4MATIC, EQS SUV 450+, EQS SUV 580 4MATIC, 2024-2025 EQS SUV 680 4MATIC, and AMG EQE SUV 53 4MATIC vehicles.  The battery management system software may cause the high-voltage battery to shut down, which can result in a sudden loss of drive power.
24V372000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
24V372000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the battery management system software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 5, 2024.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.  MBUSA's number for this recall is 2024060002.
24V372000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V402000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2025 Freightliner Cascadia, 108SD, 114SD, Business Class M2, Western Star 47X, 49X, Freightliner Custom Chassis S2RV 106, and S2C 106 transit buses, cabs, and chassis.  The front axle tie rod ball joint studs may crack and break, which can result in tie rod separation.
24V402000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Tie rod separation can cause a sudden loss of steering control and increase the risk of a crash.
24V402000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the tie rod assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 25, 2024.  Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 800-745-8000.  DTNA's number for this recall is D24R6.
24V402000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V382000.DESC_DEFECT: Driverge Vehicle Innovations (Driverge) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Ford T-350 vehicles, equipped with certain GO-ES Space Saver Foldaway Seats.  The recliner mechanism may not engage when the seat back is fully reclined.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."
24V382000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The seat back could release when force is applied to the shoulder belt, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
24V382000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Driverge will work with the equipment manufacturer to inspect and repair the seats as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 29, 2024.  Owners may contact Driverge customer service at 1-330-861-1118 or Freedman customer service at 1-800-443-4540.
24V382000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V396000.DESC_DEFECT: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2025 VN, VNRe, and VHD trucks.  The drag link may contain an improperly heat-treated ball stud that can fail, resulting in a sudden loss of steering control.
24V396000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden loss of steering control increases the risk of a crash.
24V396000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicle until the repair has been performed.  Dealers will inspect and replace the drag links, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 20, 2024.  Owners may contact Volvo Trucks customer service at 1-800-528-6586.  Volvo Truck's number for this recall is RVXX2402.
24V396000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V398000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2025 Mack AN, GR, and TE trucks.  The drag link may contain an improperly heat-treated ball stud that can fail, resulting in a sudden loss of steering control.
24V398000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden loss of steering control increases the risk of a crash.
24V398000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until the remedy has been completed.  Dealers will inspect and replace the drag links, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 20, 2024.  Owners may contact Mack customer service at 1-800-866-1177.  Mack's number for this recall is SC0465.
24V398000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V401000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Thomas Built Buses Saf-T-Liner C2 and 2025 Thomas Built Buses Safe-T-Liner EFX school buses.  The front axle tie rod ball joint studs may crack and break, which can result in tie rod separation.
24V401000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Tie rod separation can cause a sudden loss of steering control and increase the risk of a crash.
24V401000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the tie rod assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 25, 2024.  Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 800-745-8000.  DTNA's number for this recall is D24R6.
24V401000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V376000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2012-2024 Model S, 2015-2024 Model X, 2017-2023 Model 3, and 2020-2023 Model Y vehicles.  In the event of an unbelted driver, the seat belt warning light and audible chime may not activate as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
24V376000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat belt warning system that fails to alert occupants of an unbelted seat belt can increase the risk of injury during a crash.
24V376000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla will release an over-the-air (OTA) software update.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 26, 2024.  Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752.  Tesla's number for this recall is SB-24-00-008.
24V376000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V408000.DESC_DEFECT: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2022-2024 R1T and R1S vehicles.  The attachment clips on the upper B-pillar and/or C-pillar trim panels may have been damaged during a service procedure.
24V408000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Damaged pillar trim panel clips can result in improper side curtain air bag deployment, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
24V408000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Rivian will replace the pillar trim panels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 16, 2024.  Owners may contact Rivian customer service at 1-888-748-4261.  Rivian's number for this recall is FSAM 1464.
24V408000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V409000.DESC_DEFECT: McClain Trailers Inc. (McClain Trailers) is recalling certain 2024 10K, 12K, 15K, and 18K boat trailers.  The Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) listed on the trailer brake actuator is incorrect, which can allow it to become overloaded.
24V409000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overloaded trailer brake actuator can increase the risk of a crash.
24V409000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: McClain Trailers will mail corrected labels to owners, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 23, 2024.  Owners may contact McClain Trailers customer service at 1-713-675-2761.
24V409000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V415000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022 Dodge Durango and Ram 2500 and 3500 vehicles.  Due to a software malfunction, the ABS control module may disable the electronic stability control system.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 126, "Electronic Stability Control Systems."
24V415000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Driving with a disabled electronic stability control system can increase the risk of a crash.
24V415000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the ABS control module software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed beginning July 11, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US, LLC's number for this recall is 55B.
24V415000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V607000.DESC_DEFECT: REV Recreation Group (REV) is recalling certain 2019-2025 Holiday Rambler Admiral, 2018 Holiday Rambler Admiral XE, Fleetwood Storm, 2023-2025 Holiday Rambler Eclipse, Fleetwood Flex, 2018-2025 Fleetwood Flair, 2020-2024 Fleetwood Fortis, 2020-2025 Holiday Rambler Invicta, 2018-2023 Fleetwood Pace Arrow, and 2018-2019 Holiday Rambler Vacationer XE motorhomes, equipped with the HappiJac drop down bed option.  The front overhead cabinet fasteners can break, allowing the overhead cabinet to detach.
24V607000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A cabinet that detaches while the vehicle is in motion can distract the driver, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V607000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and install new hardware and fasteners as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 7, 2024.  Owners may contact REV customer service at 1-800-509-3417.  REV's number for this recall is 240809REV.
24V607000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V425000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
24V425000.DESC_DEFECT: New Flyer of America, Inc.  (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2023 XD35, XD40, and XD60 vehicles equipped with certain Cummins L9 diesel engines.  The remote fuel filter hoses may become separated from the fitting, which can result in a fuel leak and a lack of fuel supply to the engine.
24V425000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.  Additionally, a lack of fuel can cause an engine stall, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V425000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Cummins will replace the fuel filter hoses, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed July 21, 2024.  Owners may contact New Flyer customer service at 1-800-241-2947.
24V425000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V427000.DESC_DEFECT: Thor Motor Coach (TMC) is recalling certain 2025 Thor Tranquility and Sanctuary motorhomes.  A 50 AMP circuit breaker was incorrectly installed when a 20 AMP breaker is required, which can result in overheated wiring.
24V427000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Wiring that overheats increases the risk of a fire.
24V427000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a 20 AMP circuit breaker, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 29, 2024.  Owners may contact TMC customer service at 1-877-500-1020.  TMC's number for this recall is RC000305.
24V427000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V434000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023 Jeep Grand Cherokee vehicles.  A bolt for the second-row seat belt buckle may not be tightened properly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."
24V434000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly secured seat belt buckle may not properly restrain occupants during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
24V434000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and tighten the second-row seat buckle bolt as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 9, 2024.  Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA US, LLC's number for this recall is 70B.
24V434000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V435000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2024 Jay Feather travel trailers.  A14-inch spare tire was mistakenly installed when the tire placard information is based on a 15-inch tire.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
24V435000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Referring to the placard, the operator can inflate the tire to an incorrect pressure, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V435000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the spare tire, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 28, 2024.  Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267.  Jayco's number for this recall is 9901609.
24V435000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V439000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2023-2024 aerial devices, digger diggers, pressure diggers, service trucks, reel lifters, pressure washers, and articulating crane models built on a Freightliner M2 Plus chassis.  Please refer to Altec's recall report for specific vehicle make and model details.  The lighting wire harness may be overloaded, preventing the vehicle lighting from illuminating.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V439000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Lights that fail to illuminate can reduce the vehicle's visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V439000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will rework the lighting wire harness and update the trailer module as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 8, 2024.  Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832.  Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3161; CSN-3170.
24V439000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V442000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
24V442000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2023 Toyota Crown vehicles equipped with rearview and/or frontview cameras.  Due to insufficient laser welding, the camera cases may separate, allowing water to leak into the cameras and short circuit.  The rearview and front view camera images may not appear on the displays or display a distorted image.
24V442000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera that does not display an image can reduce the driver's view, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V442000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the rearview and frontview cameras as necessary, free of charge.  Owner letters were mailed August 9, 2024. Owners may contact Toyota customer service at 1-800-331-4331.  Toyota's numbers for this recall are 24TB08 and 24TA08.
24V442000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V448000.DESC_DEFECT: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2011-2025 Micro Bird G5 school buses, equipped with certain tracked 2-place seats with lap and shoulder seat belts.  The seats may be improperly attached.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."
24V448000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly attached seat can detach in the event of a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
24V448000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Micro Bird will provide instructions on how to inspect and reattach the seats as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 14, 2024.  Owners may contact Micro Bird customer service at 1-819-477-2012.  Micro Bird's number for this recall is 24-108-TUS.
24V448000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V470000.DESC_DEFECT: Nissan North America, Inc. (INFINITI) is recalling certain 2011-2013 M56, 2012-2013 M35 Hybrid, 2014-2018 Q50, Q70 Hybrid, 2014-2019 Q70, and 2015-2019 Q70L two-wheel drive vehicles.  The driveshaft can fatigue and break.
24V470000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken driveshaft can result in a loss of drive power, or a vehicle roll away when the vehicle is in park without the parking brake applied.  Both scenarios can increase the risk of a crash.
24V470000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the driveshaft, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 13, 2024.  Owners may contact INFINITI's customer service at 1-800-662-6200.  INFINITI's numbers for this recall are R24A5 and R24A7.
24V470000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V506000.DESC_DEFECT: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2024 Tiffin Convoy, 2022 Cahaba, and 2023, 2025 Tiffin GH1 motorhomes.  The wheel bolts for the spare tire may be missing.
24V506000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A spare tire that is installed without the correct bolts can detach, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V506000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tiffin will mail the wheel bolts for the spare tire, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 27, 2024.  Owners may contact Tiffin customer service at 1-256-356-8661.  Tiffin's number for this recall is TIF-140.
24V506000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V477000.DESC_DEFECT: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Polestar 2 vehicles.  The Infotainment Head Unit (IHU) software may prevent the rearview camera image from displaying.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
24V477000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera image that does not display decreases the driver's visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V477000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Polestar has released an over-the-air IHU software update, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 9, 2024.  Owners may contact Polestar customer service at 1-800-806-2504.  Polestar's number for this recall is RP1016.
24V477000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V481000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Chevrolet Bolt EV and 2022 Chevrolet Bolt EUV vehicles that were previously remedied under recall number 21V-650.  The advanced diagnostic software may have been incorrectly installed and fail to detect defective battery modules, possibly resulting in a battery fire.
24V481000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A battery fire increases the risk of injury.
24V481000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to take the following interim steps:  Set the Target Charge Level feature in their vehicle to limit the charge level to 90%, charge their vehicle more frequently, avoid depleting the battery to 70 miles range remaining, park outside after charging, and do not charge the vehicle indoors overnight.  Dealers will reinstall the advanced diagnostic software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on August 1, 2024.  Owners may contact the Bolt EV Concierge Team at 1-833-382-4389.  GM's numbers for this recall are N242443000 and N242443002.
24V481000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V507000.DESC_DEFECT: Spartan Fire, LLC (Spartan Fire) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Gladiator, 2024-2025 Metro Star and 2024 KME Panther vehicles equipped with certain independent front suspension assemblies.  The lower control arm retention bolts could become brittle and break after being tightened.
24V507000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken bolt head can become a projectile, increasing the risk of an injury.
24V507000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Spartan Fire will replace the bolts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 5, 2024.  Owners may contact Spartan Fire customer service at 1-517-543-6400.  Spartan Fire's number for this recall is 24010.
24V507000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V509000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2025 Freightliner Cascadia, 114SD, Western Star 47X, and 49X transit buses equipped with Composolite EXS20 steerable lift axle suspension assemblies.  The tie rod assembly ball stud could have been improperly heat treated and can fail.
24V509000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The ball stud can separate from the vehicle becoming a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V509000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the tie rod assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 26, 2024.  Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 800-745-8000.  DTNA's number for this recall is F1005.
24V509000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V627000.DESC_DEFECT: Alamo Group Inc. (Morbark) is recalling certain Morbark 2018-2024 EB1821, EB2131, EB2230, and M20 trailers.  The electrical wires in the Power Distribution Module (PDM) may be loose and contact the PDM plate, possibly resulting in electrical arcing between the wiring and plate.
24V627000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Electrical arcing can increase the risk of a fire.
24V627000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will secure the electrical wires, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 18, 2024.  Owners may contact Morbark's customer service at 1-800-255-8839.
24V627000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V560000.DESC_DEFECT: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2023 Ariya vehicles.  The inverter software may misdiagnose an error, which can shut down the EV system, resulting in a loss of drive power.
24V560000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unexpected loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
24V560000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the vehicle's inverter software version and update the software, if necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 12, 2024.  Owners may contact Nissan's customer service at 1-800-867-7669.  Nissan's number for this recall is R24A8.
24V560000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V561000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2024 Santa Fe and Santa Fe HEV vehicles.  The main floor wiring harness may chafe against the passenger-side second-row bench seat assembly and become damaged, which can cause the air bags to deploy unintentionally or prevent the air bags from deploying in a crash.
24V561000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that deploys unintentionally can increase the risk of an injury.  An air bag that does not deploy as intended can increase the risk of injury in a crash.
24V561000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair, or replace the wiring harness as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 22, 2024.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 265.
24V561000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V577000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Entegra Anthem, Aspire, Cornerstone, Reatta, and Reatta XL motorhomes.  The battery cables may not be the correct size, in the correct location, or they may be improperly tightened, which can cause an electrical short or allow the cables to overheat.
24V577000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An electrical short or overheating of the battery cables increases the risk of a fire.
24V577000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the battery cables, and repair or replace them as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed August 30, 2024.  Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267.  Jayco's number for this recall is 9903611.
24V577000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V582000.DESC_DEFECT: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2024 Nissan Frontier vehicles.  The right-side headlight assemblies may have missing or illegible headlight aim markings, which can result in improperly aimed headlights.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V582000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Improperly aimed headlights can result in insufficient illumination of the road, decreasing the driver's visibility and increasing the risk of a crash.
24V582000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the right-side headlight as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 20, 2024.  Owners may contact Nissan customer service at 1-800-867-7669.  Nissan's number for this recall is PD121.
24V582000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V583000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2024 Hyundai Sonata vehicles.  The software for the brake lights may cause the brake lights to flash and not illuminate properly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
24V583000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Flashing brake lights may cause confusion for other drivers on the road, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V583000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the rear brake light software, free of charge.  Additionally, Hyundai will release the software update over-the-air (OTA).  Owner notification letters were mailed September 12, 2024.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 267.
24V583000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V591000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Transit vehicles.  The steering column intermediate shaft may have been secured to the steering gear pinion shaft with an incorrect bolt, which can result in the separation of steering components and cause a loss of steering control.
24V591000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of steering control can increase the risk of a crash.
24V591000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the steering column intermediate shaft bolt, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on February 14, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S48.
24V591000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V601000.COMPNAME: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:PROPULSION SYSTEM:FUSES, RELAYS, CONTACTS, AND SHUNTS
24V601000.DESC_DEFECT: LiveWire EV, LLC (LiveWire) is recalling certain 2024 S2 Del Mar and S2 Mulholland motorcycles.  The high voltage fuse may degrade and unexpectedly open, resulting in a loss of drive power.
24V601000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Unexpected loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
24V601000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a high voltage fuse with an increased amperage rating, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed August 2024.  Owners may contact LiveWire customer service at 1-855-387-4337.  LiveWire's number for this recall is 1003.
24V601000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V650000.DESC_DEFECT: Felling Trailers, Inc. (Felling Trailers) is recalling certain 2011-2022 Avtron D40548 trailers.  The axle bracket may experience cracking and break, allowing the axle to detach from the trailer.
24V650000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An axle assembly separation can result in a loss of trailer control, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V650000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the axle bracket as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed in November 6, 2024.  Owners may contact Felling Trailers customer service at 1-888-335-5464.
24V650000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V614000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE
24V614000.DESC_DEFECT: Acura (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2024 Acura ZDX All-Wheel Drive vehicles.  The anti-lock brake system (ABS) may activate unexpectedly and release brake pressure in the vehicle's service brake system.
24V614000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A release of brake pressure can cause a loss of braking ability, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V614000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The electronic brake control module software will be updated through an over-the-air (OTA) update or by a dealer, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 26, 2024.  Owners may contact Acura customer service at 1-800-382-2238.  Acura's number for this recall is UJE.
24V614000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V615000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2016 Model X vehicles.  The front and center roof cosmetic trim pieces may be adhered to the vehicle without primer.  As a result, one or both pieces of trim may separate from the vehicle.
24V615000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Trim that separates from the vehicle during use can create a road hazard and increase the risk of a crash.
24V615000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla service will test the roof trim adhesion and reattach the trim pieces as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 14, 2024.  Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752.  Tesla's number for this recall is SB-24-12-008.  Vehicles previously repaired under recall 20V-710 will need to have the new inspection and remedy completed.
24V615000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V616000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 R-POD RPT203 travel trailers.  The exterior griddle may be stowed while still connected to LP gas line.
24V616000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A griddle stowed while the gas is still in use can increase the risk of a fire.
24V616000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will relocate the hose connection, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 23, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-642-3119.  Forest River's number for this recall is 80-1829.
24V616000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V619000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Puma PUT39DBT travel trailers.  The anti-siphon vent may have been installed backwards which can cause sewer gas to enter the vehicle.
24V619000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Sewer gas entering the vehicle can increase the risk of injury to occupants.
24V619000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the anti-siphon vent, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 23, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-642-0588.  Forest River's number for this recall is 420-1832.
24V619000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V623000.DESC_DEFECT: Fisker Group Inc (Fisker) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Ocean vehicles.  The brake module software may cause an unexpected reduction in regenerative braking, decreasing the braking performance.
24V623000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Decreased braking performance can extend the distance required to stop, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V623000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Fisker will release an over-the-air (OTA) software update, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 26, 2024.  Owners may contact Fisker customer service at 1-844-347-5371.  Fisker's number for this recall is TSB10062408.
24V623000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V630000.DESC_DEFECT: Endera Motors (Endera) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Endera school buses.  The rear emergency exit door has a gas shock that is underrated for the weight of the door, which can result in the door closing unexpectedly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."
24V630000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An emergency exit door closing unexpectedly can increase the risk of injury.
24V630000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the gas strut with a standard locking mechanism, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 11, 2024.  Owners may contact Endera customer service at 419-523-3593.
24V630000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V674000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023 Chevrolet Silverado 1500, GMC Sierra 1500, 2023-2024 Chevrolet Tahoe, Suburban, GMC Yukon, Yukon XL, Cadillac Escalade, and Escalade ESV vehicles.  The electronic brake control module software may fail to display a warning light when a loss of brake fluid occurs.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Vehicle Safety Standard number 135, "Light Vehicle Brake Systems."
24V674000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Without a warning light, the vehicle may be driven with low brake fluid, which can reduce braking performance and increase the risk of a crash.
24V674000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The Electronic Brake Control Module (eBCM) software will be updated through an over-the-air (OTA) update or by a dealer, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 25, 2024.  Owners can contact GMC customer service at 1-800-462-8782, Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020, or Cadillac customer service at 1-800-458-8006.  GM's number for this recall is N242447990.
24V674000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V677000.COMPNAME: FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
24V677000.MFGNAME: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
24V677000.DESC_DEFECT: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Jaguar) is recalling certain 2024 F-Pace vehicles.  The Near Field Sensing Module (NFSM) may overheat and cause the 3D surround camera images, including the rearview camera image, not to display.
24V677000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera image that does not display can decrease the driver's visibility, increasing the risk of injury or crash.
24V677000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the NFSM module, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 24, 2024.  Owners may contact Jaguar customer service at 1-800-452-4827.  Jaguar's number for this recall is H516.
24V677000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V681000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Altec Aerial Device, Digger Derrick, and Pressure Digger vehicles.  The chassis ignition circuit may be overloaded, which can result in a blown fuse and cause an engine shutdown.
24V681000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine shutdown increases the risk of a crash.
24V681000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Altec will rewire the accessory circuit, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 8, 2024.  Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832.  Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3185.
24V681000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V692000.DESC_DEFECT: Elgin Sweeper Company, Inc. (Elgin Sweeper) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Broom Badger street sweepers.  The fuel system may allow the tank to be overfilled, which can cause a fuel leak.
24V692000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of fire.
24V692000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will repair the fuel tank, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 29, 2024.  Owners may contact Elgin Sweeper Customer Service Department at 1-877-DIAL-ESG (1-877-342-5374).  Elgin Sweeper's number for this recall is SB-0260.
24V692000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V696000.DESC_DEFECT: Trans Tech Bus (Trans Tech) is recalling certain 2018-2021 SST, CST, SSTFLR and CSTFLR school buses.  In the event of a rollover, the emergency exit windows may not open.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 220, "School Bus Rollover Protection."
24V696000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An emergency exit window that does not open can increase the risk of injury.
24V696000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the emergency exit windows as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 25, 2024.  Owners may contact Trans Tech customer service at 1-845-988-2333.
24V696000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V721000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Viking and Clipper travel trailers.  The roof rack hardware may not have been properly tightened, allowing the rack to detach from the roof.
24V721000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached roof rack can become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
24V721000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and tighten roof rack hardware, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 9, 2024.  Owners may call Forest River Customer Service at 269-467-6604.  Forest River's number for this recall is 121-1844.
24V721000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V706000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:GASOLINE:BELTS AND ASSOCIATED PULLEYS
24V706000.DESC_DEFECT: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling one 2023 G5 transit bus.  The engine drive belt tensioner may fail, resulting in a loose drive belt.
24V706000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose drive belt can result in a loss of power steering, or a loss of alternator and water pump function, increasing the risk of a crash.  Additionally, the engine may overheat, increasing the risk of a fire.
24V706000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: A dealer will replace the engine drive belt tensioner and belt, free of charge.  An owner notification letter was mailed November 6, 2024.  Owners can contact Micro Bird Customer Service at 819-477-2012.  Micro Bird's number for this recall is 24-111-GUC.
24V706000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V711000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2023-2024 228i, 228i xDrive, and 2025 MINI Countryman S ALL4 vehicles.  The bolts that connect the front body structure to the vehicle chassis may not have been tightened properly.
24V711000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose front body structure may not adequately protect occupants in a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
24V711000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and if necessary, tighten the front structure bolts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 18, 2024.  Owners may contact BMW Customer Service at 1-800-525-7417.
24V711000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V716000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2021-2024 BMW R18 motorcycles.  The seal for the reverse gear control unit may deteriorate and allow moisture inside the control unit, which can result in the unit overheating.
24V716000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated reverse gear control unit increases the risk of a fire.
24V716000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: As an interim remedy, the reverse gear control unit will be disconnected from the electrical system of the motorcycle, free of charge.  Dealers will install an electrical relay between the battery and the reverse gear control unit, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on April 7, 2025  Owners may contact BMW Customer Service at 1-800-525-7417.
24V716000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

24V726000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2022-2024 E-TRON GT, and RS E-TRON GT vehicles.  The high-voltage battery may experience a short circuit within the battery module.
24V726000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A short circuit in a high-voltage battery module increases the risk of a fire.
24V726000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install advanced diagnostic software as the final remedy free of charge.
