24V631000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Endera will replace the emergency exit label, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 11, 2024.  Owners may contact Endera customer service at 419-523-3593.
24V631000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V638000.DESC_DEFECT: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Commercial Office trailers equipped with CK7G generators.  The fuel line assembly on the generator may be loose or improperly routed, which can result in a fuel leak.
24V638000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
24V638000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: ATC will work with the equipment manufacturer, CK Power, to replace and reroute the fuel lines, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed September 5, 2024.  Owners may contact ATC customer service at 1-877-441-2440, ext. 3422.
24V638000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V644000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
24V644000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2024 AT and TA series aerial devices, and ST series spray bodies.  The fuel or brake lines may not be properly secured, which can cause the lines to become damaged and leak.
24V644000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A brake fluid leak can cause brake failure, increasing the risk of a crash.  A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
24V644000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Altec will provide owners with instructions to inspect the brake and fuel lines.  If improperly secured, Altec will provide a kit to secure the lines.  If the lines are damaged, dealers will repair the fuel and brake lines.  Repairs will be performed free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on January 23, 2025.  Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832.  Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3181.
24V644000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V640000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Sequoia Hybrid vehicles equipped with a tow hitch cover attached to the rear bumper.  The tow hitch cover may come loose from the bumper and detach from the vehicle.
24V640000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A tow hitch cover that detaches can become a road hazard and increase the risk of a crash.
24V640000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the tow hitch cover and modify the rear bumper, free of charge.  Owner letters were mailed April 7, 2025.  Owners may contact Toyota customer service at 1-800-331-4331.  Toyota's numbers for this recall are 24TB10 and 24TA10.
24V640000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V633000.MFGNAME: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
24V633000.DESC_DEFECT: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Jaguar) is recalling certain 2019 Jaguar I-PACE vehicles.  The high-voltage battery may overheat.
24V633000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A high-voltage battery that overheats increases the risk of a fire.
24V633000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park and charge their vehicle outside and away from structures and limit their charge to a maximum of 80% until the recall repair is complete.  As an interim repair, dealers will update the battery energy control module software, free of charge.  Owner letters were mailed March 5, 2025.  JLR will repurchase the vehicles.  Owners may contact Jaguar customer service at 1-800-452-4827.  Jaguar's numbers for this recall are H514 and H536.  These vehicles were previously recalled for this same issue under one or more recall numbers 24V-085 (H471), 23V-709 (H459), or 23V-369 (H441) and will need to have the new interim remedy performed before the vehicle is repurchased.
24V633000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

24V173000.MFGNAME: Faraday Future Eco Sales Co. LLC
24V173000.DESC_DEFECT: Faraday Future Eco Sales. LLC (FF) is recalling certain 2023 Faraday Future FF 91 2.0 Alliance vehicles.  A software error may prevent the air bag malfunction warning light from illuminating when a system fault is detected in the Airbag Control Unit (ACU).
24V173000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A warning light that fails to indicate a problem with air bag deployment can increase the risk of injury during a crash.
24V173000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: FF will deploy an over-the-air (OTA) iHUB module software update, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 27, 2024.  Owners may contact Faraday customer service at 1-800-228-7702.  FF's number for this recall is 24-90-32-01.
24V173000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

24V938000.DESC_DEFECT: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo Car) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Volvo C40 vehicles.  The clamps may be improperly crimped on the driver's side inner far side air bag module (FSAB), which can cause the air bag to deploy improperly.
24V938000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that deploys improperly may not protect the driver as intended during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
24V938000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the driver's side inner FSAB, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 24, 2025.  Owners may contact Volvo Car customer service at 1-800-458-1552.  Volvo Car's number for this recall is R10296.
24V938000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V558000.DESC_DEFECT: Midwest Fire Equipment & Repair Company (Midwest Fire) is recalling certain 2021-2025 All-Poly Series fire trucks. The hose reel mounting plate may crack and fail, which can cause the hose reel to detach from the vehicle.
25V558000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A hose reel that detaches can become a road hazard and increase the risk of a crash. In addition, the mounting plate can fail suddenly during hose operation, increasing the risk of injury.
25V558000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Midwest Fire will reinforce the hose reel mounting plate, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 26, 2025. Owners may contact Midwest Fire's customer service at 1-800-344-2059.

25V853000.DESC_DEFECT: Motor Coach Industries (MCI) is recalling certain 102DL3, 102D3, MC12PTV, E4500, D4000, 102D3ISTV,  D4500, J4500, D4000ISTV, D4005, D4505, and J3500 transit buses. Please refer to MCI's recall report for specific model year information. The front door lower curb view glazing material is incorrect. As such, these vehicles fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 205, "Glazing Materials."
25V853000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The incorrect window glazing material may reduce the driver's visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V853000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: MCI will replace the glass, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed February 4, 2026. Owners may contact MCI customer service at 1-800-241-2947. MCI's number for this recall is 22-005.

25V606000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2023-2025 IONIQ 6 electric vehicles. The charging port door panel may detach.
25V606000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached charging port door panel can create a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V606000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will apply an adhesive on the charging port door assembly, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed beginning October 10, 2025. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 282. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on September 13, 2025.

25V588000.DESC_DEFECT: Storyteller Overland, LLC (Storyteller) is recalling certain 2024-2026 GXV Hilt recreational vehicles. The auxiliary power system wires may have been improperly. The wires may be damaged by contact with the intake manifold.
25V588000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Damaged wire may overheat and short, increasing the risk of a fire.
25V588000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect, replace, and secure the wires as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 8, 2025. Owners may contact Storyteller customer service at 1-888-999-7442.

25V437000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:HARD PARTS INTERNAL/MECHANICAL
25V437000.DESC_DEFECT: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Rogue, 2019-2020 Altima, 2019-2022 Infiniti QX50, and 2022 Infiniti QX55 vehicles equipped with 3-cylinder 1.5L or 4-cylinder 2.0L variable compression turbo (VC-Turbo) engines. The engine bearings may have manufacturing defects that can lead to engine failure.
25V437000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Engine failure increases the risk of a crash. A bearing failure may cause a breach in the engine block, allowing hot oil to be discharged, increasing the risk of an engine fire.
25V437000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reprogram the engine control module (ECM) software, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed April 8, 2026. Owners may contact Nissan's customer service at 800-647-7261 or Infiniti's customer service at 1-800-662-6200. Nissan's numbers for this recall are R25A8/A9 and R25B1/B2.

25V549000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Tucson and Santa Fe vehicles. The connecting rod bolts in the engine may have been improperly tightened, which can cause a loss of drive power and engine damage, possibly resulting in an oil leak.
25V549000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash. An oil leak in the presence of hot engine components can increase the risk of an engine compartment fire.
25V549000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the engine, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 23, 2025. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 281.

25V551000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Cedar Creek recreational trailers. The trailers may not have an emergency exit window installed.
25V551000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A missing emergency exit window can prevent passengers from exiting in the event of an emergency, increasing the risk of injury.
25V551000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install red window operating hardware and an exit sticker for the window, free of charge. All vehicles are still in dealer inventory and therefore no owner notification letters will be mailed. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-260-593-4000. Forest River's number for this recall is 20-1970.

25V546000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Mustang, and  Mustang GTD vehicles. Water may enter the body control module and cause a loss of communication with the exterior lighting, including the license plate light, side marker, and tail lights. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
25V546000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: License plate, side marker, and tail lights that fail to illuminate as intended can reduce visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V546000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and seal the body seams as necessary. Dealers will also inspect the body control module for corrosion and replace it, if necessary. Repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 10, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25C43.

25V431000.DESC_DEFECT: Newmar Corporation (Newmar) is recalling certain 2023-2024 London Aire, Essex, and 2016-2024 King Aire motorhomes. The baggage door skins may come loose and separate from the door frame.
25V431000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached door skin can become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V431000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and add fasteners and adhesive the door as necessary, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed August 22, 2025. Owners may contact Newmar customer service at 1-800-731-8300. Newmar's number for this recall is 619 RSB.

25V182000.DESC_DEFECT: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2021-2026 Peterbilt 220, 2022-2026 Kenworth K370, and 2020-2026 K270 Medium-Duty Battery Electric Vehicles. The cradle harness may have a loose electrical connection that can cause a loss of drive power.
25V182000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
25V182000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the cradle harness as necessary, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed September 8, 2025. Owners may contact Peterbilt's customer service at 1-940-591-4220 and Kenworth's customer service at 1-425-828-5888.  PACCAR's numbers for this recall are 25KWD and 25PBD.
25V182000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V537000.DESC_DEFECT: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2025 R1S and R1T vehicles. An improperly grounded connection inside the High Voltage Distribution Box (HVDB) may cause a loss of drive power.
25V537000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
25V537000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Rivian will inspect and repair the HVDB ground strap joint or replace the high voltage battery pack as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 17, 2025. Owners may contact Rivian customer service at 1-888-748-4261. Rivian's number for this recall is FSAM-1723.

25V531000.DESC_DEFECT: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd. (Triumph) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Daytona 660 motorcycles. The engine may fail due to internal damage from a disruption of oil flow.
25V531000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Engine failure increases the risk of a crash.
25V531000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will increase the engine oil capacity and install a redesigned dipstick, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 10, 2025. Owners may contact Triumph customer service at 1-678-854-2010. Triumph's number for this recall is SRAN 640.

25V524000.DESC_DEFECT: The Heil Co. (Heil) is recalling certain 2021-2022 front end loader garbage trucks. The vertical welds on the automatic front loader (AFL) arm may be missing, causing the arm to crack and fall.
25V524000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A falling arm increases the risk of injury.
25V524000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Heil will inspect and repair or replace the AFL arm as necessary, free of charge. All affected trucks were repaired by July 28, 2023. Owners may contact Heil's customer service at 1-866-275-4345.

25V105000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain Genesis 2023-2024 G80, GV80, 2025 GV70 and 2023-2025 GV70 "Electrified" vehicles.  Due to a software error, the instrument panel display may fail.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."
25V105000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument panel display that fails to show critical safety information, such as the speedometer or warning lights, increases the risk of a crash.
25V105000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and update the instrument panel display software, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 26, 2025.  Owners may contact Genesis customer service at 844-340-9741.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 026G.
25V105000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V520000.DESC_DEFECT: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Volvo New VN trucks. The dynamic steering and oversteer guidance feature may malfunction and cause a loss of steering control.
25V520000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of steering control increases the risk of a crash.
25V520000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The oversteer guidance feature will be disabled through an over-the-air (OTA) update or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 22, 2025. Owners may contact Volvo Trucks' customer service at 1-800-528-6586. Volvo Trucks' number for this recall is RVXX2506.

25V518000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Lincoln Nautilus vehicles that were repaired incorrectly under recall 24V953. The window automatic reversal system may not react correctly after detecting an obstruction. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 118, "Power-Operated Window Systems."
25V518000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A closing window may exert excessive force by pinching a driver or passenger before retracting, increasing the risk of injury.
25V518000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the driver door module (DDM) and the passenger door module (PDM) software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed on September 23, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25C36.

25V498000.DESC_DEFECT: Storyteller Overland, LLC (Storyteller) is recalling certain 2023 Mode LT recreational vehicles. The exterior shore power inlet may have been improperly tightened.
25V498000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly tightened shore power inlet may overheat, increasing the risk of a fire.
25V498000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the shore power inlets, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 19, 2025. Owners may contact Storyteller customer service at 1-888-999-7442.

25V487000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2022-2023  EQB 350 4MATIC, and EQB 300 4MATIC vehicles. The bus bar in the high voltage battery may be secured with incorrect screws, which can cause the system to have a sudden loss of drive power without warning.
25V487000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
25V487000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park outside until the recall repair is complete. Dealers will inspect and replace the high-voltage battery as necessary, free of charge. This will be a phased campaign, with the remedy becoming available in different phases based on model and model years. Owner notification letters were mailed January 9, 2026.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372. MBUSA's number for this recall is 2025080004.

25V436000.DESC_DEFECT: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Kenworth T480, T680, T880, W990, Peterbilt 520, 536, 537, 548, 567, 579, 589, 2025 Kenworth T180, Peterbilt 535, 2025-2026 Kenworth T280, T380 and L770 vehicles. The tail brake light, upper and lower beam headlights, reverse light, and turn signal may not illuminate as intended. In addition, the lift axles, if lowered, may revert to a raised position, or oscillate up and down when the signal warning lights are activated. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices and Associated Equipment."
25V436000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Delayed and unsteady headlights can result in insufficient illumination of the road, decreasing the driver's visibility and increasing the risk of a crash. In addition, an unexpected position change of the lift axles may increase the risk of injury.
25V436000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the VCU software, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed August 19, 2025. Owners may contact Kenworth's customer service at 1-425-828-5888 and Peterbilt's customer service at 1-940-591-4220. PACCAR's number for this recall is 25PACF.

25V477000.DESC_DEFECT: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Revuelto vehicles. The gas springs that allow the doors to open and stay open, may fail due to improperly assembled support pins in the springs.
25V477000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Door spring failure can cause the doors to close unexpectedly, increasing the risk of injury.
25V477000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the spherical pins as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed September 6, 2025. Owners may contact Automobili Lamborghini customer service at 1-866-681-6276. Automobili Lamborghini's number for this recall is L74X-R.01.25.

25V452000.DESC_DEFECT: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2015-2025 Utilimaster Truck Body vehicles. The signal converter may fail, which can cause the brake lights and turn signals to become inoperative.
25V452000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Inoperative turn signals and brake lights can fail to alert other road users to the driver's intentions to turn or stop, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V452000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Shyft will inspect and repair the signal converter connecters as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 7, 2025. Owners may contact Shyft customer service at 1-800-237-7806. Shyft's number for this recall is 25-16.

25V462000.MFGNAME: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc.
25V462000.DESC_DEFECT: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc. (MFTA) is recalling certain 2024 Rizon FEC7K (E16), FEC9K (E18), and 2025 FECXK (E18) trucks. The electric parking brake (EPB) actuator may use a spacer that is too big, resulting in excessive friction and overheated brake components.
25V462000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overheated brake components can result in a fire.
25V462000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: MFTA will replace the EPB actuator. In addition, the brake assembly will be inspected for brake dragging, and replaced as necessary. All repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 29, 2025. Owners may contact MFTA customer service at 1-877-711-0707.  MFTA's number for this recall is C10138.

25V392000.DESC_DEFECT: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo Car) is recalling certain 2023 Volvo C40 BEV, 2025 EC40, 2023-2024 XC40 BEV, 2020-2026 XC90 PHEV, 2022-2026 XC60 PHEV, 2023-2025 S60 PHEV, 2024-2025 V60 PHEV, and 2025-2026 EX40 and 2025 S90 PHEV vehicles. In certain driving scenarios while coasting down a hill and using "B" mode or "One Pedal Drive," the vehicle may lose brake function.
25V392000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of brake function increases the risk of a crash.
25V392000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to use "B" Mode (for plug-in hybrid vehicles) or "One Pedal Drive" (for pure electric vehicles) until the repair has been completed. The brake module software will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 15, 2025. Owners may contact Volvo Car's customer service at 1-800-458-1552. Volvo Car's number for this recall is R10329.

25V449000.DESC_DEFECT: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2015-2022 ACTT (Xspotter) and ACX (Xpeditor) vehicles. The air tanks have an insufficient volume of air for the brake system.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 121, "Air Brake Systems."
25V449000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Insufficient air volume can reduce brake function, extending the distance required to stop and increasing the risk of a crash.
25V449000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace or add additional air tanks as necessary, free of charge. Interim owner notification letters explaining the safety risk were mailed August 29, 2025. Owners will receive a second notice once remedy parts become available, anticipated September 2026. Owners may contact Autocar customer service at 1-888-218-3611. Autocar's numbers for this recall are ACTT-2503 and ACX-2503.

25V427000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Mack MD vehicles. When the Controller Area Network (CAN) communications are interrupted, the throttle signal from the electro mobility control unit may retain the last known throttle setting, and the engine will not return to idle as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 124, "Accelerator Control Systems."
25V427000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine that does not return to idle quickly enough can cause a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V427000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the control unit software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 14, 2025. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0481.

25V424000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Sabre fifth wheel recreational trailers. The exterior griddle may have been incorrectly installed, allowing the griddle to be stowed while still connected to the LPG.
25V424000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Stowing the griddle while connected to the LPG increases the risk of a fire.
25V424000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install self-tapping screws to properly secure griddle to shelf, free of charge. Owner notifications letters were mailed July 11, 2025. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-260-499-2100. Forest River's number for this recall is 62-1943.

25V393000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2025 Aviator, and Explorer vehicles. The switch for the easy-entry second-row outer seats may bind or stick, resulting in the seats unlatching, folding, or sliding unexpectedly while driving.
25V393000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat that moves unexpectedly may not properly restrain an occupant during a crash, increasing their risk of injury.
25V393000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the second-row seat switch, and replace the bezel around the switch as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 7, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S67.

25V416000.DESC_DEFECT: REV Recreation Group (REV) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Holiday Rambler Incline, and Fleetwood Altitude Class C motorhomes. The electrical components under the house entry steps may fail due to water intrusion, including the carbon monoxide (CO) or Liquid Propane (LP) detector.
25V416000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A faulty CO or LP detector may not notify occupants of carbon monoxide or propane exposure, increasing the risk of injury or death.
25V416000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install latch covers on the entry steps, mudflaps, and seal the compartment seams, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2025. Owners may contact REV customer service at 1-800-322 8216. REV's number for this recall is 250618REV.

25V616000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC is recalling certain 2025-2026 X1 and X2, MINI Cooper Convertible, MINI Cooper, Mini Countryman S ALL4, and 2025 MINI Countryman SE ALL4 vehicles. The torsion bar in both front seat belt retractors may have been damaged during production.
25V616000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A damaged seat belt retractor may not properly restrain an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
25V616000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace both front seat belt retractors, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 13, 2025. Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) will be searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 7, 2025.

25V619000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2021 Cadillac Escalade, 2021, 2023-2024 Chevrolet Tahoe, and 2022 and 2024 GMC Yukon vehicles equipped with a 6-cylinder diesel engine. The original fuel tank may have been replaced with an incorrect fuel tank, which can allow fuel to leak in a rollover crash.
25V619000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a vehicle fire.
25V619000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect for the correct fuel tank and replace it, if necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed November 5, 2025. Owners may contact Cadillac customer service at 1-800-333-4223, Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020, or GMC customer service at 1-800-462-8782.  GM's number for this recall is N252512770. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on September 18, 2025.

25V246000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
25V246000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Alfa Romeo Tonale and Dodge Hornet vehicles.  The display module may not show the rearview camera image.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V246000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview image that does not display reduces the driver's view of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V246000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the software or replace the display as necessary free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed beginning May 13, 2025.  Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403.  Chrysler's numbers for this recall are 13C and 38C.
25V246000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V115000.DESC_DEFECT: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2025 EV9 vehicles.  The rear gear drive unit (GDU) motor shaft may have been improperly welded and become damaged, causing a loss of drive power.
25V115000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
25V115000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the rear GDU, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 7, 2025.  Owners may contact Kia customer service at 800-333-4542.  Kia's number for this recall is SC337.
25V115000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V249000.DESC_DEFECT: Blue Bird Bus Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Vision electric school buses equipped with hydraulic brakes.  The system software may fail to detect and alert the driver to a loss of the secondary brake assist.
25V249000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Driving the bus without a functioning secondary brake assist increases the risk of a crash.
25V249000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the software and repair the wiring harness, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 11, 2025.  Owners may contact Blue Bird customer service at 1-478-822-2242.  Blue Bird's number for this recall is R25DL.
25V249000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171), or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V261000.DESC_DEFECT: Motiv Power Systems, Inc. (Motiv) is recalling certain 2019-2022 F-53 and F-59 vehicles equipped with a Motiv Gen 5 EPIC powertrain.  A support bracket may fatigue and break, allowing the main power disconnect to contact other structures and short.
25V261000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An electrical short can shut down the high voltage system, resulting in a loss of drive power and increasing the risk of a crash.
25V261000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Motiv field support technicians will replace the bracket, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 9, 2025.  Owners may contact Motiv customer service at 1-650-458-4804.
25V261000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V377000.DESC_DEFECT: Starcraft RV (Starcraft) is recalling certain 2025 Autumn Ridge travel trailers. The installed safety chains are rated at 7,600 lbs. and the actual Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) is 7,995 lbs. This can cause the chains to fail, allowing the trailer to separate from the tow vehicle.
25V377000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Separation of the trailer and tow vehicle increases the risk of a crash.
25V377000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the safety chains, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 17, 2025. Owners may contact Starcraft customer service at 1-800-283-8267. Starcrafts number for this recall is 9902634.

25V276000.DESC_DEFECT: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2025-2026 HV, HX, LT, MV, RH, and 2025 EMV vehicles.  The linkage that connects the right-side wiper arm to the motor may separate, causing the wipers to fail.
25V276000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Windshield wiper failure can reduce driver visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V276000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the wiper module, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 2, 2025.  Owners may contact International customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  International's number for this recall is 25505.
25V276000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V333000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2026 Mack MD vehicles. The center bench seat belt assembly may be routed incorrectly.
25V333000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrectly routed seat belt assembly may not restrain an occupant as intended, increasing the risk of injury in a crash.
25V333000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the seat belt assembly as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 3, 2025. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0478.

25V350000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Maverick vehicles. The air bag indicator light on the dashboard may be loose or dislodged, and not visible to occupants. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
25V350000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The air bag indicator light may fail to warn occupants of a deactivated air bag, increasing the risk of injury in a crash.
25V350000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install air bag indicator light retaining clips, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 24, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25C17.

25V337000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024  Nautilus vehicles. The multimedia module software may cause the panoramic and center displays to reboot, resulting in a blank screen. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 111, "Rear Visibility," and 102, "Transmission shift lever sequence, starter interlock, and transmission braking effect," as well as FMVSS numbers 126, 108, 135, 138, 208, 101, and 305.
25V337000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A blank instrument display can result in a loss of critical safety information, such as the speedometer and warning lights, increasing the risk of a crash. In addition, a missing rearview camera display image can reduce visibility of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V337000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The multimedia  module system software will be updated by a dealer, or through an over-the-air (OTA) update, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 24, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25C21.

25V323000.DESC_DEFECT: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2025-2026 IC Bus CESB school buses. The parking brake can be released when the wheelchair platform lift is deployed. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 403, "Platform Lift Systems."
25V323000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A bus that moves while the platform lift is in operation increases the risk of injury.
25V323000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the dash electronic control unit (DECU) module, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 16, 2025. Owners may contact International customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  International's number for this recall is 25506.

25V102000.DESC_DEFECT: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2023-2025 New VN trucks.  The brakes may take longer than expected to activate.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 121, "Air Brake Systems."
25V102000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Delayed brake activation can extend the distance required to stop, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V102000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a new pneumatic circuit, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 11, 2025.  Owners may contact Volvo Trucks' customer service at 800-528-6586.  Volvo Trucks' number for this recall is RVXX2502.
25V102000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V094000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Maverick vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 23V-848.  In the event that one of the rear turn signals stops working, the vehicle will not adjust the turn signal flash rate frequency to warn the driver that a turn signal has failed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
25V094000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A nonfunctioning exterior turn signal cannot notify other drivers that the vehicle is turning, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V094000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the body control module software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 27, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25C04.
25V094000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V092000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2023 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles operating software prior to 2023.38.4.  The printed circuit board for the electronic power steering assist may experience an overstress condition, causing a loss of power steering assist when the vehicle reaches a stop and then accelerates again.
25V092000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of power steering assist can require greater steering effort, especially at low speeds, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V092000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla has released an over-the-air (OTA) software update, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 25, 2025.  Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752.  Tesla's number for this recall is SB-25-00-004.
25V092000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V079000.DESC_DEFECT: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2025 911 vehicles.  A software error in the front-end electronics control module may result in the low beam headlights creating a glare for oncoming traffic.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
25V079000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Excessive glare can decrease the visibility to oncoming drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V079000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the front-end electronics control module software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 1, 2025.  Owners may contact Porsche customer service at 1-800-767-7243.  Porsche's number for this recall is ASA1.
25V079000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-888-275-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V072000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Entegra Coach Launch, 2022 Launch LE, 2021-2025 Jayco Terrain, and 2022 Terrain LE recreational vehicles.  The grey water tank support brackets may contact and damage the fuel tank, causing a leak.
25V072000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.
25V072000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the support brackets, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 7, 2025.  Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267.  Jayco's number for this recall is 9903619.
25V072000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V070000.DESC_DEFECT: Storyteller Overland, LLC (Storyteller) is recalling certain 2024-2025 MODE XO vehicles.  The seat assembly's floor mounting system may be improperly welded, which can cause the seat assembly to loosen or detach.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 207, "Seating Systems."
25V070000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose or detached seat assembly increases the risk of injury.
25V070000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the second-row seat mounting brackets and fasteners as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 24, 2025.  Owners may contact Storyteller customer service at 1-888-999-7442.
25V070000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V049000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Bronco Sport, Escape, and Lincoln Corsair vehicles.  The Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) may not illuminate at startup or while driving.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 101, "Control and Displays" and 102, "Transmission shift lever sequence, starter interlock, and transmission braking effect" as well as FMVSS numbers 126, 108, 135, 138, 208, and 305.
25V049000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument panel display that fails to show critical safety information, such as the speedometer or warning lights, increases the risk of a crash.
25V049000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the instrument panel cluster, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 17, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25C02.
25V049000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V009000.DESC_DEFECT: Marion Body Works Inc. (Marion Body Works) is recalling certain 2024 Spartan Fire Metro Star vehicles.  A missing mechanical stop may allow the cab tilt cylinder to be overextended.
25V009000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overextension of the cab tilt cylinder can cause the cab to drop, increasing the risk of injury.
25V009000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the cylinder as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 27, 2025.  Owners may contact Marion Body Works customer service at 1-715-754-5261.
25V009000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V898000.DESC_DEFECT: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain XD35, XDE35, XE35, XN35, XD40, XDE40, XE40, XHE40, XN40, XT40, XD60, XDE60, XE60, XN60, XT60, and XHE60 transit buses. Please refer to New Flyer's recall report for specific model year information. The antilock braking (ABS) and electronic stability control (ESC) module may lose communication and fail without illuminating the warning lights. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 121, "Air Brake Systems" and 136, "Electronic Stability Control Systems on Heavy Vehicles."
25V898000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An ABS or ESC warning light that fails to illuminate will not alert the driver to the loss of ABS or ESC, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V898000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: New Flyer will update the software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed February 17, 2026. Owners may contact New Flyer's customer service at 1-800-241-2947.

25V042000.DESC_DEFECT: Brinkley RV (Brinkley) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Model G fifth wheel trailers.  The solar charge controller may fail and overheat.
25V042000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated controller increases the risk of fire.
25V042000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the controller, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 7, 2025.  Owners may contact Brinkley customer service at 1-574-501-4280.  Brinkley's number for this recall is REC-2501.
25V042000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V900000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
25V900000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2019-2026 vehicles. Please see the recall report for a complete list of models. A software error may prevent the rearview camera image from displaying as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V900000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview image that does not display reduces the driver's view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V900000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed January 14, 2026. Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Audi's number for this recall is 90TV. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on December 23, 2025.

25V906000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling one 2025 I4 EDRIVE40 vehicle. The connection between the positive battery cable and the rear power distributor may become loose.
25V906000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose positive battery cable connection could lead to the vehicle stalling, increasing the risk of a crash. In addition, a loose battery cable can overheat, increasing the risk of a fire.
25V906000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: A dealer will check the positive battery cable connection and, if necessary, repair it, free of charge. The owner notification letter is expected to be mailed on February 13, 2026. Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417. The Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning February 13, 2026.

25V912000.DESC_DEFECT: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2026 Rogue vehicles. The incorrect-size spare tire may have been installed, which does not match the tire size and inflation pressure information on the tire placard. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
25V912000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect spare tire pressure information on the placard may lead to incorrect inflation of the spare tire, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V912000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the spare tire assembly as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed February 25, 2026. Owners may contact Nissan's customer service at 800-647-7261. Nissan's number for this recall is PD180. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on January 6, 2026.

25V867000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2010-2016 Granite (GU) trucks. Vehicles remedied under Recall 15V804 (SC0398) may have had incorrect parts installed during subsequent repairs. The incorrect parts may cause a brake imbalance between the steer and drive axle brakes and the rear brakes to overheat.
25V867000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overheated brakes may cause a tire blowout or fire, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V867000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the brake chambers as necessary, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed April 14, 2026. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0491. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning December 22, 2025. Owners who received a remedy under Recall 15V804 (SC0398) must have the new remedy completed.

25V766000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Jeep Grand Cherokee 4XE and 2024-2025 Jeep Wrangler 4XE Plug-In Hybrid Electric (PHEV) vehicles. Debris inside the engine may cause engine failure, which can result in a loss of drive power and/or an engine compartment fire.
25V766000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash, and a vehicle fire can increase the risk of injury.
25V766000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a software update and replace the block or engine as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed beginning May 7, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 78C. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning November 13, 2025.

25V879000.DESC_DEFECT: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2026-2027 IC Bus CESB school buses. The retractors may not lock, preventing the wheelchair from being properly secured.
25V879000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unsecured wheelchair can move during transit, increasing the risk of injury.
25V879000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the retractors as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed February 16, 2026. Owners may contact International's customer service at 1-800-448-7825. International's number for this recall is 25526. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning February 9, 2026.

25V307000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Cherokee ACKT271RK travel trailers.  These vehicles may not have an emergency exit window installed.
25V307000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A missing emergency exit can prevent or delay occupants from exiting in an emergency, increasing the risk of injury.
25V307000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install an emergency exit window, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 2, 2025.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-260-499-2100.  Forest River's number for this recall is 17-1927.
25V307000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171) or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V305000.DESC_DEFECT: DRV Suites (DRV) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Full House toy hauler travel trailers, equipped with a removable step assembly.  The clip-on bracket mounting bolts may come loose, allowing the steps to detach.
25V305000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Steps that detach while in use increase the risk of injury.
25V305000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the clip-on bracket assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 19, 2025.  Owners may contact DRV customer service at 1-260-562-3500.
25V305000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171), or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V303000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 Bronco vehicles.  The left-side rear door may be opened from the inside of the vehicle when the child safety lock is in the "ON" position.
25V303000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A malfunctioning child safety lock that allows a rear door to be opened unintentionally can increase the risk of injury.
25V303000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the child safety locks and replace the rear door latch, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on May 22, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford Customer Service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S15.  This recall expands previous recall number 24V-189.
25V303000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V294000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Q5 Quattro and Q5 Sportback Quattro vehicles.  The cylinder head cover screws may have been improperly tightened.
25V294000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The screws can loosen, allowing oil to leak and increasing the risk of a fire.
25V294000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the screws as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 5, 2025.  Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Audi's number for this recall is 15ZK.
25V294000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V278000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River Bus, LLC (Forest River Bus) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Champion Challenger, Defender, 2024-2025 Glaval Entourage, and 2023-2024 Glaval Universal transit buses.  The entry door ground wire may be incorrectly connected to the positive side of the battery instead of the negative ground.
25V278000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrect ground connection increases the risk of a fire.
25V278000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will repair the wiring at the entry door, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 2, 2025.  Owners may contact Forest River Bus customer service at 800-348-7440.  Forest River Bus's number for this recall is 05-1925.
25V278000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V270000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
25V270000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015 F-250, F-350, F-450, Expedition, Lincoln Navigator, and MKC vehicles.  The rearview camera printed circuit board terminal header connector may be loose or damaged, which can result in a blank or distorted image.
25V270000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A blank or distorted rearview camera image can reduce the driver's view of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V270000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the rearview camera, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 16, 2025. Owners may contact Ford Customer Service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S42.   This recall expands previous recall number 22V-082.
25V270000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V253000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2022-2025 C 300, and 2023-2024 AMG C 43 vehicles.  The driver-side seat belt cover may not be properly installed on the seat belt tensioner, which can cause the seat belt anchor to come loose.
25V253000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose seat belt may not properly restrain an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
25V253000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the seat belt covers, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 16, 2025.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.  MBUSA's number for this recall is 2025040012.
25V253000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V266000.DESC_DEFECT: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2025-2026 IC CESB and 2025 EVSB school buses.  The driver's seat belt anchor bolt may come loose.
25V266000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose seat belt may not properly restrain the driver in a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
25V266000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install spacers and tighten the seat belt anchor bolts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 2, 2025.  Owners may contact International customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  International's number for this recall is 25504.
25V266000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V250000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2014-2016 AT200A aerial devices.  Cracks may develop in the legs of the mounting frame, which can cause the mounting frame side plate to break.
25V250000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken side plate may result in pedestal and truck frame separation, increasing the risk of injury.
25V250000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Altec will provide instructions for owners to inspect the mounting frame side plates for cracks.  If cracks are found, Altec will repair the side plates as necessary, or provide a repair kit, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed in April 2025.  Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832.  Altec's number for this recall is CSN 3215.
25V250000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY: 1-888-275-9171), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

25V231000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2025 Ram 1500 vehicles.  A software error may cause an incorrect tire inflation pressure message to display on the instrument panel.
25V231000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrect tire pressure message may result in improperly inflated tires, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V231000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the instrument panel software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed beginning April 24, 2025.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is 30C.
25V231000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V223000.COMPNAME: SUSPENSION:FRONT:SPRINGS:LEAF SPRING ASSEMBLY:U-BOLT, LEAF SPRING TO AXLE
25V223000.DESC_DEFECT: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2023 G5 school buses.  The u-bolts securing the suspension blades may break.
25V223000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken bolt may allow the suspension to shift or detach, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V223000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace main screw and the u-bolts as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 22, 2025.  Owners can contact Micro Bird Customer Service at 819-477-2012.  Micro Bird's number for this recall is 25-114-UUS.
25V223000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171) or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V206000.DESC_DEFECT: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain Blue Arc BA4L-800 vehicles equipped with Aries LFP battery packs.  The battery pack may be improperly sealed and allow liquid to enter the battery.
25V206000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Liquid intrusion into a battery pack can cause a loss of electrical isolation or short circuit, increasing the risk of a fire or shock hazard.
25V206000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Shyft will work with Our Next Energy to inspect and repair, or replace the battery packs as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 17, 2025.  Owners may contact Shyft customer service at 1-800-237-7806.  Shyft Group's number for this recall is 25-08.
25V206000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V214000.DESC_DEFECT: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2023-2026 New VN trucks.  The hazard switch back lighting may become inoperative.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."
25V214000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A hazard switch that is not illuminated may be difficult to locate when needed, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
25V214000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the vehicle master control unit (VMCU) software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 25, 2025.  Owners may contact Volvo Trucks' customer service at 800-528-6586.  Volvo Trucks' number for this recall is RVXX2503.
25V214000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V200000.DESC_DEFECT: Great Dane Trailers (Great Dane) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Champion Dry Van trailers equipped with Bridgestone R123 Ecopia tires, size 295/75R22.5.  The tires may have been manufactured incorrectly with one of the three stabilizer ply belts applied in the wrong orientation.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 119, "New pneumatic tires - other than passenger cars."
25V200000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect belt orientation may cause the tires to fail and increase the risk of a crash.
25V200000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Bridgestone (BATO) dealers will replace the tires, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed May 27, 2025.  Owners may contact BATO customer service at 1-800-847-3272 or Great Dane customer service at 1-877-369-3493.
25V200000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V193000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025 Cadillac LYRIQ vehicles.  The owner's manual inaccurately describes the rear outboard head restraints.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 202, "Head Restraints."
25V193000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect head restraint information may lead to improperly adjusted head restraints, increasing the risk of injury in a crash.
25V193000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: GM will mail owner's manual inserts with the correct illustrations and descriptions for rear outboard head restraints, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 30, 2025.  Owners may contact Cadillac customer service at 1-800-458-8006.  GM's number for this recall is N252492340.
25V193000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

25V190000.DESC_DEFECT: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2012, 2015-2019, and 2024 G5 school buses equipped with Type 2 seat belts.  The seat reinforcement supports may not have been installed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 207, "Seating Systems" and 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."
25V190000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An insufficiently retained seat can detach during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
25V190000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install reinforcement supports, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 21, 2025.  Owners may contact Micro Bird customer service at 1-819-477-2012.  Micro Bird's number for this recall is 25-113-FUS.
25V190000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V177000.DESC_DEFECT: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2025 IC Bus CECB buses equipped with halogen headlights.  When the high beams are activated, the low beams turn off.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
25V177000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Headlight low beam failure can reduce visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V177000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the body control module (BCM) software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 28, 2025.  Owners may contact International customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  International's number for this recall is 25503.
25V177000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V147000.DESC_DEFECT: Ineos Automotive Americas, LLC (Ineos) is recalling certain 2024 Grenadier vehicles.  The door button mechanism may have been assembled without a sufficient application of grease, preventing the door from fully latching.
25V147000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unlatched door can open unexpectedly while the vehicle is in motion, increasing the risk of injury.
25V147000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Ineos will replace the door button assemblies, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on September 12, 2025. Owners may contact Ineos customer service at 1-833-494-4748.
25V147000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V146000.DESC_DEFECT: Kawasaki Motor Corp., U.S.A. (KMC) is recalling certain 2024 Ninja 500 (ABS, KRT Edition, KRT Edition SE ABS, SE ABS, SE 40th Anniversary Edition ABS), Z500 ABS, and Z500 SE ABS motorcycles.  The clutch release shaft was not properly welded, which can cause the clutch lever to break apart.
25V146000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken clutch release lever may not disengage, disabling the motorcycle and increasing the risk of a crash.
25V146000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the clutch release shaft, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 24, 2025.  Owners may contact KMC customer service at 1-866-802-9381.  KMC's number for this recall is MC25-04.
25V146000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V141000.DESC_DEFECT: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd. (Triumph) is recalling certain 2025 Speed Twin 1200, Speed Twin 1200 RS, and Speed Twin 900 motorcycles.  The red rear turn signals were installed too close to the rear tail light.  As such, these motorcycles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, reflective devices, and associated Equipment."
25V141000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Rear turn signals that are too close to the tail lights can cause difficulty seeing the motorcycle's intentions, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V141000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the red rear turn signals with amber colored turn signals, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 20, 2025.  Owners may contact Triumph customer service at 1-678-854-2010.  Triumph's number for this recall is SRAN 630.
25V141000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V120000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE
25V120000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2021-2023 ID.4, 2022-2023 Audi Q4 e-Tron, and Q4 e-Tron Sportback vehicles. The instrument panel may not properly display the transmission gear lever indicator.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 102, "Transmission Shift Lever Sequence, Starter Interlock, and Transmission Braking Effect."
25V120000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Failure to display the gear position may result in a vehicle rollaway if the parking brake is not engaged, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V120000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the brake control unit software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 14, 2025.  Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298 or Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Volkswagen's number for this recall is 97H3.  Audi's number for this recall is 454R.
25V120000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V113000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River Bus, LLC (Forest River Bus) is recalling certain 2024 Starcraft Allstar Transit buses.  The handle for the emergency exit window may not be visible to someone standing in the aisle, which can delay passengers from exiting in the event of an emergency.
25V113000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A delay in exiting the vehicle during an emergency increases the risk of injury.
25V113000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the bottom handle windows with side handle windows, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 24, 2025.  Owners may contact Forest River Bus customer service at 800-348-7440.  Forest River Bus's number for this recall is 05-1896.
25V113000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V112000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Coachmen Catalina ACAT35FME travel trailers.  The towing coupler may be underrated for the Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) of the trailer.
25V112000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An underrated towing coupler can break, allowing the trailer to detach from the tow vehicle and increasing the risk of a crash.
25V112000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the coupler, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed April 2, 2025.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 574-825-4995.  Forest River's number for this recall is 205-1897.
25V112000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V744000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Toyota, Lexus, and Subaru Solterra vehicles equipped with a Panoramic View Monitor (PVM) system. Please see the recall report for a complete list of models. A software error may cause the rearview camera to freeze or display a blank screen when the vehicle is in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V744000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera that fails to display an image can reduce the driver's view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V744000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the parking assist software, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed January 2, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 25TB13 and 25LB06. Subaru's number for this recall is WRE25.

25V910000.DESC_DEFECT: Spartan Fire, LLC (Spartan) is recalling certain 2021-2023, 2025 Spartan Fire Legend, 2007, 2015-2026 Star Series, and 2019-2020 UST Body emergency vehicles.  A handle may detach from the ladder lock assembly, allowing the ground ladders to fall off.
25V910000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached handle or ladder can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V910000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the rod and handle as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed February 2, 2026. Owners may contact Spartan customer service at 1-517-543-6400. Spartan's number for this recall is 26001.

25V851000.DESC_DEFECT: Blue Bird Bus Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Vision and All American school buses equipped with QRT-Deluxe and QRT-Max wheelchair restraints. The retractors may not lock, preventing the wheelchair from being properly secured.
25V851000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unsecured wheelchair can move during transit, increasing the risk of injury.
25V851000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Blue Bird will work with Q'Straint to inspect and replace the retractors as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed January 29, 2026. Owners may contact Blue Bird customer service at 1-478-822-2242.

25V904000.DESC_DEFECT: Terminal Investment Corporation (TICO) is recalling certain 2018-2026 Pro Spotter Tandem tractors. The track rod mounting bracket for the forward rear axle, of the tandem axles set may crack and break, which can result in track rod detachment.
25V904000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Track rod detachment can cause a loss of vehicle steering control and increase the risk of a crash.
25V904000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the track rod mounting bracket as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed May 22, 2026. Owners may contact TICO customer service at 1-843-536-8139.

25V566000.DESC_DEFECT: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2013, 2017-2025 XE40, 2019-2025 XE60, XE35, 2023-2025 XHE40, and 2024-2025 XHE60 buses. An inadequate weld on the high voltage battery busbar and incorrect software may cause the battery module to overheat.
25V566000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A battery module that overheats increases the risk of a fire.
25V566000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: New Flyer will inspect and replace the battery module as necessary. New Flyer will also update the BMS software. All repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 6, 2025. Owners may contact New Flyer's customer service at 1-800-241-2947.

25V279000.DESC_DEFECT: Temsa is recalling certain 2021-2025 TS30, TS35, and 2021-2026 TS45 buses equipped with a Mux5-B multiplex.  The temporary bus stop valve may activate unintentionally and apply the brakes, causing them to overheat.
25V279000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Brakes that overheat can increase the risk of a fire.
25V279000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Temsa will inspect the multiplex, update the software, and repair the wiring harness as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 11, 2025.  Owners may contact Temsa customer service at 1-833-628-3672.
25V279000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V534000.DESC_DEFECT: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2026 MV vehicles. The battery interconnect cable may contact the auxiliary stud and hold down bracket, causing a short circuit.
25V534000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A short circuit increases the risk of a fire.
25V534000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install three wind laces on the battery hold down and add a J-bolt between each battery to ensure 3 mm of terminal clearance, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 10, 2025. Owners may contact International customer service at 1-800-448-7825. International's number for this recall is 25513.

25V318000.DESC_DEFECT: Alliance RV, LLC (Alliance) is recalling certain 2023 Paradigm 295MK and Avenue 23RLS fifth wheels.  The freshwater tank may be installed incorrectly, which can result in the tank detaching from the vehicle.
25V318000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A freshwater tank that detaches from a vehicle can become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V318000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and remount the freshwater tank, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 16 2025.  Owners may contact Alliance customer service at 1-574-218-7165.

25V296000.DESC_DEFECT: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2025 Utilimaster Aeromaster vehicles.  The rear seat belts may not have been installed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
25V296000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A passenger riding without a seat belt has an increased risk of injury.
25V296000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to allow passengers to sit in the rear seats until the remedy has been completed.  Dealers will install the rear seat belt, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 29, 2025.  Owners may contact Shyft customer service at 1-800-237-7806.  Shyft Group's number for this recall is 25-10.
25V296000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V285000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc (Jayco) is recalling certain 2025 Entegra Launch and Jayco Terrain motorhomes.  An incorrect standard outlet was installed in the kitchen instead of a GFCI protected outlet.
25V285000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A lack of proper circuit protection increases the risk of electric shock and injury.
25V285000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the Non-GFCI breaker with a GFCI breaker at the load center for the proper circuit protection at the kitchen outlet, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 16, 2025.  Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267.  Jayco's number for this recall is 9903629.
25V285000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171), or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V271000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 F-150 vehicles.  The air bag warning label may be missing from the dashboard.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
