25V271000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A missing air bag warning label will not warn occupants about the risks of air bag deployment, increasing the risk of injury in a crash.
25V271000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Ford will mail owners the warning labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 7, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25C12.
25V271000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V245000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Coachmen Catalina, Forest River Aurora, Cascade, Cedar Creek, Cherokee, Sandpiper, Sierra, 2025 Campsite Reserve, Impression, Pause, Puma, Sabre, Salem, Vengeance, and Wildwood fifth wheel and travel trailers, equipped with a removable step assembly.  The clip-on bracket mounting bolts may come loose, allowing the steps to detach.
25V245000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Steps that detach while in use increase the risk of injury.
25V245000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair or replace the clip-on bracket as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 28, 2025.  Owners may contact customer service at Aurora & Catalina (1-574-825-4995), Campsite Reserve, Cascade, Cherokee, Sabre, Vengeance (1-260-499-2100), Cedar Creek (1-260-593-4000), Impression (1-574-327-2716), Pause (1-574-327-2681), Puma (1-574-642-0588), Sierra & Sandpiper (1-574-534-4574), and Salem & Wildwood (1-574-534-3167).  Forest River's number for this recall is 51-1915.
25V245000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171), or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V232000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Cadillac LYRIQ vehicles.  The left or right front stabilizer bar bracket bolts may have been improperly tightened, which can allow the bolts to loosen and separate from the vehicle frame.  A detached stabilizer bar or bracket can damage the vehicle's high voltage cables or EV battery coolant lines.
25V232000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Damaged cables or coolant lines can result in a vehicle shutdown, causing a loss of drive power and increasing the risk of a crash.
25V232000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and tighten the left and/or right stabilizer bar bracket bolts, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 8, 2025.  Owners may contact Cadilac customer service at 1-800-333-4223.  GM's number for this recall is N252494190.
25V232000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171) or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V210000.DESC_DEFECT: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2018-2025 CB300R motorcycles.  The headlights may flicker or shut off while driving.
25V210000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Loss of headlight illumination can reduce visibility, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
25V210000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the headlight assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 27, 2025.  Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 866-784-1870.  Honda's number for this recall is KS0.
25V210000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V208000.DESC_DEFECT: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2020-2026 DC (Legend) vehicles.  The incorrect blower motor fuse may have been installed.
25V208000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrect fuse may fail to trip, allowing the blower to short circuit and increasing the risk of a fire.
25V208000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the fuse, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 29, 2025.  Owners may contact Autocar customer service at 1-888-218-3611.  Autocar's number for this recall is DC-2503.
25V208000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V244000.DESC_DEFECT: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain 2024 Granturismo vehicles.  The tire label may detach from the driver's side B-Pillar.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
25V244000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Without a tire information label, the vehicle may be overloaded, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V244000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 7, 2025.  Owners may contact Maserati customer service at 877-696-2737.  Maserati's number for this recall is 784.
25V244000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V205000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
25V205000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Entegra Anthem, Aspire, and 2025 Reatta XL motorhomes, equipped with Cummins L9 diesel engines.  The remote fuel filter hose may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
25V205000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.  An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
25V205000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Cummins will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 15, 2025.  Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267.
25V205000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V097000.DESC_DEFECT: Thor Motor Coach (TMC) is recalling certain 2023 Gemini and Compass motorhomes.  Washers were not installed with the roof mounting brackets.
25V097000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Without washers, the solar panel can detach and become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V097000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and install washers on the mounting brackets as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 26, 2025.  Owners may contact TMC customer service at 877-855-2867.  TMC's number for this recall is RC000322.
25V097000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V184000.DESC_DEFECT: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Nova Bus LFS transit buses.  The high voltage batteries may have loose hardware that can fall inside the battery pack and create a short circuit.
25V184000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A short circuit increases the risk of a fire.
25V184000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Nova Bus will replace the batteries, free of charge.   Owner notification letters were mailed June 5, 2025.  A second letter will be sent once the remedy is available.  Owners may contact Nova Bus customer service at 800-350-6682.  Nova Bus's number for this recall is CR5687.
25V184000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V165000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Escape and 2021-2023 Bronco Sport vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall numbers 22V-859 or 24V-187.  A fuel injector may crack and leak fuel inside the engine compartment.
25V165000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source such as hot engine or exhaust components, can increase the risk of a fire.
25V165000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the powertrain control module (PCM) software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 22, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S21.
25V165000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V450000.DESC_DEFECT: Airstream, Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain 2025 - 2026 Interstate motorhomes. The Parametric Special Module (PSM) may fail to lock the controls, allowing the awning to be extended during transit.
25V450000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An extended awning can detach, becoming a road hazard and increasing the risk of a crash.
25V450000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will correct the PSM pinning assignment, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 31, 2025. Owners may contact Airstream customer service at 1-877-596-6505 or 1-937-596-6111 ext. 7401 or 7411.

25V154000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:FOUNDATION COMPONENTS:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
25V154000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 X3 30 xDrive and X3 M50 xDrive vehicles.  The rear brake hoses may leak, causing a loss of rear brake function, and a loss of the Antilock Brake System (ABS) and the Dynamic Stability Control (DSC) system.
25V154000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of rear brake function increases the risk of a crash.
25V154000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the rear brake hoses, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 9, 2025.  Owners may contact BMW customer service at 800-525-7417.
25V154000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V152000.DESC_DEFECT: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2025 Utilimaster Upfit vehicles.  The passenger jump seat mounting bolts may not have been properly tightened.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 207, "Seating Systems."
25V152000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat with loose bolts may not properly restrain an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
25V152000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and tighten the jump seat mounting bolts, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 26, 2025.  Owners may contact Shyft customer service at 1-800-237-7806.  Shyft Group's number for this recall is 25-07.
25V152000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V138000.DESC_DEFECT: Motiv Power Systems, Inc. (Motiv) is recalling certain 2017-2020 E-450 and F-59 school buses with Gen 4 EPIC powertrain, and 2020-2023 E-450, F-59, and F-53 school buses with a Gen 5 EPIC powertrain.  A throttle position sensor (TPS) power wire connector pin may loosen, causing a loss of signal to the powertrain control module and a loss of drive power.
25V138000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
25V138000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Motiv field support technicians will inspect and repair, or replace the PCM connector, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 23, 2025.  Owners may contact Motiv customer service at 1-650-458-4804.
25V138000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-888-275-9171), or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V140000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2025 Jayco Eagle fifth wheels, Eagle HT fifth wheels, and Eagle HT travel trailers.  The certification label states incorrect tire load and tire size information.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
25V140000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect tire information could result in the wrong tires being installed on the trailer, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V140000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Jayco will mail replacement labels to owners, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 14, 2025.  Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267.  Jayco's number for this recall is 9901621.
25V140000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171), or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V123000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Maverick Hybrid vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 24V-140.  The instrument panel cluster may not properly illuminate warning lights or gauges.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 101, "Control and Displays," and 102, "Transmission shift position sequence, starter interlock, and transmission braking effect" as well as FMVSS numbers 105, 108, and 208.
25V123000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument panel that does not illuminate critical safety information, such as the speedometer or warning lights, can increase the risk of a crash.
25V123000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the instrument panel cluster software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 9, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25C06.
25V123000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V124000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE
25V124000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 Maverick vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 24V-730.  Under certain circumstances, the Antilock Brake System (ABS) module may cause the brake lights to illuminate without the driver applying the brakes.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
25V124000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Unintended illumination of the brake lights may confuse other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V124000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the software in the ABS module, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 14, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25C07.
25V124000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V121000.DESC_DEFECT: REV Recreation Group (REV) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Fleetwood Bounder, Flair, Fortis, Holiday Rambler Admiral, Invicta, Vacationer, 2023-2025 Fleetwood Flex, Holiday Rambler Eclipse, and 2022-2023 Fleetwood Southwind motorhomes.  The engine exhaust tip may detach, allowing exhaust fumes to enter the cabin.
25V121000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Exhaust fumes inside the cabin increases the risk of injury or death from carbon monoxide poisoning.  In addition, a detached exhaust tip can become a road hazard for other road users, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V121000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a clamp to the exhaust tip, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed April 26, 2025.  Owners may contact REV customer service at 1-800-509-3417.  REV's number for this recall is 250221REV.
25V121000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-888-275-9171), or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V119000.DESC_DEFECT: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2025 Serenova travel trailers.  The axle bearing nut may have been improperly tightened, causing the bearings to overheat.
25V119000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overheated bearings can increase the risk of a fire or cause the tire to detach from the travel trailer, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V119000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the bearings as needed, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 25, 2025.  Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679.  Grand Design's number for this recall is 910049.
25V119000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V117000.DESC_DEFECT: Textron Specialized Vehicles (Textron) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Cushman Hauler Pro LSV, Tour LSV, and E-Z-GO Liberty LSV vehicles.  The side and rear reflectors insufficiently reflect light.  As such, these lights fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
25V117000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Without properly reflective equipment, it may be difficult for other road users to see the vehicle from the rear or side, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V117000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: E-Z-Go or Cushman will mail new reflectors to owners, and dealers will be able to install, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on March 24, 2025.  Owners may call Textron Specialized Vehicles Customer Service at 706-799-4768.
25V117000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V106000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2022-2024 X3 sDrive30i and X3 xDrive30i vehicles.  The second-row seat side door locking modules may not function properly and allow the doors to be unlocked with a single motion.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 206, "Door Locks and Door Retention Components."
25V106000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Doors that can be inadvertently unlocked and unlatched may open unexpectedly, increasing the risk of injury to rear seat occupants.
25V106000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the second-row seat side door locking modules, free of charge.  A letter informing owners of the safety risk was mailed on April 21, 2025.  Owners may contact BMW customer service at 800-525-7417.
25V106000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V098000.DESC_DEFECT: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Grecale, 2023-2025 MC20 Cielo, 2024 Granturismo, GranCabrio, 2021-2024 Levante, Ghibli, Quattroporte, and 2022-2025 MC 20 vehicles.  The radio software may prevent the rearview image from displaying.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V098000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera image that does not display decreases the driver's visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V098000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The radio software will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a dealer, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 10, 2025.  Owners may contact Maserati customer service at 877-696-2737.  Maserati's number for this recall is 740.
25V098000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V064000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 IONIQ 5 EV vehicles.  The rear floor wiring harness may contain an open circuit, which can result in the rear side air bag not deploying as intended.
25V064000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rear side air bag that does not deploy as intended can increase the risk of injury in a crash.
25V064000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the rear floor wiring harness, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 12, 2025.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 274.
25V064000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V061000.DESC_DEFECT: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2019-2024 Grand Design Solitude fifth wheel trailers.  The step tread joints may be unsupported, causing the tread to break.
25V061000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken step increases the risk of injury.
25V061000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reinforce the current step tread with a metal bracket, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 22, 2025.  Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679.  Grand Design's number for this recall is 910048.
25V061000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V050000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2022-2025 EQB 250, EQB 300 4MATIC, and EQB 350 4MATIC electric vehicles.  The high voltage battery may fail internally and lead to a vehicle fire while parked or driving.
25V050000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A vehicle fire while parked or driving can increase the risk of injury.
25V050000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to only charge their vehicles to a maximum of 80% battery capacity until the repair has been completed.  Dealers will update the battery management system software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on  May 22, 2025. This is a phased recall. Phase 1 owner letters were mailed on May 22, 2025. Phase 2 owner letters were mailed on October 31, 2025 and Phase 3 owner letters were mailed on December 12, 2025. Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.  MBUSA's number for this recall is 2025040005.
25V050000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V048000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
25V048000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021 Expedition, 2021-2022 Super Duty F-250, F-350, F-450, F-550, F-600, and 2020-2022 Lincoln Corsair vehicles.  The rearview camera may display a blank or distorted image.
25V048000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Rearview camera failure can reduce the driver's view of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V048000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the rearview camera as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 18, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S05.
25V048000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V051000.DESC_DEFECT: Roadtrek Inc. (Roadtrek) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Westfalia Wave Pop Top vans.  The Occupant and Cargo Carrying Capacity (OCCC) and Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) labels list the incorrect weight.
25V051000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Referencing an incorrect label may lead to unintentionally overloading the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V051000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 18, 2025.  Owners may contact Roadtrek customer service at 1-888-762-3873.  Roadtrek's number for this recall is 2025-01.
25V051000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V036000.DESC_DEFECT: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2020-2026 Autocar DC (Legend) trucks.  The cab shock absorber bracket fasteners may have been improperly secured, allowing the fasteners to detach.
25V036000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached fastener can become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V036000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and secure or replace the fasteners as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 27, 2025.  Owners may contact Autocar at 1-888-218-3611.  Autocar's number for this recall is DC-2502.
25V036000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V030000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2010-2018 MRU and 2019-2025 Terrapro towing vehicles.  The vehicles are missing the anti-lock brake (ABS) warning light and circuitry that controls the anti-lock brake function for an attached trailer.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 121, "Air Brake Systems."
25V030000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Driving without a functioning anti-lock brake system may result in the trailer not braking as intended, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V030000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will add an ABS warning light and circuitry, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 28, 2025.  Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177.  Mack's number for this recall is SC0474.
25V030000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V580000.DESC_DEFECT: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2016-2026 IC Bus CESB and 2016-2021 RESB school buses. The underfloor reinforcement may not have been installed, compromising the structural integrity of the buses. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages" and 222, "School Bus Passenger Seating and Crash Protection."
25V580000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Reduced structural integrity may increase the risk of injury in a crash.
25V580000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and install a reinforcement channel as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed December 8, 2025. Owners may contact International customer service at 1-800-448-7825. International's number for this recall is 25514.

25V615000.DESC_DEFECT: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Polestar 2 vehicles. The rearview camera image may not display when the vehicle is placed in reverse.
25V615000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera image that does not display reduces the driver's view of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V615000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the vehicle software, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed June 4, 2026. Owners may contact Polestar's customer service at 1-800-806-2504. Polestar's number for this recall is RP1069. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning April 20, 2026. This recall replaces previous NHTSA recalls 24V477 and 25V280.  Vehicles previously repaired under those recalls will need to have the new remedy performed.

25V563000.COMPNAME: POWER TRAIN:AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION:PARK/NEUTRAL START INTERLOCK SWITCH
25V563000.DESC_DEFECT: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2025-2026 G5e school buses. The transmission interlock may allow the vehicle to be put into gear when the rear emergency door is locked. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."
25V563000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An emergency exit that is locked can prevent or delay occupants from exiting the vehicle during an emergency, increasing the risk of injury.
25V563000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the transmission interlock as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 27, 2025. Owners can contact Micro Bird Customer Service at 819-477-2012. Micro Bird's number for this recall is 25-115-EUS.

25V442000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2018-2022 Transit Connect, 2019-2020 MKZ, MKX,  Edge, Continental, F-150, Nautilus, Fusion, 2019-2023 Ranger, Mustang, 2020-2021 EcoSport, Expedition, Navigator, 2020-2022 Escape, F-250 SD, Corsair, 2020-2023 Aviator, Transit, 2020-2024 Explorer, 2021-2024 Bronco Sport, and 2022-2024 Maverick vehicles. A software error may cause the rearview camera to display a blank image, or the image may remain on the display after the backing event has ended.
25V442000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera that displays a blank image can reduce the driver's view behind the vehicle. A rearview image that continues to be displayed after the vehicle is shifted out of reverse may distract the driver. Both of these situations can increase the risk of a crash.
25V442000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the rearview camera software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 4, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S72.

25V552000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
25V552000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2019-2021 Ram ProMaster and 2019-2020 Dodge Journey vehicles. Cracks in the microprocessor may cause the vehicle's rearview camera image not to display properly. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility.
25V552000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview image that does not display properly reduces the driver's view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V552000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the rearview camera, free of charge. Interim notification letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, were mailed beginning September 30, 2025. A second notice will be sent once the final remedy is available, anticipated July 2026. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 59C.

25V553000.DESC_DEFECT: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2013 LFS transit buses. The coolant hoses routed through the HVAC roof unit may fail and leak coolant into the passenger seating area.
25V553000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Hot coolant that leaks into the passenger seating area increases the risk of injury.
25V553000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Nova Bus will inspect and replace the hoses, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 22, 2025. Owners may contact Nova Bus customer service at 1-450-472-6410. Nova Bus' number for this recall is CR5752. Vehicles in this recall were previously recalled under 18V117.

25V559000.COMPNAME: LANE DEPARTURE: LANE KEEP: AUTOMATIC STEERING
25V559000.DESC_DEFECT: VinFast Auto, LLC (VinFast) is recalling certain 2023-2025 VF8 vehicles. The Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) may activate during wide turns, causing unexpected steering wheel movements that are difficult for the driver to override.
25V559000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A steering wheel that moves unexpectedly may increase the risk of a crash.
25V559000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: VinFast will update the ADAS software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 27, 2025. Owners may contact VinFast customer service at 1-833-503-0600.

25V486000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
25V486000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Sunseeker, Solera, Forester, Freelander, Leprechaun, and East to West Entrada motorhomes. The fuel line extension connectors  may have inconsistent crimps, allowing the fuel line to detach.
25V486000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached fuel line can leak, increasing the risk of a fire.
25V486000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the fuel lines as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed beginning September 26, 2025. Entrada owners may contact customer service at 1-574-264-6664. Forester, Solera, and Sunseeker owners may contact customer service at 1-574-206-7600. Leprechaun and Freelander owners may contact customer service at 1-574-825-8602. Forest River's number for this recall is 51-1955.

25V024000.DESC_DEFECT: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Niro EV, Plug-in Hybrid (PHEV), and Hybrid vehicles.  The floor wiring assembly beneath the front passenger seat may become damaged, which can prevent the front air bags and seat belts from deploying properly or cause an unintended side curtain air bag deployment.
25V024000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Air bags and seat belts that deploy improperly or an air bag deploying unintentionally can increase the risk of injury in a crash.
25V024000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect, replace and reroute the floor wiring assembly, as necessary, free of charge.  In addition, dealers will install wiring covers.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 27, 2025.  Owners may contact Kia customer service at 1-800-333-4542.  Kia's number for this recall is SC332.
25V024000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V476000.DESC_DEFECT: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2020-2023 LFS transit buses. The electric power steering system may be missing a check valve, allowing hydraulic pressure to turn the steering wheel without the driver's input.
25V476000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A steering wheel that turns unintentionally increases the risk of a crash or injury.
25V476000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Nova Bus will install a check valve, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 11, 2025. Owners may contact Nova Bus customer service at 1-450-472-6410. Nova Bus' number for this recall is CR5746.

25V526000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2025 Tiguan vehicles. A tie rod bolt on the rear axle assembly may be loose, which can lead to a loss of vehicle control.
25V526000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of vehicle control increases the risk of a crash.
25V526000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the affected tie rod bolt, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 5, 2025. Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 800-893-5298. Volkswagen's number for this recall is 42E7.

25V525000.DESC_DEFECT: The Heil Co. (Heil) is recalling certain 2018-2020 front end loader garbage trucks. Excessive vibrations may cause the front head hydraulic tubes to leak.
25V525000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A hydraulic fluid leak in the presence of an ignition source, such as hot engine or exhaust components, can increase the risk of a fire.
25V525000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Heil will install stabilizing clamps, new hydraulic tubes, and update the software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 30, 2025. Owners may contact Heil's customer service at 1-866-275-4345.

25V481000.DESC_DEFECT: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2024 Convoy, 2023-2026 GH1, 2025 GT1, and 2026 GH2 motorhomes equipped with 2.0 liter engine. The secondary alternator controller programming was not properly updated.
25V481000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Improper programming can cause the engine to stall, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V481000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a wire harness and update the alternator programming, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 19, 2025. Owners may contact Tiffin customer service at 1-256-356-8661. Tiffin's number for this recall is TIF-145.

25V482000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 IONIQ 5 vehicles. The high voltage battery system may contain an improperly tightened bus bar, which can cause a short-circuit.
25V482000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An electrical short in the high voltage battery system increases the risk of a fire.
25V482000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park their vehicles outside and away from structures until the recall remedy is complete. Dealers will inspect and repair the high voltage battery system, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 25, 2025. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 280.

25V466000.MFGNAME: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
25V466000.DESC_DEFECT: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Jaguar) is recalling certain 2021-2024 E-Pace vehicles. The passenger air bag may tear during deployment.
25V466000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A torn air bag may not adequately protect an occupant in a crash, increasing the risk of injury. Additionally, a torn air bag may allow hot gases to escape, which can cause a burn injury.
25V466000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the passenger air bag module, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed February 6, 2026. Owners may contact Jaguar's customer service at 1-800-452-4827. Jaguar's number for this recall is H552.

25V444000.DESC_DEFECT: Oshkosh Corporation (Oshkosh Defense) is recalling certain 2025 NGDV delivery vehicles. The air bag warning label on the sun visor may detach. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
25V444000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A missing label cannot warn occupants about the risks of air bag deployment, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
25V444000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Oshkosh Defense will replace the sun visor assembly and add an electric shock warning label as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 18, 2025. Owners may contact Oshkosh customer service at 1-833-304-8100. Oshkosh's number for this recall is NGDV_TSB_040.

25V011000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2017-2019 Jeep Cherokee vehicles.  The power transfer unit (PTU) may become damaged and disengage the transmission and differential, resulting in a loss of drive power and/or loss of park function.
25V011000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power can increase the risk of a crash.  A loss of park function can cause an unintended vehicle rollaway, which can increase the risk of a crash or injury.
25V011000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the drivetrain control module and PTU software and replace the PTU, as necessary free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed beginning February 19, 2026. Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is 01C.
25V011000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V434000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Atlas, Atlas Cross Sport and 2023-2024 ID.4 vehicles. Certain bolts on the chassis, brake system and/or suspension (such as bolts for certain  cross member, engine mount, control arm, subframe, rear brake carrier, etc.) of affected vehicles may not have been correctly tightened during the manufacturing process.
25V434000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of vehicle control increases the risk of a crash.
25V434000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the bolts as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 25, 2025. Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834. Volkswagen's number for this recall is 42HX.

25V430000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023 Jeep Grand Cherokee and Jeep Grand Cherokee L vehicles. The blower motor may fail, which can cause the defrosting and defogging system to be inoperative. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 103, "Windshield Defrosting and Defogging Systems."
25V430000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An inoperative windshield defrosting and defogging system may decrease the driver's visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V430000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the blower motor, as necessary free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 8, 2025. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  Chrysler's number for this recall is 49C.

25V419000.DESC_DEFECT: Subaru of America, Inc. (Subaru) is recalling certain 2025 Forester vehicles. The child seat anchor bolts may have been improperly tightened, allowing the bolts to come loose.
25V419000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loose child seat anchor bolt increases the risk of injury to a child during a crash.
25V419000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the child seat anchor bolts and, if necessary, tighten the bolts, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed August 15, 2025. Owners may contact Subaru customer service at 1-844-373-6614. Subaru's number for this recall is WRC-25.

25V204000.DESC_DEFECT: Bollinger Motors, Inc. (Bollinger Motors) is recalling certain 2025 B4 trucks.  The high voltage battery pack may be improperly sealed and allow liquid to enter the battery.
25V204000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Liquid intrusion into a battery pack can cause a loss of electrical isolation or short circuit, increasing the risk of a fire or shock hazard.  In addition, the detection of a battery fault can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V204000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Bollinger Motors will work with Our Next Energy to inspect and repair the battery packs as necessary, free of charge.  Owners can contact Bolling Motors at 586-785-7351.
25V204000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V370000.DESC_DEFECT: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2022-2025 R1T and R1S vehicles. The D-ring bolts for one or both front seat belt anchorage assemblies may not have been properly installed.
25V370000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly secured seat belt may not restrain an occupant as intended, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
25V370000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Rivian will inspect and properly secure the seat belt anchorage assemblies as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 8, 2025. Owners may contact Rivian customer service at 1-888-748-4261. Rivian's number for this recall is FSAM-1681.

25V358000.DESC_DEFECT: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2024 XL750, 2025 CMX1100, and CRF1100 motorcycles. The crankcase sealing bolt may have been improperly manufactured, which can cause the engine to leak oil onto the rear tire.
25V358000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Oil on the rear tire may cause a loss of control, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
25V358000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the crankcase sealing bolt, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 15, 2025. Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-866-784-1870.  Honda's number for this recall is KS2.

25V356000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023 â 2024 model year Cadillac Lyriq vehicles. The driver video display may go blank while driving.
25V356000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A blank video display can result in a loss of critical safety information, such as the speedometer, warning lights, and rearview camera image, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V356000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The video display control module software will be updated by a dealer, or through an over-the-air (OTA) update, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed July 14, 2025. Owners may contact Cadillac customer service at 1-800-333-4223. GM's number for this recall is N252500680.

25V343000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Lincoln Nautilus, 2023-2025 Escape, 2023 Lincoln Corsair, 2025 Lincoln Corsair, Maverick, and Bronco Sport vehicles equipped with a 1.5L or 2.0L MPC engine and an engine block heater. The engine block heater may overheat when the vehicle is parked with the block heater plugged in.
25V343000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated engine block heater can increase the risk of a fire.
25V343000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the block heater element and inspect the electrical cord, replacing it if necessary, free of charge. Owners will also have a alternative option to replace engine block heater element with a threaded blanking plug coupled, and remove the block heater electrical cord. Owner notification letters were mailed June 9, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S52.

25V313000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2023 F-150 Lightning vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 23V801.  The SYNC software may fail to activate the electronic stability control (ESC) system at the beginning of each ignition cycle.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 126, "Electronic Stability Control Systems."
25V313000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Failure to reset the ESC to active may result in the driver unknowingly operating the vehicle without electronic stability control, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V313000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the Accessory Protocol Interface Module (APIM) software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 18, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25C15.
25V313000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V338000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Lincoln Aviator and  Lincoln Corsair vehicles equipped with a Revel Audio System that were repaired incorrectly under recall 22V-953. When the driver's seat belt is not buckled and the vehicle is started, the seat belt warning system may activate the audible warning chime for an insufficient amount of time of less than 4 seconds. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
25V338000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An audible warning chime that does not properly alert of an unbelted seat belt can increase the risk of injury during a crash.
25V338000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the audio control module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 3, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25C18.

25V347000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2016-2017 Explorer vehicles. The driver and front passenger B-Pillar door trim may detach while driving.
25V347000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Door trim that detaches while driving can create a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V347000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will repair the B-pillar trim, free of charge. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, were mailed June 5, 2025. A second notice will be sent once the final remedy is available, anticipated November 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S53.

25V346000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020 Expedition and Navigator vehicles that were repaired incorrectly under recall 20V262. The Pre-Collision Assist features, such as forward collision warning and automatic emergency braking, are not functional due to a software error.
25V346000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Inoperative pre-collision assist features that fail to perform as expected can increase the risk of a crash or injury.
25V346000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the body control module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 25, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S56.

25V330000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
25V330000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Ram ProMaster vehicles. A software error in the security gateway module may cause the rearview camera image not to display. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V330000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview image that does not display reduces the driver's view of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V330000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the security gateway module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 12, 2025. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 40C.

25V478000.DESC_DEFECT: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Revel Sport, 2024-2025 Vita, 2025 Porto, Adventure Wagon, 2024-2026 View, Revel, Navion, and Ekko motorhomes. Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) wires can be caught in the seat mechanism when the driver or passenger seats are adjusted.
25V478000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Damaged wires can prevent air bags from deploying in a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
25V478000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and re-route the wiring, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 19, 2025. Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-641-585-6939 or 1-800-537-1885. Winnebago's number for this recall is 199.

25V327000.DESC_DEFECT: Braun Ambulances (Braun Ambulances) is recalling certain 2016-2018 Demers MXP150E, MX164E, 2016-2024 Transit TSE, 2024 Transit TXE, and 2018- 2020 Demers Ambulances vehicles. The cushion equipment storage may not have been properly installed, resulting in unsecured equipment.
25V327000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Items that detach during transit increase the risk of injury.
25V327000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the cushion assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed July 18, 2025.  Owners may contact Braun Ambulances customer service at 1-877-344-9990.  Braun Ambulances number for this recall is Cushion.

25V502000.DESC_DEFECT: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2018 International 4000 Series 4300, 2017-2025 MV, 2018-2024 1300 FBC, 2018-2025 IC Bus TC, and 2024-2025 IC Bus CECB vehicles. The brake pressure switch assembly may leak brake fluid into the brake pressure switch's electrical components and cause an electrical short-circuit.
25V502000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An electrical short in the brake pressure switch can overheat the circuit and increase the risk of a fire while driving or parked.
25V502000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures until the recall repair is complete. Dealers will install a silicone black jumper harness, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 15, 2025. Owners may contact International customer service at 1-800-448-7825. International's number for this recall is 25509. Vehicles previously repaired under 23V397 will need to have the new remedy completed.

25V315000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Bronco, F-150, 2021-2024 Edge, 2022-2025 Escape, F-250, F-350, F-450, F-550, F-600, 2022-2024 Expedition, 2022-2025 Transit, 2021-2023 Mach-E, 2024 Ranger, Mustang, 2021-2023 Lincoln Nautilus, 2022-2024 Navigator, and 2023-2024 Corsair vehicles. A software error may cause the rearview camera image to delay, freeze, or not display when the vehicle is in reverse.
25V315000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A frozen or missing rearview camera image can reduce the driver's view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V315000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The accessory protocol interface module (APIM) software will be updated by a dealer or through an over-the-air update, free of charge. This will be a phased campaign, with the remedy becoming available in different phases based on model and model years. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk were mailed on June 26, 2025. Additional letters will be mailed once the final remedy is available on each phase. Owner notification letters were sent on October 8, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S49.
25V315000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V484000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Lincoln Aviator vehicles. When closing the windows with the global closing feature, the side rear windows may exert excessive force when encountering an object, before they automatically reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 118, "Power-Operated Window Systems."
25V484000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A closing window that does not reverse direction as expected can pinch a passenger before retracting, increasing the risk of injury.
25V484000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the Body Control Module (BCM) software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 7, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25C33.

25V185000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Mack LRBE trucks.  The high voltage batteries may have loose hardware that can fall inside the battery pack and create a short circuit.
25V185000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A short circuit increases the risk of a fire.
25V185000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the batteries, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 24, 2025.  Owner notification letters will be mailed on or before August 25, 2025, for the additional vehicles added on July 22, 2025. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177.  Mack's number for this recall is SC0475.
25V185000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V550000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:FOUNDATION COMPONENTS:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
25V550000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2018-2026 Riverstone fifth wheel trailers. The steel hydraulic brake lines may fail and leak brake fluid.
25V550000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A brake fluid leak can cause a loss of brake function, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V550000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the brake lines, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 19, 2025. Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 260-593-2425. Forest River's number for this recall is 70-1957.

25V505000.DESC_DEFECT: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC (Suzuki) is recalling certain 2020-2025 DL 1050 and 2020, 2024 GSX-1000S motorcycles. The upper headlight beam may be too bright and exceed the maximum light output, which may adversely affect the vision of the driver.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
25V505000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Headlights that are excessively bright can reduce visibility for oncoming drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V505000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Suzuki dealers will replace the headlight assembly, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed on November 7, 2025. Owners may contact Suzuki customer service at 1-800-934-0934. Suzuki's number for this recall is 3A06/3A07.

25V508000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:ENGINE CONTROL MODULE (ECU/ECM):SOFTWARE
25V508000.DESC_DEFECT: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2025 Nissan Frontier vehicles. Due to a software logic error, the daytime running lights may dim unexpectedly when the idle start-stop feature cycles the engine from off to on. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
25V508000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Daytime running lights that dim unexpectedly may cause confusion to other vehicles or pedestrians, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V508000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the engine control module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 17, 2025. Owners may contact Nissan's customer service at 800-647-7261. Nissan's number for this recall is R25C3.

25V535000.DESC_DEFECT: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC) is recalling certain 2023 PL500, 2023-2024 PL700, 2023-2025 RM500, RM900, ST450, 2024-2025 PL550, PL750, 2024 PR300, 2025 RM450, RM550, and RM800. A software error may cause the radio and speakers to overheat.
25V535000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overheated radio and speakers increase the risk of a fire.
25V535000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: ATC will work with Maxxsonics to mail instructions and a USB with a software update. All speakers will be inspected and replaced as necessary. Repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 24, 2025. Owners may call ATC customer service at 1-877-441-2440 ext. 342.

25V547000.DESC_DEFECT: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2026 Springdale and Hideout travel trailers. The pivot brackets on the bunk bed may bend or break.
25V547000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Bent or broken brackets may allow the bunk bed to fall, increasing the risk of injury.
25V547000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the brackets, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 5, 2025. Owners may contact Keystone customer service at 1-866-425-4369.  Keystone's number for this recall is 25-472.

25V554000.DESC_DEFECT: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2025 GT1 Touring vans. The seat belt buckles on the rear bench seat may be too short and not able to be buckled.
25V554000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat belt that is unable to be fastened increases the risk of injury in the event of a crash.
25V554000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the seat belt, as necessary free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 2, 2025. Owners may contact Tiffin customer service at 1-256-356-8661. Tiffin's number for this recall is TIF-146.

25V572000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
25V572000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015-2019 Lincoln MKC, Mustang, F-350 SD, F-250 SD, F-450 SD, 2015-2017 Lincoln Navigator, Expedition, 2015-2018 Edge, Transit Connect, 2016-2019 F-550 SD, Transit, 2017-2019 Econoline, and 2019 Ranger vehicles. The rearview camera may display a distorted, inverted, or blank image when the vehicle is in reverse.
25V572000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera that displays an inverted, distorted, or blank image can reduce the driverâs view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V572000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the rearview camera as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed January 13, 2026.  Ford owners will receive letters in phases, beginning January 2026 and June 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S89. This recall expands previous NHTSA recall number 25V270. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning September 8, 2025.

25V568000.COMPNAME: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:INSTRUMENT PANEL:FUEL GAUGE:FUEL LEVEL FLOAT/SENSOR/SENDING UNIT
25V568000.DESC_DEFECT: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2024-2025 CX-90 and 2025 CX-70 mild hybrid electric vehicles (MHEV). The fuel gauge in the instrument cluster may display an inaccurate fuel reading.
25V568000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An inaccurate fuel gauge may result in the vehicle unexpectedly running out of fuel and stalling, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V568000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the body control module (BCM) software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed October 24, 2025.  Owners may contact Mazda customer service at 1-800-222-5500 Option 6. The manufacturer's number for this recall is 78251.  The information in your report suggests that Mazda may have been aware of this issue more than five business days before filing a report with NHTSA.  Please be reminded that under Federal law, this agency is to be notified of all safety defect and/or noncompliance decisions within five business days.  49 CFR 573.6 Significant civil penalties can be assessed for this violation.

25V006000.DESC_DEFECT: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Sorento, 2025 Sorento Hybrid, and 2025 Sorento Plug-In Hybrid vehicles.  A software error in the Body Domain Control Unit (BDC) may cause a loss of low beam headlights and taillights.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
25V006000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of headlights and taillights can reduce visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V006000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the BDC software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 21, 2025.  Owners may contact Kia customer service at 1-800-333-4542.  Kia's number for this recall is SC331.
25V006000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V353000.DESC_DEFECT: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2024 Peterbilt 367, 2026 Peterbilt 548, 589, and 2024-2026 Peterbilt 567 trucks. The rear brake piping assembly may have insufficient clearance, which can result in a loss of service brakes or anti-lock brake function.
25V353000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Brake failure can increase the risk of a crash.
25V353000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install new brake hoses and correct the rear brake piping assembly, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed September 8, 2025. Owners may contact Peterbilt's customer service at 1-940-591-4220. PACCAR's number for this recall is 25PBE.

25V010000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2016-2019 Ram 3500, Ram 1500, 2016-2020 Ram 2500, and 2016 Ram 3500 Cab Chassis vehicles.  The right and left side curtain air bag inflators may rupture due to a manufacturing defect.
25V010000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An inflator rupture may result in sharp metal fragments striking occupants, resulting in injury.
25V010000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace one or both side curtain air bags, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 13, 2025.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's numbers for this recall are 05C, 09C, and 10C.
25V010000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V020000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Ford Explorer and Lincoln Aviator vehicles.  The transmission may be improperly secured due to loose cross member bolts.
25V020000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly secured transmission can result in a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V020000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the transmission cross member bolts as necessary, free of charge.  If the cross member bolts are missing, dealers will replace the cross member and install new bolts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 29, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S03.
25V020000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V021000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 East to West Ahara fifth wheel trailers.  The water heater exhaust is ventilated directly under the slideroom, allowing carbon monoxide to enter the vehicle.
25V021000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Carbon monoxide inside the vehicle increases the risk of carbon monoxide poisoning and death.
25V021000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to use the water heater until the remedy is performed.  Dealers will replace the water heater, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 31, 2025.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-264-6664.  Forest River's number for this recall is 503-1887.
25V021000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V028000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2018 Camry, 2019 Lexus NX300, and 2019 RX350L vehicles.  The low-pressure fuel pump inside the fuel tank may fail.
25V028000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Fuel pump failure can cause an engine stall, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V028000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the fuel pump assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 12, 2025.  Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331.  Toyota's numbers for this recall are 25TA01 and 25LA01.
25V028000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V032000.DESC_DEFECT: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2025 Acura MDX vehicles.  The touchscreen in the center console may go blank, resulting in the rearview camera image not displaying as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V032000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera that does not display an image can reduce the driver's rear view, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V032000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the center information display unit, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 3, 2025.  Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-888-234-2138.  Honda's number for this recall is RKZ.
25V032000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V493000.DESC_DEFECT: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2023-2025 K5 vehicles. The left and right rear window trim pieces may loosen and detach.
25V493000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Detached trim pieces can create a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V493000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the C-pillar trim assemblies, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed November 19, 2025. Owners may contact Kia customer service at 800-333-4542. Kia's number for this recall is SC346.

25V037000.MFGNAME: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc.
25V037000.DESC_DEFECT: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc. (MFTA) is recalling certain 2024 FEC7K and FEC9K trucks.  The chassis harness may have been improperly sealed.  Water intrusion can shut down the EV system, causing a loss of drive power.
25V037000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
25V037000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will repair the chassis wire harness and replace the fuse terminals as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 28, 2025.  Owners may contact MFTA customer service at 1-877-711-0707.  MFTA's number for this recall is C10129.
25V037000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V040000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2023 Toyota Corolla, Corolla Cross, Corolla Cross Hybrid, Highlander, Highlander Hybrid, Tacoma, Lexus RX350, 2023-2024 NX250, and NX350 vehicles that may have been incorrectly repaired under previous NHTSA recall number 23V-480.  An electrical connection inside the steering column's spiral cable assembly may be insufficiently welded, causing the connection to separate and deactivate the driver's air bag.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
25V040000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A deactivated driver's air bag will not deploy as intended, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
25V040000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the spiral cable assembly as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 17, 2025.  Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331.  Toyota's number for this recall is 25TA02.  Lexus' number for this recall is 25LA02.
25V040000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V066000.DESC_DEFECT: Zeekr Technology US, LLC (Zeekr) is recalling one 2025 RT vehicle.  The C-Pillar trim may catch the side curtain air bag, preventing the air bag from fully deploying.  As such, this vehicle fails to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 226, "Ejection Mitigation."
25V066000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that deploys improperly increases the risk of ejection and injury during a crash.
25V066000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Zeekr will modify the C-Pillar chutes, free of charge.  The vehicle was repaired on February 23, 2025.  Owners may contact Zeekr customer service at 1-212-481-2050.
25V066000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V073000.DESC_DEFECT: Nikola Corporation (Nikola) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Tre FCEV trucks.  The hydrogen tank mounting block bolts may be too long and damage the tank.
25V073000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A damaged tank can leak fuel, increasing the risk of a fire.
25V073000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Nikola will inspect and replace the bolts, and replace the hydrogen tank as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 14, 2025.  Owners may contact Nikola customer service at 1-630-808-4531.  Nikola's number for this recall is 24VDC1101.
25V073000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V080000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Audi Q5, and 2022 A7 E Hybrid Electric PHEV vehicles.  The high-voltage battery may overheat.
25V080000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A high-voltage battery that overheats increases the risk of a fire.
25V080000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install advanced diagnostic software , free of charge. Volkswagen will monitor available online vehicle data and contact owners as necessary, to advise them not to charge the vehicle until the battery can be replaced.  For vehicles in which online data is unavailable, owners are advised not to charge their batteries until the final remedy becomes available.  Repairs will be performed free of charge.  This will be a Phased recall. Phase 1 will include Interim letters 2022-2023 model year vehicles. Phase 2 will include Owner letters 2021-2024 model year vehicles, and Phase 3 will include Interim letters 2022-2023 model year vehicles.  Interim owner notification letters informing owners of the safety risk were mailed February 28, 2025, and May 7, 2025. A second notice will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owner notification letters were mailed May 1, 2025. Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Volkswagen's number for this recall is 93AA.  This recall expands and replaces previous NHTSA recall number 24V898.
25V080000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-888-275-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V058000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:FOUNDATION COMPONENTS:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
25V058000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Tacoma 4-wheel drive vehicles.  The rear brake hoses can be damaged if mud and dirt builds up inside the rear wheels.  This can result in a brake fluid leak.
25V058000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A brake fluid leak can reduce braking ability and increase the risk of a crash.
25V058000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace both rear brake hoses, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed August 1, 2025. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 25TB04 and 25TA04.
25V058000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V095000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Maverick vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 24V-293.  The body control module (BCM) may inadvertently deactivate one or both rear tail lights.
25V095000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Rear tail lights that fail to illuminate can reduce the vehicle's visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V095000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the body control module software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 28, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S07.
25V095000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V090000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2024 Mercedes-Benz eSprinter vehicles.  The welds on the helical gear within the rear axle drivetrain may fail, causing a loss of drive power.
25V090000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.  In addition, drivetrain failure can result in a vehicle rollaway if the parking brake is not applied, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
25V090000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the rear axle electric drivetrain, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 5, 2025.  Owners may contact DVUSA customer service at 877-762-8267.  DVUSA's number for this recall is V3ESCHWEI.
25V090000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V086000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Sienna Hybrid vehicles.  The bolts for the seatbacks on the third-row seat assemblies may not be tightened properly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 202, "Head Restraints," 207, "Seating Systems," and 225, "Child Restraint Anchorage Systems."
25V086000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly tightened seatback may not adequately restrain the occupant during a crash, increasing their risk of injury.
25V086000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will tighten the seat assembly bolts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 1, 2025.  Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331.  Toyota's number for this recall is 25TA05.
25V086000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V134000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023 F-Super Duty F-250, F-350, and F-450 vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 23V-573.  The default rearview camera image may not be displayed when using the Pro Trailer Hitch Assist feature.
25V134000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrect rearview camera image can reduce the driver's view of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
25V134000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the Advanced Drive Assistance System (ADAS) module software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 4, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S17.
25V134000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V151000.DESC_DEFECT: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2025 Keystone Kodiak, Colorado 260RBC, 270BHC, 280BHC, and Sunset travel trailers.  The 7-way cord and 12-volt distribution box were wired incorrectly, resulting in wiring with insufficient surge protection.
25V151000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Unprotected electrical wiring can overheat and increase the risk of a fire.
25V151000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will repair the wiring, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 25, 2025.  Owners may contact Keystone customer service at 866-425-4369.  Keystone's number for this recall is 25-463.
25V151000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V159000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Explorer, Lincoln Aviator, and 2020-2022 Lincoln Corsair vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 23V-342.  The video output may fail, preventing the rearview camera image from displaying.
25V159000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Loss of the rearview camera image can reduce the driver's rear visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V159000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the Image Processing Module software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 25, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S27.
25V159000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V166000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Explorer vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall numbers 23V-199 or 22V-255.  The rear axle horizontal mounting bolt may fracture and cause the driveshaft to disconnect.
