As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 141, "Minimum Sound Requirements for Hybrid Electric Vehicles."
25V366000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A vehicle that makes an incorrect sound may fail to alert pedestrians of a reversing vehicle, increasing the risk of crash.
25V366000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the AVAS software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 1, 2025. Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372. MBUSA's number for this recall is 2025070005.

25V409000.DESC_DEFECT: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2021 and 2024 Polestar 2 vehicles. In certain driving scenarios while coasting down a hill and using "One Pedal Drive," the vehicle may lose brake function.
25V409000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of brake function increases the risk of a crash.
25V409000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to use "One Pedal Drive" until the repair has been completed. Polestar has released an over-the-air (OTA) software update, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 18, 2025. Owners may contact Polestar's customer service at 1-800-806-2504. Polestar's number for this recall is RP1061.

25V425000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Wildwood and Salem travel trailer recreational trailers. The exterior transit latch on the rear patio door cannot be unlocked from inside the vehicle.
25V425000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A door that remains locked can prevent or delay occupants from evacuating during an emergency, increasing the risk of injury.
25V425000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will remove the exterior transit latch, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 22, 2025. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-534-3167. Forest River's number for this recall is 69-1945.

25V329000.DESC_DEFECT: Custom Truck and Body Works (Custom Truck) is recalling certain 2020 Ford F-550 vehicles equipped with Weldon 8X16 Input-Output nodes. In the event of a short circuit or wiring failure, the firmware in the node may fail to shut off the output pin, resulting in overloaded electrical circuits.
25V329000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overloaded electrical circuits can overheat, increasing the risk of fire.
25V329000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Custom Truck will work with Weldon to update the firmware, free of charge. All vehicles were repaired.  Owners may contact Custom Truck customer service at 1-888-712-2963 or Weldon Division of Akron Brass customer service at 1-800-228-1161.

25V007000.DESC_DEFECT: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2025 Minnie Winnie and Spirit motorhomes.  The spare tire carrier mounting bolts may loosen, allowing the carrier to detach.
25V007000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached spare tire carrier can become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V007000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect, replace, and correctly torque the bolts as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 3, 2025.  Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-800-537-1885.  Winnebago's number for this recall is 194.
25V007000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V025000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Bronco vehicles.  The rear shock absorbers may corrode and fail, resulting in detachment of the external reservoir.
25V025000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An external reservoir that detaches from a vehicle can create a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V025000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the rear shock absorbers, as necessary free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S01.
25V025000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V371000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Explorer vehicles. The bolts securing the front brake caliper may not be tightened properly, which can result in a loss of front brake function and possible wheel damage.
25V371000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Loss of brake function and wheel damage can increase the risk of a crash.
25V371000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and tighten the bolts as necessary.  If bolts are missing, the brake caliper and pads will be replaced. Repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 19, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S60.

25V399000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Ranger trucks. The instrument panel was not properly configured, preventing many of the the warning lights or gauges from properly displaying. This includes forward collision warnings, auto emergency braking, traction control, roll stability, and other gauges. The fuel gauge, distance to empty, and fuel economy may also not show accurately. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 101, "Control and Displays" and 126, "Electronic Stability Control Systems."
25V399000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument panel that does not clearly display critical safety information increases the risk of a crash.
25V399000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the instrument panel software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 29, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Fords number for this recall is 25C23.

25V418000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:ENGINE CONTROL MODULE (ECU/ECM)
25V418000.DESC_DEFECT: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2025 CX-50 Hybrid vehicles. The transmission gear shifter can be moved from Neutral to Drive without pressing the brake pedal.
25V418000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Shifting into gear without the brake pedal depressed can result in unexpected vehicle movement, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V418000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the Engine Control Module (ECM) and reprogram the Hybrid Control Unit (HCU) and Power Control Unit (PCU), free of charge. Interim owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2025. A second notice will be sent once the remedy becomes available, anticipated late summer 2025. Owners may contact Mazda customer service at 1-800-222-5500 Option 6. The manufacturer's number for this recall is 7725F.

25V384000.DESC_DEFECT: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2025 Carbon, Fuzion, and Raptor toy hauler recreational trailers. The rear gate pins and/or leg support bracket may be missing, allowing the gate to shift during operation.
25V384000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rear gate that shifts or patio stairs that becomes unstable increase the risk of injury.
25V384000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install the gate pins and/or leg support brackets, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 4, 2025. Owners may contact Keystone customer service at 1-866-425-4369. Keystone's number for this recall is 25-470.

25V821000.DESC_DEFECT: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2025 Murano, 2025-2026 Armada, and Infiniti QX80 vehicles. A software error may occur in the In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) system at vehicle startup, resulting in the rearview camera image not displaying when the vehicle is shifted into reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V821000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview image that does not display reduces the driver's view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V821000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The IVI system software will be updated by a dealer, or through an over-the-air (OTA) update, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed February 2, 2026. Owners may contact Nissan's customer service at 800-647-7261 or Infiniti's customer service at 1-800-662-6200. Nissan's numbers for this recall are R25D6, R25D5, and R25D7. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning December 12, 2025.

25V019000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Bronco Sport and 2022-2023 Maverick vehicles.  The 12-volt battery may experience degradation and suddenly fail.
25V019000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Battery failure can result in a loss of electrical accessories, including the hazard lights, or cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V019000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and if necessary, replace the 12-volt battery, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 2, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S02.  Vehicles in this recall were previously repaired under 24V-267 and will need to have the new remedy completed.
25V019000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V451000.DESC_DEFECT: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2012-2025 ACTT (Xspotter) vehicles. The tire inflation information label is incorrect.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
25V451000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect tire inflation information can result in under inflated tires, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V451000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Autocar will mail corrected labels, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 29, 2025. Owners may contact Autocar customer service at 1-888-218-3611. Autocar's number for this recall is ACTT-2504.

25V017000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
25V017000.MFGNAME: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
25V017000.DESC_DEFECT: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Jaguar) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Jaguar XE vehicles.  Due to wiring damage in the trunk, the rearview camera image may not appear on the display.
25V017000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera that does not display an image can reduce the driver's rear view, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V017000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair, or replace the rearview camera wiring harness, as necessary, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed February 2, 2026. Owners may contact Jaguar's customer service at 1-800-452-4827.  Jaguar's number for this recall is H535.  This recall replaces and expands previous recall number 23V-501.  Vehicles already repaired under recall 23V-501 will need to have the new remedy completed.
25V017000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V031000.DESC_DEFECT: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Acura MDX Type-S, 2023-2025 Honda Pilot, and 2021-2025 Acura TLX Type-S vehicles.  A software error in the fuel injection electronic control unit (FI-ECU) may cause an engine stall or a loss of power.
25V031000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine stall or loss of power can increase the risk of a crash or injury.
25V031000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reprogram the FI-ECU software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 17, 2025.  Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-888-234-2138.  Honda's numbers for this recall are EL1 and AL0.
25V031000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V038000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
25V038000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Trucks North America LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Freightliner Custom Chassis XCM, 2022-2025 Custom Chassis XCR, 2024 Custom Chassis XBS, and 2024-2025 Custom Chassis XCS chassis, equipped with certain Cummins L9 diesel engines.  The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
25V038000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.  An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
25V038000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Cummins will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 11, 2025.  Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712 or Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467.  DTNA's number for this recall is F1016.
25V038000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V060000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2022 GMC Sierra 1500 vehicles equipped with chrome front grille deflectors.  The attachments that hold the front grille deflectors in place may fracture, resulting in grille detachment.
25V060000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached front grille deflector may become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V060000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reinforce or repair all attachment points on the chrome front grille deflector, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 17, 2025.  Owners may call GM customer service for GMC at 1-800-462-8782.  GM's number for this recall is N242490120.
25V060000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V069000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Rockport work trucks.  The incorrect fasteners may have been used to install the optional E-Track Cargo Tie Down system.
25V069000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The fasteners can fail, causing the system to detach from the wall and increasing the risk of injury.
25V069000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install the correct fasteners, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 17, 2025.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-522-7599.  Forest River's number for this recall is 65-1894.
25V069000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V074000.DESC_DEFECT: KTM North America, Inc. (KTM) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Husqvarna FE 350s, FE 501s, and 2024-2025 GASGAS ES 350 and ES 500 motorcycles.  The front brake caliper may crack in the area around the upper guide pin.
25V074000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken front brake caliper can cause a loss of front brake function, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V074000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the front brake caliper, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 11, 2025.  Owners may contact KTM customer service at 1-888-985-6090.
25V074000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V067000.COMPNAME: AIR BAGS: AIR BAG/RESTRAINT CONTROL MODULE:SOFTWARE
25V067000.DESC_DEFECT: Zeekr Technology US, LLC (Zeekr) is recalling one 2025 RT vehicle.  The Occupant Weight Sensor (OWS) may misclassify the front passenger seat occupant or disable the air bag.  As such, this vehicle fails to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
25V067000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that deploys improperly or fails to deploy increases the risk of injury during a crash.
25V067000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Zeekr will update the OWS software, free of charge.  The vehicle was repaired February 23, 2025.  Owners may contact Zeekr customer service at 1-212-481-2050.
25V067000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V071000.DESC_DEFECT: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo) is recalling certain 2025 EX90 vehicles.  Due to a software error in the low power controller (LPC), the headlight shutters may close over the high and low beams while driving.
25V071000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of headlight function while driving can reduce visibility and increase the risk of a crash.
25V071000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The LPC software will be updated manually, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 12, 2025.  Owners may contact Volvo's customer service at 1-800-458-1552.  Volvo's number for this recall is R10298.
25V071000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V059000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2025 Toyota Camry Hybrid, Lexus NX250, NX350, NX350 Hybrid, 2024-2025 Lexus RX350, RX350 Hybrid, and RX500 Hybrid vehicles.  The second-row center seat belt webbing may be damaged.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies."
25V059000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A damaged seat belt may not adequately restrain an occupant, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
25V059000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the seat belt webbing and replace the seat belt assembly if necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 20, 2025.  Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331.  Toyota's numbers for this recall are 25TA03 and 25LA03.
25V059000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V087000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025 Chevrolet Express and GMC Savana vans.  The impact beam located in the driver's side door may have improper welds.
25V087000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly welded door impact beam may not adequately protect occupants in a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
25V087000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the driver's side door, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 3, 2025.  Owners may contact Chevrolet customer service at 800-222-1020 or GMC customer service at 800-462-8782.  GM's recall number for this recall is N242490780.
25V087000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V108000.DESC_DEFECT: Indian Motorcycle Company (Indian) is recalling certain 2025 Challenger Dark Horse, Pursuit Limited, Roadmaster Elite and Springfield Dark Horse motorcycles.  Due to an incorrectly crimped wire, the fuel pump may fail and result in an engine stall during operation.
25V108000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine stall increases the risk of a crash or injury.
25V108000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the fuel pump, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 5, 2025.  Owners may contact Indian customer service at 877-204-3697.  Indian's number for this recall is I-25-01.
25V108000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V116000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2021-2022 S 500, Maybach S 580 4MATIC, 2021-2023 S 580 4MATIC, 2022 S 680 4MATIC, and 2023 S 580e 4MATIC vehicles.  The front brake hoses may rupture and leak brake fluid.
25V116000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A brake fluid leak can extend the distance needed to stop the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V116000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the front brake hoses, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 25, 2025.  Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.  MBUSA's number for this recall is 2025030007.
25V116000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V344000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:HARD PARTS INTERNAL/MECHANICAL
25V344000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Transit, F-150, and Explorer vehicles. The connecting rod and rod bearing components may have manufacturing defects that can lead to engine damage and engine failure.
25V344000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A damaged engine can result in engine failure and a stall, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V344000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the connecting rods and replace the engine long block assembly as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S55.

25V130000.COMPNAME: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:PROPULSION SYSTEM:TRACTION BATTERY:MANAGEMENT SYSTEM/ENERGY CONTROL MODULE (BMS/BECM):SOFTWARE
25V130000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Mustang Mach-E vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 22V-412.  The high voltage battery main contactors may overheat.
25V130000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated high voltage battery contactor may cause the vehicle to lose drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V130000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the on-board software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 11, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S14.
25V130000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V145000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2024 Entegra Condor, Jayco Granite Ridge, 2025 Jayco Alante SE, Redhawk SE, and Entegra Odyssey SE motorhomes.  The Occupant and Cargo Carrying Capacity (OCCC) on the Federal label may be incorrect and allow the vehicle to be overloaded.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 120, "Wheels and Rims - other than passenger cars."
25V145000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overloaded vehicle increases the risk of a crash.
25V145000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Jayco will mail new labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 31, 2025.  Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267.  Jayco's number for this recall is 9903622.
25V145000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171), or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V149000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Aurora ART26BHS travel trailers.  The electrical connector for the air conditioner may have strands of wiring exposed, which can cause electrical arcing.
25V149000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Electrical arcing increases the risk of a fire.
25V149000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the electrical connector, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 24, 2025.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-541-995-3447.  Forest River's number for this recall is 64-1902.
25V149000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171), or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V164000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 F-150, Bronco, 2024 Ranger, 2025 Mustang, Explorer, and Aviator vehicles.  The transmission valve body may have been machined incorrectly, which can cause reverse gear failure, or unexpected forward movement in reverse or neutral gear.
25V164000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Unexpected vehicle movement increases the risk of a crash.
25V164000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the transmission main control valve body, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 11, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S19.
25V164000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V178000.DESC_DEFECT: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2024 HV, 2020-2025 MV, and 2019 Workstar 7400 trucks.  The caliper may contact a suspension spring or axle U-bolt and prevent the outer brake pad from functioning.
25V178000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of outer brake pad function can extend the vehicle's stopping distance, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V178000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will switch the left and right rear air disc brake calipers, replace the rear brake torque plates, and replace the brake pads, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 12, 2025.  Owners may contact International customer service at 1-800-448-7825.  International's number for this recall is 25501.
25V178000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V187000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2026 Freightliner eM2, Freightliner 108SD, Freightliner 114SD, Freightliner Cascadia, 2025-2026 Freightliner Business Class M2, Western Star 47X, and Western Star 49X vehicles.  A software error in the advanced signal and actuator module for the automatic emergency braking system may cause the brake lights to fail to illuminate.
25V187000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Brake lights that fail increase the risk of a crash.
25V187000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the automatic emergency braking system software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 15, 2025.  Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712.  DTNA's number for this recall is F1018.
25V187000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V195000.DESC_DEFECT: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2024-2025 ADV160 scooters.  The oil pump driven gear may fail, resulting in a loss of drive power.
25V195000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash or injury.
25V195000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the oil pump driven gear, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed August 6, 2025. Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 866-784-1870.  Honda's number for this recall is KR9.
25V195000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V198000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 F-150, Expedition, and 2024 Lincoln Navigator vehicles equipped with 3.5L GTDI engines.  The engine may have a misaligned engine cup plug, which can result in a rapid oil leak.
25V198000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rapid oil leak can result in an engine stall, increasing the risk of a crash.  In addition, an oil leak in the presence of an ignition source such as hot engine or exhaust components, can increase the risk of a fire.
25V198000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the engine cup plug alignment, and replace the plug if necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 22, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S30.
25V198000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V191000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2025 Chrysler Pacifica Plug-In Hybrid Electric (PHEV) vehicles.  The bolts securing the front brake caliper bracket may not be tightened properly, which can result in reduced steering control, a brake fluid leak, and a loss of front brake function.
25V191000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Reduced steering control, a brake fluid leak, and loss of front brake function increase the risk of a crash.
25V191000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the front brake caliper brackets and bolts, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 10, 2025.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is 27C.
25V191000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V209000.DESC_DEFECT: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2023-2024 DC (Legend) vehicles.  The air tanks have an insufficient volume of air for the brake system.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 121, "Air Brake Systems."
25V209000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Insufficient air volume can reduce brake function, extending the distance required to stop and increasing the risk of a crash.
25V209000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace or add additional air tanks as necessary, free of charge.  All vehicles were repaired by May 23, 2025.  Owners may contact Autocar customer service at 1-888-218-3611.  Autocar's number for this recall is DC-2504.
25V209000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V230000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain Coachmen Catalina BCAT154RBX travel trailers.  The wastewater holding tank pipe may not extend to the exterior of the vehicle, allowing sewer gas to enter the cabin.
25V230000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Sewer gas inside the cabin increases the risk of injury.
25V230000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will extend the ventilation pipe, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 25, 2025.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-825-4995.  Forest River's number for this recall is 203-1917.
25V230000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171), or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V225000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
25V225000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2025 SQ6 e-tron and Q6 e-tron vehicles. The rearview camera may show a blurry image.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V225000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A blurry rearview image can reduce the driver's view of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V225000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the rearview camera.  In addition, dealers will inspect and replace surround view cameras as necessary.  All repairs will be performed free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 2, 2025.  Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834.  Audi's number for this recall is 90XM.
25V225000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V289000.DESC_DEFECT: Blue Bird Body Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2026 Vision and All American school buses equipped with a lap belt-ready or 3-pt seats.   The seat mounting fasteners may have been improperly tightened.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 207, "Seating Systems," 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages," and 222, "School Bus Passenger Seating and Crash Protection."
25V289000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat with loose fasteners may not properly restrain an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
25V289000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Blue Bird will replace the seat fasteners, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed July 2, 2025.  Owners may contact Blue Bird customer service at 1-478-822-2242.  Blue Bird's number for this recall is R25DM.
25V289000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V235000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 Hyundai IONIQ 5 "N" vehicles equipped with left-foot braking (LFB) and N e-shift features.  The integrated electronic brake (IEB) and vehicle control unit (VCU) software may cause reduced braking performance when LFB is activated.  Additionally, the vehicle may continue to accelerate after the pedal is released and the vehicle's N e-shift feature is engaged.
25V235000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Reduced braking performance and unexpected, continued acceleration increase the risk of a crash.
25V235000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to use the LFB or N e-Shift features until the remedy has been performed.  The IEB and VCU software will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a dealer, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed April 25, 2025.  This recall replaces NHTSA recall number 25V-065.  Vehicles repaired under the previous recall will need to have the new remedy completed.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 277.
25V235000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171) or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V238000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 E-Transit Chassis Cab vehicles.  The tray side rails for the high voltage battery pack may buckle and crack, allowing water to enter the battery.
25V238000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Water inside a high voltage battery can cause an electrical short circuit, increasing the risk of a fire.
25V238000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures until the recall repair is complete.  Dealers will inspect and replace, or repair the battery assembly as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 15, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S36.
25V238000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V291000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 Hyundai Palisade vehicles.  An insufficient seal on the controller for the electric oil pump may allow moisture to accumulate in the printed circuit board, which can cause an electrical short and result in a fire.
25V291000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fire while parked or driving can increase the risk of injury.
25V291000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park their vehicles outside and away from structures until the recall remedy is completed.  Dealers will replace the electric oil pump controller, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 11, 2025.  Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460.  Hyundai's number for this recall is 278.
25V291000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171) or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V298000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2019-2024 Ram 1500 vehicles.  The driver's side air bag may not be connected properly, which can cause the air bag not to deploy as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
25V298000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A driver's side air bag that does not deploy as intended increases the risk of injury in a crash.
25V298000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers secured the connectors for the air bag, free of charge.  All vehicles have been remedied.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 27, 2025.  Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403.  Chrysler's number for this recall is 08C.
25V298000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V311000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Ranger and Bronco vehicles.  The bolts that secure the driver's seat frame to the body may be loose or missing.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 207, "Seating Systems."
25V311000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat with loose or missing fasteners may not properly restrain an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
25V311000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the seat fasteners and tighten or install new fasteners as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 23, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25C16.
25V311000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V312000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
25V312000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Bronco vehicles equipped with 8-inch SYNC infotainment screens that were repaired incorrectly under recall 22V-825.  The rearview camera image may still be displayed after a backing event has ended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V312000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview image that continues to be displayed after the vehicle is shifted out of reverse may distract the driver, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V312000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update SYNC module software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 18, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25C14.
25V312000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V341000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 F-150 Lightning BEV vehicles. The front upper control arm ball joint nut may not have been tightened properly, allowing the front upper control arm to detach from the knuckle assembly.
25V341000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached control arm can cause a loss of vehicle steering and control, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V341000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the upper control arm ball joint nut, and replace the nut and/or knuckle assembly, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 6, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24S76. This recall expands previous NHTSA recall number 24V949.

25V362000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River Bus, LLC (Forest River Bus) is recalling certain 2025 Collins Bus transit buses. The lock on the emergency exit door may fail to unlock. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."
25V362000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An emergency exit that remains locked can prevent or delay passengers from evacuating during an emergency, increasing the risk of injury.
25V362000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the barrel latch, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 25, 2025. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-620-888-3361. Forest River Bus's number for this recall is 551-1934.

25V340000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022 F-150 Lightning BEV vehicles equipped with 20" or 22" all season tires that were repaired incorrectly under recall 22V-453. The tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) light may not illuminate as intended, failing to warn the driver of low tire pressure. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring Systems."
25V340000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Low tire pressure can lead to poor vehicle handling and a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V340000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the body control module (BCM) software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 27, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25C20.

25V352000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2026 Granite trucks. The incorrect drive axle brake drums were installed, resulting in an incorrect load rating on the door jamb label.
25V352000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect weight rating information on the door can result in overloading the axles, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V352000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the brake drums, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 16, 2025. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0472.

25V002000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Model 3, Model S, 2023-2025 Model X, and Model Y vehicles.  The computer circuit board may short, resulting in the loss of the rearview camera image.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V002000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera that does not display an image reduces the driver's rear view, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V002000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla released an over-the-air (OTA) software update, free of charge. Tesla will also identify any vehicles that experienced a circuit board failure, or stress that may lead to a circuit board failure, and replace the affected computers, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 7, 2025.  Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752.  Tesla's number for this recall is SB-25-00-001.
25V002000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V375000.DESC_DEFECT: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley-Davidson) is recalling certain 2018-2024 Softail motorcycles. The mounting tab on the rear shock pre-load adjuster may break, allowing the rear shock absorber adjuster to damage the rear tire, causing a loss of tire pressure.
25V375000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden loss of tire pressure increases the risk of a crash.
25V375000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a new bracket, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed June 16, 2025. Owners may contact Harley-Davidson customer service at 1-800-258-2464. Harley-Davidson's number for this recall is 0188. Some of the vehicles included in this recall were previously repaired under recall 23V591, and will need to have the new remedy completed.

25V015000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2024 Chevrolet Silverado EV and 2024-2025 GMC Sierra EV pickup trucks.  The bolt that secures the rear center seat belt assembly to the seat structure may not have been properly tightened.
25V015000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly secured seat belt assembly may not restrain an occupant as intended, increasing the risk of injury in a crash.
25V015000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: GM will tighten the bolt that attaches the center seat belt assembly to the rear seat structure, free of charge.  All affected vehicles are still in dealer inventory and, therefore, no owner letters will be mailed.  Owners may contact GM customer service at 1-888-988-7267, or Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020.  GM's number for this recall is N242489901.
25V015000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V388000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023 Chrysler Pacifica and Voyager vehicles. Due to a manufacturing error, the rearview camera image may not display. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V388000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview image that does not display reduces the driver's view of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V388000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the rearview camera, as necessary free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 3, 2025. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 34C.

25V398000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 F-150 trucks. Contact with the engine coolant hose may chafe the engine wire harness or cause a pull out of the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) connector pins, causing the engine to stall.
25V398000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
25V398000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect, replace the engine wire harness as necessary, and relocate the engine coolant hose, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 12, 2025. The parts are anticipated to be available the third quarter of 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S63.

25V406000.DESC_DEFECT: Foretravel, Inc. (Foretravel) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Presidential Realm vehicles. Engine vibration may cause the rear kick up panel fins to detach.
25V406000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fin that detaches while driving creates a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V406000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reinforce the fins, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 24, 2025. Owners may contact Foretravel customer service at 1-800-955-6226.

25V422000.DESC_DEFECT: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2013 Honda Accord vehicles equipped with a 4-cylinder engine and a continuously-variable transmission. The affected vehicles were originally sold, or ever registered, in Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, and Wisconsin. The driveshaft may corrode and break, due to damage from road salt or other contaminants.
25V422000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A broken driveshaft can result in a loss of drive power, or a vehicle rollaway when the vehicle is in park without the parking brake applied. Both scenarios can increase the risk of a crash or injury.
25V422000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the driveshaft assemblies as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 11, 2025. Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-888-234-2138. Honda's number for this recall is OM2. This recall expands previous recall number 20V769.

25V432000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors (GM) is recalling certain 2018 GMC Sierra 1500, 2019 Sierra 2500, 3500, Chevrolet Silverado 3500, and Chevrolet Silverado 2500 and 2018 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Crew Cab vehicles. The left or right-side roof-rail air bag (RRAB) inflator end cap may detach from the inflator or the inflator sidewall may rupture.
25V432000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached end cap or inflator rupture can allow compressed gas to escape and project the end cap or fragments of the inflator into the vehicle, increases the risk of injury or crash.
25V432000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the left and right side RRAB modules, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 23, 2025. Owners may contact GMC customer service at 1-888-988-7267 or Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020. GM's number for this recall is N252513060.

25V439000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Navigator and Expedition vehicles. The passenger side air bag may have been manufactured incorrectly, which can cause the air bag to deploy with excessive force during a crash.
25V439000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that deploys with excessive force can increase the risk of injury during a crash.
25V439000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the  passenger side air bags, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 8, 2025. Owners may contact Ford Customer Service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S51.

25V463000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Mercedes-Benz Metris vehicles. The electrical connections for the infotainment system may not be properly secured, which can cause the rearview camera image not to display. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V463000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview image that does not display reduces the driver's view of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V463000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the infotainment system connection, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed November 11, 2025. Owners may contact DVUSA customer service at 1-877-762-8267.  DVUSA's number for this recall is VS2GARPIN.

25V471000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Chrysler Pacifica vehicles. The vehicles were built with an incorrect radio, which can cause the rearview camera image not to display. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V471000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview image that does not display reduces the driver's view of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V471000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers replaced the radio, free of charge.  All affected vehicles have been repaired.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 7, 2025.  Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403.  Chrysler's number for this recall is 57C.

25V489000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 F-150 hybrid vehicles equipped with a 3.5L hybrid electric powertrain. When the driver or passenger's seat belt is not buckled and the vehicle is started, the audible warning chime may not activate as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
25V489000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An audible warning chime that fails to alert occupants of an unbelted seat belt can increase the risk of injury during a crash.
25V489000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the audio control module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 15, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25C31.

25V497000.DESC_DEFECT: Brinkley RV (Brinkley) is recalling certain 2025 Model Z trailers. The electrical wiring may not be secured properly, which can result in damaged wiring and a short circuit.
25V497000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A short circuit increases the risk of a fire.
25V497000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will secure the electrical wires, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 14, 2025. Owners may contact Brinkley customer service at 1-574-501-4280.  Brinkley's number for this recall is REC-2503.

25V495000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2026 Mack GR trucks. The brake drum and steer axle combination are incompatible, which may cause a loss of brake function. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 121, "Air Brake Systems."
25V495000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Reduced brake function can extend the distance required to stop, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V495000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the steer axle brake drums, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 27, 2025. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0482.

25V510000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
25V510000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Lincoln Corsair vehicles. Water may enter into the rearview camera connectors, which can cause the rearview camera image not to appear on the display or display a distorted image.
25V510000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera that displays a blank or distorted image can reduce the drivers view of what is behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V510000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the rearview camera harness and rearview camera, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed May 1, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S83.

25V509000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, AIR:SUPPLY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
25V509000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2025 AP Series vehicles. The brake air line compression fitting may not be tightened correctly, which can allow the supply line or other air lines to detach and cause the chassis emergency brakes to engage.
25V509000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Unexpected activation of the emergency brakes may cause the vehicle to stop suddenly, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V509000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Altec will provide owners with instructions to inspect the brake air lines.  If the lines are improperly secured, Altec will provide instructions and a kit to secure the lines. Repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 3, 2025.  Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3242.

25V523000.DESC_DEFECT: The Heil Co. (Heil) is recalling certain 2024 front end loader garbage trucks. The fuel shutoff solenoid may fail, resulting in an engine stall while driving.
25V523000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
25V523000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Heil will remove the CNG automatic shutoff solenoid, free of charge. All repairs will be performed free of charge. All affected trucks were repaired by August 12, 2024. Owners may contact Heil's customer service at 1-866-275-4345.

25V528000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Jay Flight SLX travel trailers. The furnace exhaust vent may be missing from the exterior wall, allowing carbon monoxide to enter the vehicle.
25V528000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Unvented carbon monoxide increases the risk of injury or death from carbon monoxide poisoning.
25V528000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and install a furnace exhaust vent as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 18, 2025. Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267. Jayco's number for this recall is 9901636.

25V540000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025-2026 F-550 SD, F-450 SD, F-350 SD, F-250 SD, and 2025 F-150 vehicles. The Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) may fail at startup.
25V540000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument panel display that does not show critical information, such as warning lights or vehicle speed, increases the risk of a crash.
25V540000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The instrument panel cluster software will be updated by a dealer or through an over-the-air (OTA) update, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 5, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S88.

25V380000.DESC_DEFECT: GEM WAEV LLC (GEM) is recalling certain 2022-2025 e2, e4, e6, and eLXD vehicles. The retaining fasteners between the ball joint and the hub strut may have been improperly tightened, which can result in ball joint separation from the wheel.
25V380000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Ball joint separation can cause a loss of steering control, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V380000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and tighten the retaining fasteners or replace the ball joints as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 7, 2025. Owners may contact GEM customer service at 1-800-688-8680. This recall replaces NHTSA recall 24V971.

25V364000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Salem and Wildwood travel trailers. The side entry gate latch may become unlocked, allowing the strut to open the gate during transit.
25V364000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An open gate can striking other road users and increases the risk of injury.
25V364000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a warning label and tethered pin and remove the strut, free of chare. Owner notification letters were mailed July 2, 2025. Owner may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-534-3167. Forest River's number for this recall is 51-1935.

25V385000.DESC_DEFECT: Vanguard National Trailer Corporation (Vanguard) is recalling all 2021-2023 VXP 28-Foot Pup trailers. The pintle hook box assembly may crack or break, reducing the trailer's stability while being towed.
25V385000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Trailer instability can cause a loss of control, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V385000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Vanguard will inspect and repair the pintle hook box assembly as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 23, 2025. Owners may contact Vanguard customer service at 1-888-253-3008.

25V013000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:HYDRAULIC:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
25V013000.DESC_DEFECT: Ducati North America (Ducati) is recalling certain 2025 Ducati Panigale S/STD V4 motorcycles.  Excessive heat may damage the rear brake hose between the ABS control unit and brake caliper, resulting in a sudden loss of the rear brakes.
25V013000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden loss of the rear brakes increases the risk of a crash or injury.
25V013000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reinstall the thermal shield, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 17, 2025.  Owners may contact Ducati customer service at 1-888-391-5446.  Ducati's number for this recall is CR285.
25V013000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V005000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Shasta Oasis and Spirit travel trailers equipped with InVision Three Burner Cooktops.  The aluminum burner tube may crack and cause a gas leak.
25V005000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A gas leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
25V005000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to use the cooktop until the remedy is completed. Dealers will replace the internal gas line, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 29, 2025.  Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-821-1311.  Forest River's number for this recall is 53-1883.
25V005000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

25V395000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2022-2025 i4, 2022-2024 IX, 2023-2024 I7, and 2024 I5 vehicles. The electric drive motor software may shut down the high-voltage system, causing a loss of drive power.
25V395000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
25V395000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The electric drive motor software will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed August 5, 2025. Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417.

25V397000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Bronco four-door vehicles. The left-hand rear door may be able to be opened from inside the vehicle when the child safety lock is in the "ON" position.
25V397000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A malfunctioning child safety lock that allows a rear door to be opened unintentionally can increase the risk of injury.
25V397000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the rear door latch, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 27, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25S64.

25V400000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2020 TA Series, 2019 L Series Aerial Device, 2018-2025 Service Body, LS Series, and AT Series trucks. The Power Distribution Module (PDM 10) circuit may experience a voltage spike, which can damage the Transfer Case Control Module (TCCM) and disrupt chassis functions, including the PTO switch, rearview mirror, or rearview camera.
25V400000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A damaged TCCM and disrupted chassis functions can result in a loss of handling and control or brake performance, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V400000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Altec will install a diode to the ignition hot circuit, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 8, 2025. Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3229.

25V401000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025  F-550 SD, F-450 SD, F-350 SD, and F-250 SD vehicles. The brake booster pushrod retaining spring may not have been installed, which can allow the pushrod to disconnect from the brake pedal and cause a sudden loss of brake function. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 135, "Light Vehicle Brake Systems" and 105, "Hydraulic and electric brake systems."
25V401000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden loss of brake function increases the risk of a crash.
25V401000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until they have been repaired. Dealers will inspect and repair the brake pedal assembly as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 20, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford Customer Service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25C26.

25V410000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2026 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles. The fasteners attaching the seat back to the seat bottom may have been improperly tightened.
25V410000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The seat may not properly restrain the occupant, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
25V410000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla Service Centers will inspect and tighten or replace the seat assembly fasteners as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 16, 2025. Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752. Tesla's number for this recall is SB-25-13-003.

25V192000.DESC_DEFECT: Oshkosh Corporation (Oshkosh) is recalling certain 2024-2025 ICE 2WD, ICE AWD, and BEV 2WD Next Generation delivery vehicles.  The wiper arm nuts may be loose, causing the wipers to fail.
25V192000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Windshield wiper failure can reduce driver visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V192000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Oshkosh will inspect and tighten the wiper arms as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on April 3, 2025.  Owners may contact Oshkosh customer service at 1-888-686-7278.  Oshkosh's number for this recall is NGDV_TSB_034.
25V192000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171), or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V224000.DESC_DEFECT: Oshkosh Corporation (Oshkosh) is recalling certain 2025 Defense NGDV ICE 2WD, AWD, and BEV 2WD vehicles.  The rearview camera image may not display when the vehicle is placed in reverse.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
25V224000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A blank rearview camera display can reduce the driver's rear visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V224000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Oshkosh will inspect and replace the head units as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 22, 2025.  Owners may contact Oshkosh customer service at 1-800-830-3554.  Oshkosh's number for this recall is NGDV_TSB_036.  Vehicles that were previously recalled under 24V-928 will need to be inspected and possibly have the head unit replaced again.
25V224000.NOTES: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1- 888-275-9171) or go to www.safercar.gov.

25V413000.COMPNAME: AIR BAGS: AIR BAG/RESTRAINT CONTROL MODULE:SOFTWARE
25V413000.DESC_DEFECT: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain CX-50 Hybrid and CX-50 vehicles. Incorrectly configured module software may cause the air bag to deploy improperly.
25V413000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag that deploys improperly increases the risk of injury during a crash.
25V413000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the module software, free of charge. Owner notifications will not be mailed due to all vehicles being under Mazda dealer control. Owners may contact Mazda customer service at 1-800-222-5500 Option 6. The manufacturer's number for this recall is 7625F.

25V405000.COMPNAME: FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
25V405000.DESC_DEFECT: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Utilimaster Aeromaster vehicles. The monitor in the 360-degree camera system may not display the correct image at start up.
25V405000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A monitor failing to display the correct image reduces the driver's view, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V405000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Shyft will install an in-line circuit protector and monitor, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 8, 2025. Owners may contact Shyft customer service at 1-800-237-7806. Shyft's number for this recall is 25-15.

25V423000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Spirit travel trailers. The installed safety chains may not meet the actual Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) listed on the Federal Placard. This can cause the chains to fail, allowing the trailer to separate from the tow vehicle.
25V423000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Separation of the trailer and tow vehicle increases the risk of a crash.
25V423000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the safety chains, free of charge. All vehicles are still in dealer inventory and therefore no owner notification letters will be mailed. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-825-8519. Forest River's number for this recall is 220-1941.

25V412000.DESC_DEFECT: Bontrager Outdoors (Bontrager) is recalling certain 2025 Skinny Guy Campers Armor 7LT and Bontrager Outdoors 7ROD trailers. The carbon monoxide detectors may not have been installed.
25V412000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Occupants will not be alerted to elevated levels of carbon monoxide, increasing the risk of injury.
25V412000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install carbon monoxide detectors, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 8, 2025. Owners may contact Bontrager's customer service at 1-260-768-7932.

25V421000.DESC_DEFECT: Supreme Corporation (Supreme) is recalling certain 2025 Wabash truck body vehicles equipped with Waltco ZS series slide liftgates. The cylinder pin in the slide liftgate may be insufficiently lubricated, which can cause the pin to seize, resulting in lift gate failure.
25V421000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A lift gate that fails during operation increases the risk of injury.
25V421000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Supreme will work with HIAB USA to replace the pivot pin, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 8, 2025. Owners may contact Supreme customer service at 1-844-352-4921. Owners may also contact Hiab customer service at 1-330-630-7755.

25V453000.DESC_DEFECT: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2025 Polestar 3 vehicles. Water may damage the electrical connectors between the engine bay and front bumper cable harnesses.
25V453000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Damage to harnesses can cause various electrical malfunctions, such as a loss of power steering assist, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
25V453000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Polestar will replace the bumper harness and the inline front bumper/engine bay connector on the engine bay harness, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 31, 2025. Owners may contact Polestar's customer service at 1-800-806-2504. Polestar's number for this recall is RP1063.

25V470000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2022-2025 IX, 2023-2024 I7, and 2022-2023 i4 vehicles. The high-voltage battery cell modules may not have been assembled properly, resulting in stress on the module frame and possible module failure.
25V470000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Battery module failure may lead to a shutdown of the high-voltage system which can result in a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.  In addition, module failure increases the risk of a fire.
25V470000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace specific high-voltage battery cell modules, free of charge. Interim owner notification letters explaining the safety risk were mailed September 11, 2025. Another notice will be sent once the remedy becomes available, anticipated December 31, 2025Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417.

25V468000.DESC_DEFECT: American Manufacturing Operations, Inc. (AMO) 2025 AMO Utility trailers. The shackle nuts securing the axle to the chassis may loosen, allowing the axle to detach from the trailer.
25V468000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An axle separation can cause a loss of trailer control, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V468000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: AMO will remove the shackle nuts and install new shackle nuts, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 3, 2025. Owners may contact AMO customer service at 1-419-269-1560.

25V475000.DESC_DEFECT: Rosenbauer America (Rosenbauer) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Avenger, 2019-2024 Commander, and Warrior fire trucks equipped with an Innovative Controls instrument panel. A software error may cause the odometer to freeze and not display accurate mileage.
25V475000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An inaccurate odometer reading can unintentionally delay critical safety-related maintenance, potentially impairing the safe operation of the vehicle and increasing the risk of a crash.
25V475000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the instrument panel, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 10, 2025. Owners may contact Rosenbauer customer service at 1-651-462-1000.

25V474000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain Genesis 2023-2025 G90 and GV60 vehicles. Due to a software error, the instrument panel display may fail. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."
25V474000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument panel display that fails to show critical safety information, such as the speedometer or warning lights, increases the risk of a crash.
25V474000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The instrument panel display software will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 22, 2025. Owners may contact Genesis customer service at 844-340-9741. Hyundai's number for this recall is 027G.

25V479000.DESC_DEFECT: Ferrari North America, Inc. (Ferrari) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Purosangue vehicles. The fuse boxâs power supply and the passenger-side footrest may contact each other, possibly resulting in a short circuit that activates the brake warning light and decreases the vehicle's braking ability.
25V479000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of braking ability increases the risk of a crash.
25V479000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Ferrari will install a plastic spacer between the fuse boxâs power supply and the passenger-side footrest, free of charge. Owner notification letters are scheduled to be mailed by September 21, 2025. Owners may contact Ferrari customer service at 1-201-816-2668. The manufacturer's number for this recall is RC 92.

25V480000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 F 900 GS, F 800 GS, R 1300 GS Adventure, R 1300 GS, S 1000 RR, S 1000 R, and K 1600 GT vehicles equipped with the optional emergency call system. The emergency call system (eCall) may have been deactivated due to a software programming error.
25V480000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: In an emergency, first responders may not receive notification of the crash or emergency location, increasing the risk of injury to riders.
25V480000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The electronic control unit software will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters are scheduled to be mailed September 12, 2025.  Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417.

25V503000.DESC_DEFECT: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2016-2024 IC Bus CESB school buses. The brake pressure switch assembly may leak brake fluid into the brake pressure switch's electrical components and cause an electrical short-circuit.
25V503000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An electrical short in the brake pressure switch can overheat the circuit and increase the risk of a fire while driving or parked.
25V503000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures until the recall repair is complete. Dealers will install a silicone black jumper harness, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed December 15, 2025. Owners may contact International customer service at 1-800-448-7825. International's number for this recall is 25510. Vehicles previously repaired under 23V398 will need to have the new remedy completed.

25V536000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023â2026 Chevrolet Corvette vehicles equipped with a left-side radiator/fan combination. Excess fuel may spill into the vehicle fuel-filler pocket during refueling and leak onto an ignition source.
25V536000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source, such as hot engine or exhaust components, can increase the risk of a fire.
25V536000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a shield to divert spilled fuel, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed November 14, 2025. Owners may contact Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020. GM's number for this recall is N252514930.

25V527000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Jeep Wrangler vehicles. The remote start antenna cable may be pinched, which can cause the tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) warning light not to illuminate as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring Systems."
25V527000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A TPMS warning light that fails to notify the driver of a problem increases the risk of a crash.
25V527000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the remote start antenna cable as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 2, 2025. Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403. FCA US, LLC's number for this recall is 56C.

25V565000.DESC_DEFECT: REV Recreation Group (REV) is recalling certain 2023-2024 American Coach American Tradition, 2023-2026 American Eagle, and American Dream, and 2025-2026 Fleetwood Palisade recreational vehicles. The waste tank macerator fuse may overheat, causing the fuse housing to melt.
25V565000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A melted fuse housing increases the risk of injury or fire.
25V565000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the fuse and fuse block holder as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 27, 2025. Owners may contact REV customer service at 1-800-509-3417. REV's number for this recall is 250829REV.

25V560000.DESC_DEFECT: Fontaine Trailer Company (Fontaine Trailer) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Fontaine HCIFL12SAT and HCIFL82CTA forklift trailers. The auto lift axle cables may not be installed in the correct ports, which can disable the anti-lock brake system. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 121, "Air Brake Systems."
25V560000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Driving without a functioning anti-lock brake system may result in the trailer not braking as intended, increasing the risk of a crash.
25V560000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Fontaine Trailer will rewire the cable connections, free of charge. Owners may contact Fontaine Trailer customer service at 1-800-821-6535, option 5.

25V573000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2025 Pacifica and Voyager vehicles. The right and left side curtain air bags may have insufficient pressure retention from improperly sealed seams. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 226, "Ejection Mitigation."
25V573000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An air bag with insufficient pressure retention increases the risk of ejection and injury during a crash.
25V573000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the side curtain air bags, as necessary free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 14, 2025. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's numbers for this recall are 82C, 86C, 87C. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning September 11, 2025. This recall is replaced by NHTSA recall number 26V189. Vehicles already repaired under this recall will need to have the new remedy completed.

25V582000.DESC_DEFECT: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2025 Acura RDX vehicles. The software for the electric power steering (EPS) assist may not be calibrated properly, which can cause the EPS system to enter a failsafe mode, resulting in a loss of power steering assist.
25V582000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of power steering assist can require greater steering effort, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
25V582000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reprogram the EPS software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 20, 2025.
