26V180000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the front passenger seat frame assembly, as necessary, free of charge. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk were mailed April 27, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available, anticipated between September 17 - October 1, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26LB03 and 26LA03.

26V214000.DESC_DEFECT: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2017-2025 K 1600 GT, GTL, B and 2018-2025 Grand America vehicles. The seal for the reverse gear control unit may deteriorate and allow moisture inside the control unit, which can result in the unit overheating.
26V214000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated reverse gear control unit increases the risk of a fire.
26V214000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the reverse gear control unit, free of charge. Letters informing owners of the safety risk were mailed May 28, 2026. A second letter will be mailed once the remedy is available. Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning May 25, 2026.

26V198000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2025 G580 vehicles. The incorrect wheel bolts may have been installed during vehicle manufacturing.
26V198000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect wheel bolts can allow a wheel to loosen or detach from the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V198000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the wheel bolts, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 24, 2026. Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372. MBUSA's number for this recall is 2026040008. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on April 2, 2026.

26V205000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:HARD PARTS INTERNAL/MECHANICAL
26V205000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026 Explorer and Mustang vehicles. The engine piston circlips may have been incorrectly installed during manufacturing, which can result in piston failure and engine damage, leading to a loss of drive power.
26V205000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unexpected loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
26V205000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect the engine for missing or mis-installed circlips and replace the engine as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed April 10, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S23. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on April 2, 2026.

26V206000.DESC_DEFECT: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2025 LFS and 2024 LFS Artic transit buses. Inadequate adhesion around the window frame may cause the glass to detach. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."
26V206000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The glass can fall out of the frame, increasing the risk of ejection and injury during a crash. Detached window glass can also become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V206000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Nova Bus will inspect and replace the glass as necessary, free of charge. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk were mailed May 29, 2026. Owners will receive another notice once remedy becomes available. Owners may contact Nova Bus customer service at 1-450-472-6410. Nova Bus' number for this recall is CR5877. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning September 25, 2026.

26V247000.COMPNAME: FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE: SENSING SYSTEM: RADAR
26V247000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries, Inc. is recalling certain 2025-2026 Digger Derrick and 2025-2026 Aerial Device vehicles. The front end radar was improperly installed, which may result in improper operation of the Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) and Active Brake Assist (ABA).
26V247000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: While driving, the brakes may activate unexpectedly without the driver's input, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V247000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Altec will inform the owners to inspect the front end radar installation and if installed incorrectly, instruct owners to take the vehicle to an OEM Chassis dealer to have the radar remounted and calibrated, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 12, 2026. Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3309.

26V258000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Taos vehicles. In the event of a rear-end crash, the fuel pressure sensor may dislodge or separate from the fuel tank. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 301, "Fuel System Integrity."
26V258000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel tank with a dislodged or separated fuel pressure sensor can leak fuel after a rollover crash, increasing the risk of a fire.
26V258000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a fuel pressure sensor wiring harness extension, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 4, 2026. Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298. Volkswagen's number for this recall is 97TH. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning April 29, 2026.

26V281000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2024-2026 AMG GT, C-Class, E-Class, SL, CLE, and GLC vehicles. The infotainment control unit may reset while the vehicle is in motion and cause the instrument panel display to go blank.
26V281000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument panel display that fails to show critical safety information, such as the speedometer and warning lights, increases the risk of a crash.
26V281000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the infotainment control unit software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 29, 2026. MBUSA's number for this recall is 2026050004. Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning May 8, 2026.

26V313000.DESC_DEFECT: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2024 Cougar, 2025-2026 Alpine, 2026 Montana, and Walkabout recreational trailers. The shock bolts may have been incorrectly tightened.
26V313000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Loose shock bolts may cause a loss of vehicle stability, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V313000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the shock bolts, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 1, 2026. Owners may contact Keystone customer service at 1-866-425-4369. Keystone's number for this recall is 26-483.

26V472000.DESC_DEFECT: Coach and Equipment Mfg. Corp. (Coach and Equipment) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Phoenix, and 2025-2026 Metrolite transit buses, equipped with certain S-Series wheelchair platform lifts. The electrical contactor may fail, preventing the controls from stopping the lift.
26V472000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A wheelchair lift that continues to move while occupied increases the risk of injury.
26V472000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will correct the wiring by installing two diodes, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 31, 2026. Owners may contact Coach and Equipment customer service at 1-800-724-8464.

26V263000.MFGNAME: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
26V263000.DESC_DEFECT: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2026 Land Rover Defender vehicles. The fuel tank was improperly manufactured with walls that are too thin.
26V263000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: In the event of a crash, an improperly manufactured fuel tank may leak fuel, increasing the risk of a fire.
26V263000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the fuel tank, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed June 19, 2026. Owners may contact Land Rover's customer service at 800-637-6837. Land Rover's number for this recall is D127.

26V108000.DESC_DEFECT: Newmar Corporation (Newmar) is recalling certain 2018-2026 Bay Star and Bay Star Sport motorhomes. The hood stops mounting adhesive may fail, which can allow the hood stop to detach while the vehicle is in transit.
26V108000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Hood stops that detach can become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
26V108000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and reinstall the hood stop brackets, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed April 20, 2026. Owners may contact Newmar customer service at 1-800-731-8300. Newmar's number for this recall is 627 RSB.

26V477000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Pause travel trailers, and OG Luxury Coach recreational vehicles, equipped with certain MaxxAir N-Series Maxxfan rooftop ventilation fans. The printed circuit board may fail during certain operations and overheat.
26V477000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated printed circuit board increases the risk of a fire.
26V477000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the printed circuit board as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed in August 18, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at  1-574-534-3167. Forest River's number for this recall is 51-2077.

26V265000.DESC_DEFECT: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2022 Utilimaster Aeromaster vehicles. The Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) listed on the certification label may be incorrect. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
26V265000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Referencing the incorrect GVWR may lead to unintentionally overloading the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V265000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Shyft will install new labels, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed May 7, 2026. Owners may contact Shyft customer service at 1-800-237-7806. Shyft's number for this recall is 26-03.

26V273000.DESC_DEFECT: Newmar Corporation (Newmar) is recalling certain 2026 Freedom Aire motorhomes. The Cargo Carrying Capacity (CCC) label may state an incorrect weight value. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 120, âWheels and Rims - Other Than Passenger Cars.â
26V273000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect weight information can allow the vehicle to be overloaded, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V273000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the labels, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed May 20, 2026. Owners may contact Newmar customer service at 1-800-731-8300. Newmar's number for this recall is 631 RSB.

26V278000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2026 CLA 350 4MATIC (EV) and  CLA 250+ (EV) vehicles. The front passenger seat belt retractor may have been manufactured with a defect that prevents the deactivation of the child seat safety function (Automatic Locking Retractor). As a result, the seat belt may remain in a locked position and cannot be extended.
26V278000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A passenger who is unable to fasten their seat belt is not properly restrained, increasing their risk of injury in a crash.
26V278000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the front passenger seat belt, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 24, 2026. Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning May 8, 2026.

26V295000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Prime Time Crusader recreational trailers. The waste water holding tank ventilation pipe may end inside the trailer, allowing sewer gas to enter the cabin.
26V295000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Sewer gas inside the vehicle may increase the risk of injury.
26V295000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install the vent pipe and roof cap, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed May 14, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at  1-574-825-4995. Forest River's number for this recall is 49-2057. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning June 19, 2026.

26V301000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026 Escape and Lincoln Corsair vehicles. The integrated park module may fail to lock into the park position when the driver shifts into park. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 114, "Theft Protection and Rollaway Prevention."
26V301000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of park function can allow the vehicle to rollaway, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V301000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: The Secondary On Board Diagnostic Module C (SOBDMC) software will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 16, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25C69. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on May 15, 2026. This recall expands previous NHTSA recall number 25V863.

26V315000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Model Y vehicles. The certification label may not have been installed. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 C.F.R. Part 567, "Certification."
26V315000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Missing weight information provided by the label may lead to unintentionally overloading the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V315000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla Service will inspect and install a certification label as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 17, 2026. Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752. Tesla's number for this recall is SB-26-19-002.

26V326000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
26V326000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Jeep Grand Wagoneer and Jeep Grand Wagoneer L vehicles. The front camera wiring harness may not be connected properly, which can cause the rearview camera image not to display. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
26V326000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview image that does not display reduces the driver's view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V326000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and reconnect the wiring harness, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 9, 2026. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 47D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov on May 28, 2026.

26V339000.DESC_DEFECT: Ember Recreational Vehicles, INC. (Ember) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Touring Edition recreational trailers, equipped with certain Curt Touring Coil Suspensions. The shock bolts may have been incorrectly tightened.
26V339000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Broken shock retainer bolt heads and washers may detach and become a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V339000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the shock bolts, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 2, 2026. Owners may contact Ember customer service at 1-844-732-4204.

26V345000.DESC_DEFECT: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2026 Chevrolet Express and GMC Savana vehicles. The gear shifter may provide inaccurate gear selection feedback to the driver due to an incorrectly manufactured steering column assembly.
26V345000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Inaccurate gear selection may result in unexpected vehicle movement, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V345000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Until the remedy is performed, owners are advised to visually verify the shift position indicator each time a gear is selected and always use the parking brake when the vehicle is parked. Dealers will replace the transmission control on the steering column, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 9, 2026. Owners may contact GMC customer service at 1-888-988-7267 or Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020. GM's number for this recall is N262558671. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on May 28, 2026.

26V128000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Highlander and Highlander Hybrid vehicles. The second-row seat backs may fail to lock into position during seat back adjustment.
26V128000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat back that fails to lock may not properly restrain an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
26V128000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the return springs in the seat back recliner assemblies, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed September 9, 2026. This is a phased recall. Owners may contact Toyotaâs customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26TB06 and 26TA06.

26V409000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Digger Derrick vehicles. The vertical center of gravity with poles in the pole rack was not calculated properly, resulting in an incorrect pole rack capacity rating.
26V409000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: While using the pole rack at full capacity, an incorrect high vertical center of gravity during braking and cornering may lead to a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V409000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Altec will provide owners with a safety alert placard, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed August 21, 2026. Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3335.

26V403000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Bronco vehicles. The fender flares may not be properly secured and detach from the vehicle.
26V403000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached fender flare can become a road hazard and increase the risk of a crash.
26V403000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair, or replace the fender flares as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 1, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S47. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning August 7, 2026.

26V629000.DESC_DEFECT: Greenpower Motor Company Inc. (Greenpower) is recalling certain 2018-2024 EV Star and 2020-2023 EV Star Mobility Plus buses. A control module interlock software error may allow the bus to move while the wheelchair lift is deployed.
26V629000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The bus moving while the wheelchair lift is in use increases the risk of injury.
26V629000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the control module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 12, 2026. Owners may contact Greenpower's customer service at 1-909-346-1090. Greenpower's number for this recall is GP2604002.

26V464000.DESC_DEFECT: Foretravel, Inc. (Foretravel) is recalling certain 2027 Realm Presidential Motorcoaches. The printed circuit board in the MaxxAir Fan assembly may fail during certain operations and overheat.
26V464000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated printed circuit board increases the risk of a fire.
26V464000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the printed circuit board as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 27, 2026. Owners may contact Foretravel customer service at 1-800-955-6226.

26V475000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Freightliner EM2, Freightliner Custom Chassis S2RV, Freightliner Custom Chassis S2C, and Freightliner Business Class M2 vehicles. A software error may cause the low beam headlights to illuminate improperly.
26V475000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Insufficient low beam headlight illumination can reduce driver visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V475000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the headlight software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 18, 2026. Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712. DTNA's number for this recall is F1036.

26V591000.DESC_DEFECT: Micro Bird USA LLC (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2025-2027 G5e school buses. A wiring harness may have been incorrectly routed. A metal bracket may contact and damage the harness, causing a loss of drive power.
26V591000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of driver power increases the risk of a crash.
26V591000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Micro Bird will inspect, replace, and properly secure the wiring harness as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 10, 2026. Owners can contact Micro Bird's Customer Service at 819-477-2012. Micro Bird's number for this recall is 26-122-HVC.

26V592000.DESC_DEFECT: Farber Specialty Vehicles (Farber Specialty) is recalling certain Farber vehicles equipped with certain S-Series and K-Series wheelchair platform lifts. Please see the recall report for a complete list of models. The electrical contactor may fail, preventing the controls from stopping the lift.
26V592000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A wheelchair lift that continues to move while occupied increases the risk of injury.
26V592000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Farber Specialty will work with Ricon to correct the wiring by installing two diodes, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 1, 2026. Owners may contact Farber customer service at 1-800-331-3188.

26V608000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Cedar Creek fifth wheel recreational trailers. The sleeper sofa may block the bunkroom door.
26V608000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A blocked door can prevent or delay occupants from exiting during an emergency, increasing their risk of injury.
26V608000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will correct the swing of the bunkroom door, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 2, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-825-4995. Forest River's number for this recall is 20-2098.

26V559000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US LLC) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Jeep Wagoneer, 2024-2026 Jeep Grand Cherokee, Jeep Grand Cherokee L, Jeep Grand Cherokee 4XE, Jeep Grand Wagoneer, 2025 Jeep Wagoneer L, 2025-2026 Jeep Grand Wagoneer L, and 2026 Jeep Cherokee vehicles. Due to a software error, the tire pressure monitoring system may fail to detect low tire pressure and/or fail to illuminate the tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) warning light as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring System."
26V559000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A TPMS warning light that fails to notify the driver of low tire pressure increases the risk of a crash.
26V559000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the radio frequency hub software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed beginning September 17, 2026. Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403. FCA US, LLC's number for this recall is 54D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on September 9, 2026.

26V644000.DESC_DEFECT: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2013-2027 buses. Please see the complete list of models above. The instrument panel indicator light may not illuminate when the hazard warning lights are on and the master run switch is in the 'Off' position. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
26V644000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Without the illuminated reminder, the driver may fail to turn off the exterior lights when no longer needed. Hazard warning lights that remain activated unintentionally can confuse other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V644000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: New Flyer will update the software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. Owners may contact New Flyer's customer service at 1-800-241-2947.

26V618000.DESC_DEFECT: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC) is recalling certain 2024-2026 RM900 and 2026 RM700 trailers. The coupler mounting bolts may loosen, separating the coupler from the trailer.
26V618000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A separated trailer coupler can cause a loss of control and increase the risk of a crash.
26V618000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: ATC will install a gusset reinforcement kit, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 13, 2026. Owners may call ATC customer service at 1-877-441-2440.

26V649000.DESC_DEFECT: REV Ambulance Group Orlando, Inc. (REVO) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Road Rescue Type I, Road Rescue Type III, and 2025-2026 Wheeled Coach Type III ambulances. A node may become unresponsive and cause a loss of functionality of connected components, such as vehicle warning lights.
26V649000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of warning lights can increase the risk of a crash.
26V649000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: REVO will provide a replacement S-Node 8x16 (Node 5), free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed in October 2026. Owners may contact REVO customer service at 1-855-661-9232.

26V554000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Entegra Accolade, Accolade XL, Jayco Seneca, and Seneca Prestige recreational vehicles. The tire size may be incorrect on the vehicle certification label. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 120, "Wheels and Rims-Other than  Passenger Cars."
26V554000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect information may result in the wrong sized replacement tires being installed, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V554000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Jayco will mail replacement labels, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 14, 2026. Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267. Jayco's number for this recall is 9903664.

26V529000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Jeep Grand Cherokee and Grand Cherokee L vehicles. Due to a software issue in the body control module (BCM), the windshield wipers may fail.
26V529000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Windshield wiper failure can reduce visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V529000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the body control module (BCM) software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 3, 2026. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  Chrysler's number for this recall is 77D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on August 20, 2026.

26V521000.DESC_DEFECT: Marion Body Works Inc. (Marion Body Works) is recalling certain 2025 Pumper fire engines, equipped with certain Weldon UV800 Display Unit user interfaces. The display may stop responding to touch commands or fail to power on, preventing the activation of exterior emergency lights, fire fighting and other emergency equipment.
26V521000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of exterior lights can reduce the visibility of the vehicle to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash. Inoperative equipment can delay emergency response, increasing the risk of injury.
26V521000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Marion Body Works will work with Hale Products to update the firmware and install a monitor system, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed in August 2026. Owners may contact Marion Body Works customer service at 1-715-754-5261.

26V510000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Dodge Hornet and 2023-2026 Alfa Romeo Tonale vehicles. The rear outboard seat belts may become twisted and fail to retract properly.
26V510000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat belt that does not retract may fail to restrain properly an occupant as intended, increasing the risk of injury.
26V510000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the retractors and pillar trim, as necessary, free of charge. Interim notification letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, were mailed September 17, 2026. A  second notice will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 84D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on August 15, 2026.

26V505000.DESC_DEFECT: Escape Trailer Industries Ltd. (Escape) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Escape E13 F1 recreational trailers. Insufficient ventilation around the refrigerator may allow carbon monoxide to buildup inside the passenger cabin.
26V505000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The accumulation of exhaust fumes increases the risk of injury or death from carbon monoxide poisoning.
26V505000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a ventilation fan and insulation, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed August 4, 2026. Owners may contact Escape customer service at 1-855-703-1650.

26V498000.DESC_DEFECT: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Ekko motorhomes. The touchscreen display may register unintended or phantom inputs and turn the generator on without the operator's knowledge.
26V498000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: People in an enclosed space, such as a garage, with a running generator may be at an increased risk of injury or death from carbon monoxide poisoning.
26V498000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park outside until the repair has been performed. Winnebago will release an over-the-air (OTA) software update, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 24, 2026. Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-641-585-6939 or 1-800-537-1885. Winnebago's number for this recall is 208.

26V490000.DESC_DEFECT: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2026 Imagine travel trailers. The outlet cover may have been improperly secured, allowing screws to contact wiring.
26V490000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Contact with wiring may cause a short circuit or an electrical arc, increasing the risk of a fire.
26V490000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the screws as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 21, 2026. Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679. Grand Design's number for this recall is 910064.

26V471000.DESC_DEFECT: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC) is recalling certain 2026 RM500 and RM700 trailers. The wireless handheld remote control may be incompatible with some legacy winches, resulting in unexpected winch movements.
26V471000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A winch that operates unintentionally may increase the risk of injury.
26V471000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: ATC will replace the wireless remote or provide a refund, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 7, 2026. Owners may call ATC customer service at 1-877-441-2440.

26V469000.DESC_DEFECT: Ember Recreational Vehicles, INC. (Ember) is recalling certain 2027 Overland Series, E-Series, and Touring Series travel trailers. The Federal Certification Label may have the incorrect Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) listed. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
26V469000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrect VIN on the label can make it difficult for owners to recognize that their vehicle is involved in a safety recall, increasing the risk of crash or injury.
26V469000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the labels, free of charge. Additionally, Ember will mail replacement labels to owners. Owner notification letters were mailed August 5, 2026. Owners may contact Ember customer service at 1-844-732-4204.

26V457000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2013-2025 AP45A trucks. The boom stow switch wire in the cargo storage area may become damaged, which can result in a short circuit, causing the wire to overheat.
26V457000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated wire can ignite flammable material in the cargo area, increasing the risk of fire.
26V457000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Altec will instruct owners to inspect their vehicle and if the wire is not protected, order a kit that includes a bolt on guard to protect the wires, free of charge. Letters informing owners of the safety risk were mailed September 11, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3349.

26V431000.DESC_DEFECT: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2022-2024 EV6 and 2024 EV9 vehicles. The high voltage battery cells may contain misaligned electrodes, which can lead to a fire while parked or driving.
26V431000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fire increases the risk of injury.
26V431000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures and limit their charge to a maximum of 80% until the recall repair is complete. Dealers will replace the high voltage battery system assembly, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed August 7, 2026. Owners may contact Kia customer service at 1-800-333-4542. Kia's number for this recall is SC375. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning July 17, 2026.

26V420000.DESC_DEFECT: Teko Inc (Teko) is recalling certain 2026 Triumph, Turbo, TurboLite, Trophy, and Trophy Plus vehicles. The acoustic vehicle alerting system (AVAS) may not have been installed, preventing the vehicle from making pedestrian warning sounds. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 141, "Minimum Sound Requirements for Hybrid and Electric Vehicles."
26V420000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A vehicle that does not make a sound may fail to alert pedestrians of an approaching vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
26V420000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Teko will provide an AVAS kit, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed August 17, 2026. Owners may contact Teko Customer Care at contact@tekoev.com.

26V416000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2027 Entegra Accolade and Jayco Seneca motorhomes. The front brackets may not have been installed, allowing the dinette to shift or detach. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 207, "Seating Systems."
26V416000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A dinette that moves during transit may increase the risk of injury.
26V416000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install the front dinette bracket, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed August 3, 2026. Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267. Jayco's number for this recall is 9903659. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning August 3, 2026.

26V414000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Jeep Grand Wagoneer and Jeep Grand Wagoneer L vehicles. The brake system control module software may cause a loss of electronic stability control and a loss of electronic brake assist. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 126, "Electronic Stability Control Systems" and 135, "Light Vehicle Brake Systems."
26V414000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of electronic stability control and/or electronic brake assist increases the risk of a crash.
26V414000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the brake system control module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed July 30, 2026. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 50D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning July 9, 2026.

26V358000.DESC_DEFECT: Braun Corporation (Braun) is recalling certain 2023-2026 Chrysler Pacifica and Voyager vehicles. The spring inside the front seat harness connector may contact electrical terminals.
26V358000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The unintended connection may prevent the air bags from deploying, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
26V358000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the spring, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 16, 2026. Owners may contact Braun's customer service at 1-800-488-0359.

26V218000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Hyundai Ioniq 6, 2023-2026 Genesis G90, 2024-2026 Hyundai Santa Fe, and Hyundai Santa Fe Hybrid vehicles. The driver and passenger seat belt anchors may detach.
26V218000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached seat belt anchor will not adequately restrain the seat occupant, increasing the risk of injury in a crash.
26V218000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and reinforce or replace the seat belt anchors, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed beginning May 29, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460 and Genesis customer service at 844-340-9741. Hyundai's numbers for this recall are 298 and 032G. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov April 8, 2026.

26V216000.DESC_DEFECT: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2018 E 400 4MATIC Sedan, E 400 4MATIC Wagon, E 400 4MATIC Cabriolet, E 400 4MATIC Coupe, 2018-2020 Maybach S 560 4MATIC, S 560 4MATIC Coupe, S 450 4MATIC, 2019-2020 E 450 4MATIC Sedan, E 450 4MATIC Wagon, E 450 4MATIC Coupe, and E 450 4MATIC Cabriolet vehicles. The drive shaft universal joint may break, resulting in a sudden loss of drive power.
26V216000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A sudden loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
26V216000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the drive shaft as necessary, free of charge. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, were mailed May 22, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning April 10, 2026.

26V640000.DESC_DEFECT: Rosenbauer America (Rosenbauer) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Commander and 2024 Warrior fire engines. The rim weld may crack, causing the wheel to separate and tire to deflate.
26V640000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Wheel and/or tire failure increases the risk of a crash.
26V640000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until the remedy has been completed. Dealers will replace the wheels and tires as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 19, 2026. Owners may contact Rosenbauer customer service at 1-651-462-1000.

26V221000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Westbrook and Avenger travel trailers. The Federal Placard label may list an incorrect dry weight. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, âTire Selection and Rims.â
26V221000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Incorrect weight information may lead to unintentionally overloading the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V221000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the label, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed April 17, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-260-499-2100. Forest River's number for this recall is 452-2045.

26V223000.COMPNAME: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE
26V223000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Jeep Cherokee vehicles. The brake system control module may fail to operate properly, which can cause a loss of anti-lock brakes (ABS) and electronic stability control (ESC).
26V223000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of anti-lock brakes or electronic stability control increases the risk of a crash.
26V223000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the brake system control module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed April 28, 2026.  Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403.  FCA's number for this recall is 29D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning April 16, 2026.

26V276000.DESC_DEFECT: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Lineage recreational vehicles. The adhesive securing the solar panels to the roof may fail, allowing the solar panel to detach.
26V276000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached solar panel can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V276000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install mechanical fasteners, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed May 11, 2026. Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679. Grand Design's number for this recall is M910059. This recall supersedes NHTSA recall 26V042.

26V224000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Jeep Wrangler vehicles. The child seat tether welds on the second-row, right-side seat frame may be insufficient, which can reduce the seat's ability to properly restrain a child during a crash. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 225, "Child Restraint Anchorage Systems."
26V224000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A child that is not properly restrained during a crash can have an increased risk of injury.
26V224000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the second-row, right-side seat frame, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed May 29, 2026. Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403. FCA's number for this recall is 27D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning April 16, 2026.

26V225000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Ram 1500 Pickup, Ram 2500 Pickup, Ram 3500 Pickup, Ram 3500 Cab Chassis, Ram 4500 Cab Chassis, and Ram 5500 Cab Chassis vehicles. A software error may cause the instrument panel display to fail. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards numbers 102, "Transmission Shift Position Sequence," 105, "Hydraulic and Electric Brake Systems," 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment," 126, "Electronic Stability Control Systems for Light Vehicles," 135, "Light Vehicle Brake Systems," 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring System," and/or 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
26V225000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument panel display that fails to show critical safety information, such as gear selection and warning lights, increases the risk of a crash.
26V225000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the instrument panel software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed May 5, 2026. Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403. FCA's number for this recall is 35D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning April 16, 2026.

26V645000.DESC_DEFECT: Motor Coach Industries (MCI) is recalling certain 2018-2026 buses. Please see the complete list of models above. The instrument panel indicator light may not illuminate when the hazard warning lights are on and the master run switch is in the 'Off' position. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
26V645000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Without the illuminated reminder, the driver may fail to turn off the exterior lights when no longer needed. Hazard warning lights that remain activated unintentionally can confuse other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V645000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: MCI will update the software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 24, 2026. Owners may contact MCI customer service at 1-800-241-2947.

26V256000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2025 RAV 4 vehicles. The front seat brackets for the seat rails may be welded improperly.
26V256000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Improperly welded seat brackets can prevent the seat from adequately restraining an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
26V256000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair the seat bracket welds as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 19, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26TB09 and 26TA09.

26V279000.DESC_DEFECT: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2022 XE40 transit buses. The speedometer may not illuminate when the headlights are turned on. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."
26V279000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unlit speedometer cannot show the vehicle's speed, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V279000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: New Flyer will update the software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed June 15, 2026. Owners may contact New Flyer's customer service at 1-800-241-2947.

26V275000.COMPNAME: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:PROPULSION SYSTEM:HYBRID MANAGEMENT:POWER CONTROL UNIT/MODULE (HPCU)
26V275000.DESC_DEFECT: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2022-2025 LFS transit buses. The telemetry control unit installed in parallel with the vehicle monitoring system may cause a data overload.
26V275000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overloaded control unit may shutdown, causing a loss of drive power and increasing the risk of a crash.
26V275000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Nova Bus will modify the connection configuration and update the software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 2, 2026. Owners may contact Nova Bus customer service at 1-450-472-6410. Nova Bus' number for this recall is CR5882. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning June 29, 2026.

26V011000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2013-2018 Focus, 2013-2019 Escape, and 2015-2016 MKC vehicles equipped with a 2.0L engine. The engine block heater may crack and develop a coolant leak, causing it to short circuit when the block heater is plugged in.
26V011000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An electrical short circuit can increase the risk of a fire.
26V011000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised not to plug in their block heater until the vehicle is remedied. Dealers will replace the block heater, free of charge. Owners will also have a alternative option to replace engine block heater element with a threaded plug, and remove the block heater electrical cord. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, were mailed March 6, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S01. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on January 16, 2026.

26V314000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 Ioniq 5 and 2026 Ioniq 9 vehicles. The fasteners for the rear suspension may loosen and detach, which can result in a loss of vehicle control.
26V314000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of vehicle control increases the risk of a crash.
26V314000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the rear suspension fasteners and perform a rear vehicle alignment, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed July 17, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 303. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on May 20, 2026.

26V308000.COMPNAME: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:PROPULSION SYSTEM:HYBRID MANAGEMENT:POWER CONTROL UNIT/MODULE (HPCU)
26V308000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Elantra Hybrid vehicles. The hybrid power control unit (HPCU) assembly may overheat.
26V308000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Overheating in the HPCU increases the risk of a fire.
26V308000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the HPCU software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 3, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 301. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on May 16, 2026.

26V311000.COMPNAME: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:PROPULSION SYSTEM:FUSES, RELAYS, CONTACTS, AND SHUNTS
26V311000.DESC_DEFECT: Oshkosh Corporation (Oshkosh Defense) is recalling certain 2025 NGDV battery electric vehicles. In cold weather, the high voltage battery contactor may open unexpectedly, causing a loss of drive power.
26V311000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power can increase the risk of a crash.
26V311000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Oshkosh Defense will repair or replace the batteries as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed May 26, 2026. Owners may contact Oshkosh Defense customer service at 1-833-304-8100. Oshkosh Defense's number for this recall is NGDV_TSB_066.

26V331000.DESC_DEFECT: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Kicks vehicles. A software error in the combination meter may cause the screen display to go partially or fully blank. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 101, "Control and Displays."
26V331000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A partial or blank screen display will not show critical safety information such as vehicle speed and warning lights, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V331000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will resume the software reprogramming of the combination meter software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 6, 2026. Owners may contact Nissan's customer service at 800-647-7261. Nissan's number for this recall is PMA66. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on May 22, 2026.

26V338000.DESC_DEFECT: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2025-2026 GT1, 2026 GH2, and GH1 motorhomes. A screw may have punctured the fuel tank during manufacturing, causing a fuel leak.
26V338000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source, increases the risk of a fire.
26V338000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures until the remedy is completed. Dealers will inspect and replace the fuel tank as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 23, 2026. Owners may contact Tiffin customer service at 1-256-356-8661. Tiffin's number for this recall is TIF-148.

26V361000.DESC_DEFECT: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2026 Entegra Qwest SE, Condor, Jayco Granite Ridge, and Melbourne recreational vehicles. The taillight warning light may incorrectly illuminate on the instrument panel display when the taillights are functioning correctly. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."
26V361000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The incorrect warning light may fail to alert the driver to critical safety information or cause confusion, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V361000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the taillight harness, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 18, 2026. Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267. Jayco's number for this recall is 9903657 .

26V357000.DESC_DEFECT: Braun Corporation (Braun) is recalling certain 2026 Ram ProMaster vehicles equipped with Q'Straint's One-Combo Belt, with part number TX11258-BA. The wheelchair seat belts may have incompatible connectors and fail to properly restrain occupants.
26V357000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Improperly restrained occupants have an increased risk of injury during a crash.
26V357000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the seat belt, free of charge. Owners may contact Braun's customer service at 1-800-488-0359.

26V370000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2017 F-150 vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 17V053. The instrument cluster may lose power after initial vehicle start-up in cold ambient temperatures. Several gauges, including the transmission gear position indicator, may not illuminate.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 102, "Transmission Shift Lever Sequence, Starter Interlock, and Transmission Braking Effect."
26V370000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument cluster that fails to display critical safety information, such as gear position or warning lights, increases the risk of a crash or injury.
26V370000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the Instrument Panel Cluster Assembly (IPC) software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 17, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26C26. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on July 6, 2026.

26V373000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2018-2020 F-150 vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 20V097. When the headlight switch is turned from "Autolamps" to "Headlamps On," the Daytime Running Lamps (DRLs) may remain fully bright instead of dimming to parking lamps as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices and Associated Equipment."
26V373000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Daytime Running Lamps that do not dim may reduce the visibility of other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V373000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: ,Dealers will reprogram the body control module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 17, 2026. Owners may contact customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26C28. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on July 6, 2026.

26V375000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2018 F-150 vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 17V669. Quickly moving the shift lever from Park to Drive may cause a loss of gear indication on the instrument cluster display and a momentary selection of an unintended gear, such as Reverse or Neutral.
26V375000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Unintended gear selection may cause the vehicle to move in an unexpected direction, increasing the risk of crash or injury.
26V375000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the powertrain control module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 9, 2026. Owners may contact customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S42. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on July 6, 2026.

26V122000.COMPNAME: ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:EXHAUST SYSTEM:EMISSION CONTROL:GAS RECIRCULATION VALVE (EGR VALVE)
26V122000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Ranger, Lincoln Nautilus, Mustang, Maverick, Explorer, Escape, Lincoln Corsair, Bronco Sport, and Bronco vehicles. The exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valve may fail, resulting in an unexpected loss of drive power.
26V122000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unexpected loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
26V122000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the EGR valves, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 31, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S10. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on March 4, 2026.

26V255000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Cybertruck vehicles equipped with 18-inch steel wheels. The brake rotor stud holes may crack and allow the stud to separate from the wheel hub.
26V255000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Wheel stud separation can cause a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V255000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla Service will replace the front and rear brake rotors, hubs, and lug nuts, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 20, 2026. Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752. Tesla's number for this recall is SB-26-33-003.

26V123000.DESC_DEFECT: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Escape, Lincoln Corsair, 2020-2024 Lincoln Aviator, and Explorer vehicles. The image on the center display may flip or invert, resulting in an incorrectly displayed rearview image when the vehicle is placed in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
26V123000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An incorrectly displayed rearview image can reduce the driverâs view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V123000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the accessory protocol interface module (APIM) software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 23, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26C11. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on March 5, 2026.

26V385000.DESC_DEFECT: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Revel and Revel Sport recreational vehicles. The tire information label states an incorrect tire. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
26V385000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Referencing the incorrect information could cause owners to install the wrong size replacement tires, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V385000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install new labels, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 17, 2026. Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-641-585-6939 or 1-800-537-1885. Winnebago's number for this recall is 207.

26V390000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2023-2024 XLR Toy Hauler recreational trailers. The listed Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) exceeds the weight rating on the upper deck chassis. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 120, "Wheels and Rims-Other than Passenger Cars."
26V390000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Referencing the incorrect GVWR may lead to unintentionally overloading the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V390000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will install a new corrected label, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 16, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-642-0432. Forest River's number for this recall is 79-2067.

26V393000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2026 Toyota BZ, Lexus RZ, and Subaru Solterra battery electric vehicles. The electronic control unit (ECU) that controls the high voltage battery may experience a fault, resulting in a loss of drive power.
26V393000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unexpected loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
26V393000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the battery ECU software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 17, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26LA07 and 26TA11. Subaru's number for this recall is WRG26.

26V391000.DESC_DEFECT: Wabash National Corporation (Wabash) is recalling certain 2027 Wabash van trailers. The bumper tube bolts may have been improperly tightened, reducing the protection provided by the rear impact guard. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 223, "Rear Impact Guards."
26V391000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An improperly installed guard may not sufficiently protect a following vehicle, increasing the risk of injury during a rear end crash.
26V391000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will tighten the bumper tube bolts, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed August 14, 2026. Owners may contact Wabash customer service at 1-765-771-5404.

26V432000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Ioniq 5 vehicles. The high voltage battery cells may contain misaligned electrodes, which can lead to a fire while parked or driving.
26V432000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fire increases the risk of injury.
26V432000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures and limit their charge to a maximum of 80% until the recall repair is complete. Dealers will replace the high voltage battery system assembly, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed August 31, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai's customer service at 855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 305. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on July 3, 2026.

26V434000.COMPNAME: FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
26V434000.DESC_DEFECT: Braun Corporation (Braun) is recalling certain 2026 Chevrolet Traverse vehicles. The fuel fill line may be missing a braze connection, allowing fuel to leak.
26V434000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A fuel leak increases the risk of fire.
26V434000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the fuel fill assembly, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed beginning August 3, 2026.  Owners may contact Braun's customer service at 1-800-488-0359.

26V450000.DESC_DEFECT: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2027 Navion and View recreational vehicles equipped with certain MaxxAir N-Series Maxxfan rooftop ventilation fans. The printed circuit board may fail during certain operations and overheat.
26V450000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated printed circuit board increases the risk of a fire.
26V450000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the printed circuit board as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 4, 2026. Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-641-585-6939 or 1-800-537-1885. Winnebago's number for this recall is 209.

26V453000.DESC_DEFECT: Orange EV is recalling certain 2023-2024 e-TRIEVER, 2020-2023 T-Series Tandem Terminal Truck, and 2024-2026 HUSK-e Tandem Terminal vehicles. Improper welding may cause frame rails to crack, leading to rail separation.
26V453000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached rail can cause a loss of control, increasing the risk of injury.
26V453000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and repair or replace the frame rails as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed July 22, 2026. Owners may contact Orange EV customer service at 1-866-688-5223. Orange EV's number for this recall is 2026-SRC-02.

26V502000.DESC_DEFECT: Alamo Group, Inc. (Royal Truck) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Royal Truck & Equipment Class 2 Traffic Control trucks equipped with a Wanco sign board. The solar panel screws may loosen, resulting in a partial detachment.
26V502000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A dangling or completely disengaged solar panel may hit other vehicles or pedestrians, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
26V502000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Royal Truck will provide instructions on how to remove the self-tapping screws and replace with rivets, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 29, 2026. Owners may contact Royal Truck's customer service at 866-975-0212.

26V506000.DESC_DEFECT: Wabash National Corporation (Wabash) is recalling certain 2027 Van Trailers. The external antilock (ABS) malfunction indicator light may not be labeled. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 121, "Air Brake Systems."
26V506000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unlabeled ABS light may confuse following drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V506000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Wabash will mail ABS identification labels and installation instructions, free of charge. Owner letters were mailed September 11, 2026. Owners may contact Wabash customer service at 1-765-771-5404.

26V511000.DESC_DEFECT: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Camry Hybrid vehicles. The instrument cluster display may fail during vehicle startup, deactivating the hazard lights, turn signals, seat belt warning system, and smart key reminder. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 101, "Control and Displays," 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices and Associated Equipment," 114, "Theft Protection and Rollaway Prevention," and 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."
26V511000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An instrument cluster that fails to display critical safety information increases the risk of a crash or injury.
26V511000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the display software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed September 28, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26TB16 and 26TA16.

26V533000.DESC_DEFECT: Halcore Group, Inc. (Halcore) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Horton Type I, Type III, and Critical Care ambulances. The touchscreen display may stop responding to touch commands or fail to power on, preventing the activation of exterior emergency lights, as well as fire fighting and other emergency equipment.
26V533000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of exterior lights can reduce the visibility of the vehicle to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash. Inoperative equipment can delay emergency response, increasing the risk of injury.
26V533000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Weldon Division of Akron will update the firmware and repair the power line, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 5, 2026. Owners may contact Weldon customer service at 1-800-228-1161 or Halcore customer service at 1-800-447-0343.

26V324000.DESC_DEFECT: Alliance RV, LLC (Alliance) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Valor and Paradigm recreational trailers. The heating pad may not be appropriate for lithium battery applications.
26V324000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The heating pad may overheat in the battery compartment, increasing the risk of a fire.
26V324000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will replace the heating pads, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed June 24, 2026. Owners may contact Alliance customer service at 1-574-218-7165. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning May 29, 2026.

26V531000.COMPNAME: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
26V531000.DESC_DEFECT: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Jeep Wrangler, Jeep Gladiator, Jeep Compass, Jeep Cherokee, Jeep Grand Cherokee, Jeep Grand Cherokee L, Jeep Grand Wagoneer, Jeep Grand Wagoneer L, Ram Promaster, Ram Promaster EV, Ram 1500, Ram 2500, Chrysler Pacifica Plug-In Hybrid, Chrysler Voyager, and 2026-2027 Chrysler Pacifica and Dodge Charger vehicles. The rearview camera image may fail to display when the vehicle is placed in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
26V531000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A rearview camera image that fails to display reduces the driver's view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V531000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Radio software will be updated by a dealer or through an over-the-air (OTA) update, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed beginning September 2, 2026. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 78D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov on August 20, 2026.

26V631000.DESC_DEFECT: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Anthem AN (4) and 2025-2027 Pioneer PR (4) vehicles. The intake and grille bezels may detach from the vehicle.
26V631000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A detached bezel can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V631000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect, replace the intake and grille bezels, and install cable ties as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 30, 2026. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0501. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 8, 2026.

26V652000.DESC_DEFECT: E-One Incorporated (E-One) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Typhoon N, 2025-2026 Cyclone N, and 2026 Cyclone II fire trucks. The positive power supply may be loose, causing the wiring harness and busbar to overheat.
26V652000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated busbar can increase the risk of a fire.
26V652000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: E-ONE will provide a replacement wiring harness and busbar, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 20, 2026. Owners may contact E-One customer service at 1-352-237-1122.

26V546000.DESC_DEFECT: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2027 Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER HDX2 and Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER EFX2 school buses. The connector plates for the driver's seat belt anchor and an interior body joint seam may be missing, resulting in insufficient structural reinforcements. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages," and 221, "School Bus Body Joint Strength."
26V546000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A seat belt anchor with a missing connector plate may fail to properly restrain the driver and insufficient joint strength may not adequately protect passengers, increasing the risk of injury in a crash.
26V546000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the header connectors, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 23, 2026. Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-574-0712. DTNA's number for this recall is F1038.

26V551000.DESC_DEFECT: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Service Body vehicles.  Water can leak into the strobe lights, which may cause an electrical short-circuit.
26V551000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An electrical short circuit can increase the risk of a fire.
26V551000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Altec will provide instructions to inspect the light assembly for moisture and install a new fuse.  If moisture is found or the light is inoperative, a light replacement kit will be installed, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 23, 2026.  Owners may contact Altec's customer service at 1-877-462-5832.  Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3360. This recall is an expansion of previous NHTSA recall number 23V357.

26V558000.DESC_DEFECT: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2026 Model Y vehicles. One or more front suspension lateral link fasteners may not have been properly tightened, allowing the lateral link to loosen or separate from the sub-frame.
26V558000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A lateral link separation could shift the wheel alignment, causing a loss of vehicle control and increasing the risk of a crash.
26V558000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Tesla Service will tighten or replace the fasteners and check wheel the alignment, free of charge. In addition, Tesla Service will replace any related parts that may have been damaged as necessary. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 30, 2026. Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752. Tesla's number for this recall is SB-26-31-004.

26V563000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2027 Vibe recreational trailers. The furnace exhaust may not be correctly attached to the outside flue, allowing carbon monoxide to buildup inside the passenger cabin.
26V563000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: Unvented exhaust fumes increase the risk of injury from carbon monoxide poisoning.
26V563000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will reposition the furnace, free of charge. Owners notification letters were mailed September 15, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-327-2716.

26V587000.DESC_DEFECT: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2025 Tiguan vehicles. A software error may cause the body control module (BCM) system to reset. This may result in the ignition switching off, resulting in an engine stall.  It can also lead to a loss of certain controls, warning lights, exterior lighting, or failure of the rearview camera system. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 101, "Controls and Displays," and 102, "Transmission shift lever sequence, starter interlock, and transmission braking effect," as well as FMVSS numbers 111 and 108.
26V587000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An unexpected engine stall, loss of exterior lighting or warning lights, or failure of the rearview camera system can increase the risk of a crash.
26V587000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will update the body control module (BCM) software, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 6, 2026. Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298. Volkswagen's number for this recall is 57KL. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on September 17, 2026.

26V588000.DESC_DEFECT: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2026 Ioniq 9 vehicles equipped with a Limited, Calligraphy, or Calligraphy Design trim package. The second-row power seats may fail to detect a person. As a result, the seats may continue to move after contacting a person during powered seat functions, such as automatic power fold-and-stow.
26V588000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A person, especially a child, may become trapped by a rear powered seat, increasing the risk of injury.
26V588000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Owners are advised to exercise caution when operating the second-row power seat functions until the repair is performed. Children are advised not to be in the rear seats or near the rear seating area during power-folding operation. The seat software will be inspected and updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a dealer, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 1, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 307. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on September 12, 2026.

26V603000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Dynamax Grand Sport GT recreational vehicles. The engine pre-heat pump may have been improperly installed, causing the coolant hose to fail.
26V603000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A coolant hose failure can cause the engine to overheat, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V603000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will re-pin the wiring harness, re-route the coolant hoses, and replace parts as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 31, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-522-1583. Forest River's number for this recall is 40-2097.

26V625000.DESC_DEFECT: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2027 R2 vehicles. A high voltage battery fastener may have been improperly tightened, causing a loss of drive power.
26V625000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
26V625000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Rivian will inspect and repair the connection or replace damaged components as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 28, 2026. Owners may contact Rivian customer service at 1-888-748-4261. Rivian's number for this recall is FSAM-1888. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 28, 2026.

26V628000.DESC_DEFECT: Grech Motors Inc. (Grech) is recalling certain 2027 Strada, Terreno, and 2026-2027 Turismo motorhomes equipped with certain MaxxAir N-Series Maxxfan rooftop ventilation fans. The printed circuit board may fail during certain operations and overheat.
26V628000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An overheated printed circuit board increases the risk of a fire.
26V628000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Dealers will inspect and replace the printed circuit board as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 30, 2026. Owners may contact Grech Customer service at 1-951-688-8347.

26V639000.DESC_DEFECT: Ring Power Corporation (Ring Power) is recalling certain 2020 Terex General 65, 2020-2021 C6000, 2020-2022 C4000, and TC55 vehicles. The incorrect pintle hitch may have been installed without reinforced bracing, resulting in the rear bumper hitch plate bending.
26V639000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: The pintle hitch may fail, causing a loss of trailer control and increasing the risk of a crash.
26V639000.CORRECTIVE_ACTION: Ring Power will inspect, replace the pintle hitch, and install bracing. Damaged bumpers will be replaced. All repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 16, 2026. Owners may contact Ring Power's customer service at 904-613-0035. Ring Power's number for this recall is 23402.

26V647000.DESC_DEFECT: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2027 Surveyor recreational trailers. The exterior receptacle may not be wired to a GFCI circuit.
26V647000.CONEQUENCE_DEFECT: An outlet without GFCI protection may fail to shut off electrical power when a ground-fault occurs, increasing the risk of injury.
